"What are you going to do to them, Fei'er?" Zhang Chen inquired while grabbing her grandson's hand, especially since she didn't want Zhang Fei to become a cold-blooded murderer by killing those people.

Zhang Fei naturally understood her grandmother's feelings, so she hugged Zhang Chen while saying it to him. "Grandma, I warned and spared them before, but they themselves chose to find trouble with us again, so I won't give them a second chance, and I will give them a punishment they will never be able to imagine."
"But, Fei'er-"

"I'm sorry, but I won't change my decision about them, Grandma." Zhang Fei then looked at Qing Yi before continuing. "Anyway, they also brought Zhang Hai with them, and they seemed to be thinking of using him to force me to surrender to them."
"What?" Zhang Chen and Qing Yi exclaimed in shock after hearing that.
"They're almost here, so I'm going to meet them now." Zhang Fei then released Zhang Chen from his arms and walked out of the house.
Zhang Chen and the others wanted to follow him, but the Chu Sisters and Ye Lian stopped them, so they went to follow Zhang Fei instead, especially since they were the strongest among them.

sentences.text: At the Qin House, Lu Xin was standing before Qin Feng after he called her to meet him, and he asked her directly.
"Have they found Zhang Hai and his family?"
"Yes, General." Lu Xin then handed her phone to Qin Feng, which showed a video.
"Our people have managed to arrest Zhang Hai at his house, and they are on their way to bring him here.
However, they couldn't find Zhang He and Chen Xin.
As for Qing Yi and Zhang Lin, they live with Zhang Fei in the village, as well as Zhang Yue, who just returned to the country today."
"Hmm?" After he heard that, Qin Feng frowned.
"Are you guys really unable to find Zhang He and Chen Xin?"
Lu Xin shook her head and informed him again.
"Based on their investigation, Zhang He and Chen Xin were last seen two days ago, and they were together with Chen Hong and Fu Min, but they are nowhere to be found now.
Even Zhang Hai himself seemed frustrated because he couldn't find his first son and daughter-in-law, even though he had asked those close to him to help look for them."
"That's weird." Qin Feng muttered to himself while raising his eyebrows.
"How long until they get here?"
"Ten minutes."
"I see." Qin Feng nodded in understanding before giving Lu Xin an order.
"Prepare another helicopter to take Zhang Hai away to that village once they get here, and I will use him to force Zhang Fei to surrender to us, or else I will kill his father before his eyes."
Unfortunately, they still didn't know that those four people had already died in Zhang Fei's hands, and he also no longer cared about Zhang Hai, so their efforts would only end in vain.

Lu Xin chose not to comment on the matter and took her phone before leaving the room, but her expression showed that she couldn't calm down, and she had a bad feeling about the matter. 'Sigh, I hope my guess is wrong, or we'll be the ones suffering from General Qin's stubbornness.'
*Crack*
"Hmm?
Why did you come here, Xixuan?
Didn't I tell you to wait for me at home?"
Yu Xixuan let out a heavy sigh and sat in front of her husband.
"Are you really going to do that to Zhang Hai?
I've tried to calm myself down, but I'm still afraid of Zhang Fei, and I'm afraid that if you really do that, he will do something to us."
"I told you that you don't need to worry about that damn brat, and I'll take care of him myself." Yu Xixuan wanted to interrupt him, but Qin Feng stopped her immediately.
"I've contacted the people from the azure dragon squad, and they are well-trained special forces, so I'm sure that they can get rid of him; only then can we calm down again."

After listening to her husband's response, Yu Xixuan massaged her forehead, feeling confused about stopping Qin Feng, particularly because he was too stubborn and his anger over Zhang Fei's actions toward their son had blinded him, making it impossible for him to see the situation rationally.
"Where is Zun'er now?
Is he resting at home?"
Qin Feng's question actually made Yu Xixuan even more dizzy, especially since he spoiled their son too much, making him so spoiled and arrogant.
"Do you believe he will rest with his character like that?
As soon as he returned home, he took his other bogyguards with him, and he must be having fun with those cheap women now."
"Just let him have fun with them for now, and I'm sure that he will change after he gets married." Qin Feng casually responded to his wife before walking out of his office.
"Anyway, I'll get ready now, but you don't need to come with us; you just need to wait quietly for me to come home."
After Qin Feng left, Yu Xixuan supported her dizzy head with her hands on the table, and her feelings became increasingly restless because of her husband's departure.
"Zhang Fei was obviously not joking with his words before, and he could even make the cars explode for no reason.
However, my husband still insisted on fighting him, and I couldn't do anything to stop him, so I hope he will be fine."

[Status: Done]
[Reward: 1,300 Red Jewels Sent To Inventory]

Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction after he saw that Yang Lu'er and the other four women were exhausted, and he had already gotten quite a lot of female essence from them. 'Mei, I should have 6,000 female essences by now, so I want you to buy that demon mimicry ability.
Besides, don't forget to delete their names from my partner list; I don't want women like them to become members of my harem.'
[Hehe, I deleted their names a long time ago, Master.
I'll buy the ability now, so you can use it right away.]
{You got Demon Mimicry Ability x1}
{5000 female essence has been deducted from your balance}
After Mei purchased the technique, Zhang Fei smiled with joy, and he immediately read the description of his new ability.
[Demon mimicry: The users can mimic the abilities of other demons, but they can only mimic one ability from each demon.]
'One ability from each demon, huh?
That's not so bad, and I'll try it with Jannette later.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he got dressed, and he then went to the second floor to check on Tang Ziyu.

However, he found that she was still sleeping soundly, so he left a note with his phone number, and he kissed her lips before leaving the penthouse to meet Zhong Yan to pick up the items for their shop in Sky Jade Realm.
Before long, Zhang Fei had arrived at Zhong Yan's house, but she greeted his arrival with a gloomy look.
"Why are you like this?"

"Did you just come back from having fun with Yang Lu'er?" Zhong Yan asked back with a deadpan look, but Zhang Fei could hear the jealousy in her tone, so he sat beside her and told her the truth, which surprised her, especially after she heard the name Tang Ziyu.
"Sigh.
Even a famous actress like her has to face such problems; does that mean you want to take her into your harem?"
"The decision depends on Ziyu herself." Zhang Fei answered while leaning back in the chair.
"If she is willing to leave her husband and career, I might accept her as my harem."
Zhong Yan raised an eyebrow in confusion at Zhang Fei's answer.
"Why do you want her to leave her career?
After all, she has built her career for decades, so I'm sure that it won't be easy for her to leave the world of entertainment that made her name."
"You may consider me selfish, but I do not want other men to touch any of my women, even if it's just for work."
"You're too possessive, you know?" Zhong Yan then leaned against his chest, and Zhang Fei hugged her while caressing her arm.
"However, I agree with you; all the women in your harem should not have contact with other men, or else you will do something unnatural to them, especially since you are an incubus.
Even so, Ziyu doesn't need to leave the world of entertainment, and she can choose roles that don't require intimate scenes, right?"
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then asked him back.
"What about Guo Lan?
Is she willing to accept your offer?"
Zhong Yan nodded to him.
"At first, Guo Lan was shocked when I told her that I wanted to transfer her to another place, and she was even more shocked after I told her that she would be the leader of your shop later.
However, she finally agreed after I explained everything to her, but I haven't told her that the shop is yours, and I want you to tell her that yourself."
"Guo Lan must still be disappointed in me now, so I'll wait until she's calmer before meeting her again, or else she'll refuse the job."
"That's good; I think that is the best way for both of you." Zhong Yan then looked up at him.
"So, what's the name of your shop?"
[You gained 350 Yin Qi from Luo Yu.]
[You gained 500 Beast Essence from Luo Yu.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei was surprised by the appearance of the two notifications. 'That silkworm girl is quite strong when it comes to sex, and she didn't even stop dual-cultivating with my clone.' "Anyway, we will use the name Sky Jade Shop for my shop, especially since we will only sell goods from the Sky Jade Realm.
Have you taken care of the patents for those products?"

"I've submitted the list of items to the patent registration list, and I've also contacted Huang Rong to take care of everything, so we just have to wait for news from her later." Zhong Yan then stood up, pulled Zhang Fei, and guided him to the garage, where all their items for sale were located.
"The sales of our shop in the Sky Jade Realm were really successful, and the people there were very interested in goods from this world, so I deliberately bought them in much larger quantities.
After all, we only returned to that realm after three to four days, or else our shop will run out of goods to sell."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and stored all the items in his inventory, especially since there were too many, and Zhong Yan's storage ring wouldn't fit them.
"Now that everything is in order, we can head back to my grandmother's house, and once they gather there, we will return to the Sky Jade Realm."
"Let's go then."

Zhang Fei then hugged Zhong Yan's waist and took her away using his teleportation, especially since it was still much faster compared to their current flying speed, and they finally arrived there after he used his ability several times.
"Big Brother!" As usual, Xu Ling'er screamed, rushed to embrace Zhang Fei, kissed him briefly, and then asked, "Are we going to the Sky Jade Realm now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then looked at the others, but he couldn't find Zhang Yue and Janette among them.
Zhang Chen told him that the two of them were going to the city to report to their branch office, so he had to wait for them to come back before leaving.
However, they suddenly heard the sound of many cars and helicopters moving towards the house, and Zhang Fei immediately checked his map to confirm the identities of those people.

Qin Feng is such an idiot, huh?
I already warned him not to find trouble with me, but he still insisted on it, and he even brought more people to confront me."

Zhang Fei naturally understood her grandmother's feelings, so she hugged Zhang Chen while saying it to him.

"Grandma, I warned and spared them before, but they themselves chose to find trouble with us again, so I won't give them a second chance, and I will give them a punishment they will never be able to imagine."
"But, Fei'er-"
"I'm sorry, but I won't change my decision about them, Grandma." Zhang Fei then looked at Qing Yi before continuing.
"Anyway, they also brought Zhang Hai with them, and they seemed to be thinking of using him to force me to surrender to them."
"What?" Zhang Chen and Qing Yi exclaimed in shock after hearing that.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Disclosure And Punishment
paragraphs: Once they arrived outside, Zhang Fei immediately shared Yi Xixuan and Qin Zhu's location with Ye Lian and asked her to forcefully bring them to him, especially since her cultivation was higher than the Chu Sisters as was her speed.
Even though she didn't understand Zhang Fei's plans for them, Ye Lian still followed his request, and she immediately disappeared from their sight to pick them up.

A helicopter and several army cars arrived not far from Zhang Chen's house shortly after she left. Qin Feng disembarked first, followed by Lu Xin, who firmly held Zhang Hai, his face covered in numerous wounds and bruises from their beating.
In addition, tens of men, dressed in military uniforms, disembarked from the cars. These individuals belonged to the Azure Dragon Squad, the most formidable special force in their country.
Even so, Zhang Fei appeared to be indifferent to Zhang Hai's condition, but his murderous gaze never left Qin Feng, and an evil smile appeared on his face.

Meanwhile, Zhang Hai continued to look at Zhang Fei with an expression full of hatred, especially since Qin Feng had told him that what he had suffered was the result of his second son's actions. "Bastard! You are truly an ungrateful son! You are the one who made me suffer like this!"

"An ungrateful son?" Zhang Fei grinned slightly when he heard that. "Ever since you expelled and abandoned me two years ago, I no longer recognize you as my father. Unfortunately, that idiot old man is unaware of this, and his attempts to use you to force me to surrender are futile; I don't care if he ends up killing you."
Zhang Hai was certainly not surprised by Zhang Fei's words, but Qin Feng and the others were truly shocked after hearing that, especially since he was so indifferent to his father.

Zhang Fei suddenly had another idea and asked his mother to come out to meet Zhang Hai, but Qing Yi felt reluctant to fulfill his request, especially since he was still her husband. That's why he brought her out with a little force, and he hugged her intimately from behind, causing her face to turn red from extreme embarrassment. "Hey!

Let me tell you one thing you might not know: I've killed Zhang He and Chen Xin. Besides that, I also killed Chen Hong and Fu Min, and I've burned their corpses to ashes, so you don't need to look for them again."

Not only was Zhang Hai shocked by Zhang Fei's confession, but Qing Yi was also shocked to hear it, and she didn't expect that he would tell his father about it. 'Sigh! Fei'er shouldn't have to inform him about their deaths; it would leave him completely devastated.

After hearing his words, Qin Feng and Lu Xin exchanged glances, and they finally realized the reason behind the two people's disappearance, but they felt fearful towards him, especially since he had the heart to kill his own big brother and sister-in-law.

"You... you..." Zhang Hai stuttered while pointing at Zhang Fei, but Qing Yi's expression made him certain that his first son and daughter-in-law had really died at the hands of his second son, causing his face to become pale and tears to flow freely from his old eyes. "Why... why did you kill them?"

"What else?" Zhang Fei asked back with an indifferent shrug. "I already warned him not to look for trouble with me, or I'll kill him, but he was too idiotic like you, and he asked for Chen Hong's help to kidnap one of the people who meant a lot to me just for the sake of his ambition to kill me.
Unfortunately, he doesn't know that I'm not who I used to be, and I will not hesitate to kill anyone who threatens my safety or the people closest to me, so I killed them all without regret."

Zhang Hai fell to the ground as soon as Lu Xin let go of him, and he continued to let out heart-rending cries after learning the truth, but his eyes had become a little dull because the shock he received was too much. However, Zhang Fei's next action made him even more devastated, especially since he kissed Qing Yi's lips, which she also responded to with passion.

On the other hand, Qing Feng and Lu Xin's eyes widened watching their hot kiss, especially since they were mother and son, but they were involved in a taboo relationship. 'What the hell with this guy? Not only did he kill his brother and sister-in-law, but he also had a crazy relationship with his own mother.'

'Sigh, I was aware that Zhang Fei was a madman, but their relationship was completely beyond my imagination.' As she turned her face to the side, Lu Xin inwardly muttered, as if she didn't want to witness them.

Zhang Chen, who watched Zhang Fei's actions from the door of her house, could only sigh heavily while rubbing her own chest. She felt sorry for Zhang Hai, especially since he was her biological son, but she didn't have the ability to reverse the situation. 'Hai'er, I've warned you many times, but you were never willing to listen to me, and it's too late for you to regret everything.
After all, Fei'r is no longer an ordinary human, but he has become a demon as a result of your decisions in the past, and his character is becoming more and more evil as a true demon.'

Understanding her grandmother's feelings, Zhang Lin hugged Zhang Chen and lightly patted her back. Even though Zhang Hai was her father, she did not feel the slightest pity for him, mainly because he had treated Zhang Yue and Zhang Fei unfairly.

The Chu Sisters, who supported Zhang Fei, were unfazed by their circumstances, particularly because they had encountered more challenging situations. Moreover, they didn't know Zhang Hai at all, even though he was their father-in-law, and they fully supported their husband's decisions.

After they stopped their kiss, Zhang Fei asked his mother to go back into the house, but Qing Yi looked at her husband for a while before following her son's request, and he then pointed to Qin Feng. "My business with him is finished, and I don't care what you guys will do to him.
However, I have warned you not to come here to bother me again, but you are much more arrogant than him because of your rank and authority."
"You-"

Before Qin Feng could curse at him, Zhang Fei had already demonstrated a bit of his power by lifting the helicopter and all the cars into the air, making him and the others look up with expressions of complete shock. Unlike before, he immediately clenched his fists, squeezing them into one like a piece of scrap metal before hurling it aside.
*Bam*

Instantly, Qin Feng fell backwards on his buttocks with his face ashen, and his body trembled quite violently while wetting his pants. Even dozens of special soldiers were also frightened by Zhang Fei's show of power just now, and they immediately tried to escape from that place.
Lu Xin stood motionless in his position, her face pale and her entire body drenched in cold sweat due to the intense fear engulfing her heart.

However, Zhang Fei suddenly summoned Boitata, who immediately returned to her original form and blocked their escape path, making them all even more frightened after seeing so many eyes all over her body. "Master, why did you summon me just to deal with these ants? Moreover, they are just ordinary humans who don't have qi, so their meat isn't delicious, and I'll get a stomach ache if I eat them."

"Pfft! Ha ha ha." After hearing that, Chu Qing laughed out loud while holding her stomach. Chu Ying was also the same as her little sister, and she was amused by Boitata's words just now. "Fei just wanted to scare them by summoning you out, so you don't have to eat them."
Boitata nodded in understanding, looking at the people one by one with her fiery eyes. "I feel sorry for you guys, and since you annoyed an evil demon, your fate has already been sealed."

"Have you realized your mistake, Old Man?" As he transformed into Incubus, Zhang Fei inquired, causing several of them to instantly fall unconscious, including Lu Xin. As for Qin Feng, he prevented him from fainting, especially since he still had other plans for him. "All of you are ordinary humans, so I previously gave you a chance and spared your lives, but you guys have wasted my kindness.
Since you guys still dare to come here again, I won't give you a second chance, but I won't kill anyone among you. Even so, you will have to face an unusual punishment, and you will find out soon."
As soon as Ye Lian landed in front of them, Qin Feng's eyes widened, particularly when he saw his wife and son in her arms, whom she immediately threw to his side.

"Husband!" Yu Xixuan shouted while hugging her husband, and she felt frightened seeing Boitata's figure and Zhang Fei's demon form, but she was strong enough not to faint. "I told you to stop looking for trouble with him, but you weren't willing to listen to me!"

Meanwhile, Qin Zhu sat dumbfounded on the ground, but his expression was like someone who had lost his soul because he was too cowardly, and all the sights around him dealt a heavy blow to his mental state.

Zhang Fei glanced at Qin Zhu with disdain before speaking to them again. "Everyone has gathered now, so it's time for me to punish you all, and I'm sure that you will definitely enjoy your punishment."

Suddenly, Zhang Chen ran towards them and hugged Zhang Fei's arm tightly. "What will you do with them, Fei'er? I hope you won't stain your hands with their blood, and I beg you to let go of your father, especially since his condition is so bad now."

"Grandma, you don't need to worry about your son, and I have no plans to kill him." Zhang Chen let out a sigh of relief after hearing Zhang Fei's answer, and she immediately called someone to go to her house, especially since she wanted to take Zhang Hai to the hospital.
"As for these people, I originally wanted to kill them, but I had other ideas for them, and they would live more miserable than death."
Before Zhang Chen could ask him, Zhang Fei had already asked Mei to open the gate to the Netherworld Realm, and a black gate appeared in front of them.

Zhang Fei immediately frowned because he couldn't feel Qi's presence in that realm. Instead, he felt a scent similar to his, which was a demon scent, and it piqued his interest in going there. However, he abandoned his intention, and he enveloped everyone with his aura while speaking to them. "You guys can enjoy your new life in the demon realm, and I hope you won't die too soon."
"No! All of them screamed hysterically after hearing that, but Zhang Fei didn't care about their screams and threw them into the gate, and Mei immediately closed it.

However, he abandoned his intention, and he enveloped everyone with his aura while speaking to them.
"You guys can enjoy your new life in the demon realm, and I hope you won't die too soon."
"No!
All of them screamed hysterically after hearing that, but Zhang Fei didn't care about their screams and threw them into the gate, and Mei immediately closed it.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Tree Control
paragraphs: Two cars arrived at the house, and one of them was Hong Yao. The other one was a female doctor who was contacted by Zhang Chen, and she came along with two nurses. They were shocked to see Zhang Hai's condition, which was like a living corpse, with his eyes not shining at all. 'What happened to him?
Could it be that he already knows about his wife and son's illicit relationship?' "Ji Yunyi, it seems like your task is really difficult, and you will have a hard time recovering him."

Ji Yunyi nodded in agreement with that. "I don't know what happened to him, but his condition is really bad, and he probably won't be able to recover to normal. Even if he has a chance to recover, it will definitely take a very long time."

When he heard that, Zhang Chen immediately spoke to her. "You can take my son to your mental hospital, Yunyi, and I hope you can take good care of him. As for all his needs, you can contact Hanzhi, and she will take care of everything."

"Aunt Chen, you don't need to worry about him; I will assign the best people to take care of him." Ji Yunyi then turned to the two nurses to put Zhang Hai into their car. "In that case, I will take him away right away, and I will also communicate this matter with Zhang Hanzhi."
After they left, Hong Yao pulled Zhang Fei into his room and asked him. "Did you do anything to my little brother? He hasn't come home since two days ago, and I can't contact him either."

"I killed Hong Ming." Hong Yao instantly froze after hearing his cold reply, but Zhang Fei immediately told her the reason behind his decision. "I will never spare anyone who has evil intentions for those closest to me, and he will make other plans against Guo Lan if I let him live. As for you, I will leave the decision in your hands, but you certainly know which one is best for you, right?"

After hearing that, Hong Yao shivered in the cold, and she felt that Zhang Fei had changed quite a bit compared to the last time they met. The current himappears increasingly icy, resembling a true demon.

"Anyway, I want you to contact Huang Rong, and I want you to coordinate with each other." Hong Yao looked at Zhang Fei in confusion. "I sent Qin Feng, Qin Zhu, Lu Xin, and Yu Xixuan to the demon realm. Besides, I also sent all the members of the Azure Dragon Squad there, and their disappearance would bring panic to the government."

Hong Yao took a deep breath, speechless, especially since Zhang Fei's number of victims was too many this time. Even though she didn't know anything about the demon realm, she believed that it wasn't a friendly place, and it was definitely much worse than Earth, which would make those people suffer. "What will happen to them?"

Her question actually made Zhang Fei stunned, especially since he himself didn't know what would happen to Qin Feng and the others in the Netherworld Realm. But Mei explained it to him straight away, and he then gave Hong Yao the same answer. "If they don't die, they will gradually become demons like me.
Unfortunately, I don't know anything about that demon realm or the demons that inhabit it, but they seem to be much more powerful than me, so they probably wouldn't be able to survive there."

After hearing that, Hong Yao massaged her forehead, especially since Zhang Fei seemed unconcerned with the fate of those people. "This matter is too big, so I have to go back now to take care of everything. However, I need Huang Rong's help to do that, so I will contact her on the way."

"All right." Zhang Fei himself had no intention of stopping Hong Yao, especially since he wanted to go to the Sky Jade Realm again, but he still had to wait for the other two women, so he lay on his bed while thinking about his next plans. "I will stay there three to four days before coming back, and I will ask Janette to take me to Diyu Realm directly tomorrow."
[Master, why don't you go to Netherworld Realm directly, compared to Diyu Realm?]
"I want to go to the Netherworld Realm, but I'm still too weak, so I don't want to waste my life in vain because many people will be sad if I die."
[In that case, you should try to increase your demon rank even faster, Master.]

Zhang Fei naturally wanted that, but human women could only give him 100 female essences. That's why he decided to go to Diyu Realm to look for female demons, especially since a demon at viscount rank like Janette could give him 500 female essences, so he wanted to look for those with a higher rank than her.

Suddenly, Zhang Yue entered his room, followed by Janette, and she immediately sat on the side of the bed while talking to Zhang Fei. "Lin already told me about our father, but I didn't expect that you would show him your relationship, which made him go crazy."
"Are you going to blame me, Big Sis?"

"No." Zhang Yue answered by shaking her head. "He treated you badly, and they have warned him repeatedly, but he is too stubborn and unwilling to change. Even though I'm sad about his condition, he's at least still alive now, and it's much better than having him die in your hands like Zhang He."
"Thank you, Big Sis." Zhang Fei then sat by Zhang Yue's side, pulling Janette onto her lap, and kissed her lips in front of her big sister, whose expression turned jealous seeing her like that.
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the tree control of a Dryad named Janette.]
After the notification appeared in his mind, Zhang Fei immediately stopped their kiss and read the description of the tree control ability.
[Tree control: The user can control plants for attack, defense, and protection. Besides, users can also accelerate plant growth.]
Janette, who was confused by Zhang Fei, asked him. "Why did you suddenly stop? Is it because Yue is beside us?"

"No." Zhang Fei then lowered Janette from his lap before pulling them to the side of his bedroom window, and he stretched his arms forward before using the Tree Control, which made the plants around their house grow rapidly, some of them even dancing.
Janette was shocked after seeing that, especially since only a Dryad like her could do that, but Zhang Fei was able to do it. "How... how can you do such a thing?"
"What actually happened, Fei? How did you make those plants like that?" Zhang Yue inquired curiously, but she appeared excited to see them dancing.

"I mimicked your ability, and I gained your ability to control plants." Unlike Zhang Yue, who continued to look at the dancing plants with excitement, Janette looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, as she had never heard of a demon being able to imitate another demon's abilities. "You don't need to be confused by that, especially since I'm different from other demons."

"What an absurd demon!" Janette expressed this while shaking her head. "As an incubus, my charm ability, as well as my shapeshifting and life absorption abilities, are useless to you." Moreover, you are also a cultivator, and you might want to learn alchemy in the future, so I wouldn't be surprised if you chose my tree control ability."

Zhang Fei just smiled hearing that because he never thought about becoming an alchemist, mainly because he had the system and there were so many precious pills there. Unfortunately, he couldn't buy them yet because many of them were very expensive, and many of them required jewels of other colors besides red, so he could only be patient in buying them.
After that, Zhang Fei took the two women to meet the women who were waiting for them, and they went straight to the Sky Jade Realm as soon as Mei opened the gate to go there.

As usual, the two python-tailed tigresses immediately welcomed Zhang Fei's arrival by jumping at him before licking him excitedly, making the women laugh out loud seeing them like that. 'Sigh, beasts really can't be compared to ordinary animals on Earth, and they will definitely become as big as adult lions in the near future.'
Ye Lian directly spoke to him. "Fei, I'm going back to my clan now, or else my mother will worry about me. I hope you can visit my clan as soon as possible because she wants to meet you."
"Don't worry, I will go to your clan tomorrow to meet your mother." Zhang Fei then stood up and hugged Ye Lian before kissing her lips. "Anyway, how is your relationship with Gu Zhan?"
"I don't know whether Gu Zhan has returned to his clan or not, so I will ask my mother about this first, and I hope he has returned, or else our relationship will continue to drag on."

Zhang Fei immediately took Boitata and Jin Yuan out of his beast space, and he asked the snake beast to go with Ye Lian. "I want you to protect her when I am not by her side, and you can kill anyone who intends to harm her."
"I know, master." Boitata then coiled her body in Ye Lian's arms, and they left the Chu Clan.

Zhang Chen and Qing Yi also left the clan to head to their restaurant. Zhong Yan and Ru Xue decided to go to their shop to check their inventory. On the other hand, Zhang Lin, the Chu Sisters, Xu Ling'er, and Jin Yuan entered the qi gathering formation to cultivate, especially since they had been absent from cultivating for days.

Zhang Fei wanted to take Zhang Yue and Janette, who looked amazed at the residence, to another area. However, Liu Hua suddenly appeared in front of them, and she looked at the dryad with a look of hostility, especially since she could recognize her identity as a demon.

Zhang Fei could understand Liu Hua's feelings, so he pulled her into a hug and explained it to her. "Janette, while indeed a demon, does not originate from this realm; rather, she comes from a different realm that shares a connection with my home realm. Moreover, you can smell it yourself; there is no blood on her body, so you don't 'need to be hostile towards her."
"I see." Liu Hua then turned to Zhang Yue. "Is she Zhang Yue?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then introduced her to the two women. "Her name is Liu Hua, and she is one of my women."
Unlike Janette, who was indifferent to Liu Hua's appearance, Zhang Yue looked jealous of her, especially since she was much prettier and sexier than her, and her breasts were also bigger than hers.

Liu Hua smiled faintly as she noticed the jealousy in Zhang Yue's eyes, so she hugged his arm. "You don't need to be jealous of me, okay? After all, we are a family, and Fei won't treat us differently because of our physique."
"Huh?"

"Fei'er, someone left this necklace with me, but she should still be around here now." After she handed over the necklace that Hu Lili had entrusted to her, Liu Hua immediately took Zhang Yue away with her, wanting to get to know her better.

Meanwhile, Janette chose to join the other women in the formation because Liu Hua seemed hostile towards her, and Zhang Fei observed the necklace seriously. 'Mei, can you track the location of the owner of this necklace?'

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Meeting Hu Lili
paragraphs: After Mei informed him of Hua Lili's position, Zhang Fei immediately used his teleportation ability to go meet her. He found her sitting alone on the side of the river, dipping her feet into it, and the five white tails behind her kept dancing along with the wind's movements.

Zhang Fei also had a strange feeling towards Hu Lili, but it was different from the one he felt towards Hu Yue. Instead, it was a feeling of subduing her, which came from his Heavenly Fox bloodline, and his heavenly aura leaked from his body. 'Scan her status, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
[Status]
Name: Hu Lili
Gender: Female
Race: Moon Fox
Rank: Divine Beast
Cultivation: 1 Star Sovereign Realm
Element: Light
Core: Peak Rank Light Core
Physique: Fox Physique
Special Physique:
Special Bloodline:
Abilities: Healing Light, Mass Healing, Light Punishment, Light Prison
Strong: Light
Weak: Darkness
Partner: Hu Yinhu (dead)
Like: Hu Yue
Dislikes: Hu Gao, Hu Dong

Zhang Fei took a deep breath after reading Hu Lili's status; she was the strongest cultivator he had ever met, and Zhang Lingxue was no match for her either. Even so, he didn't seem worried about her, especially since Mei had already told him that Moon Fox was still below Heavenly Fox, so she would never be able to harm him.

"Since you were the Heavenly Fox, I expected that you would be able to find me. However, I didn't expect that your bloodline was so strong, and you managed to subdue that divine beast." Hu Lili fell into a daze as she turned her head back and looked at Zhang Fei, and her bloodline immediately urged her to submit to him, just like her daughter had experienced before.

Fortunately, she has lived for a long time, and she has strong self-control, so she can resist the urge. "No wonder my daughter fell in love with you the first time she saw you, and she's kept thinking about you since returning to our sub-space."

"I didn't anticipate that you were monitoring the Chu Clan from a distance, but your high cultivation prevented Liu Hua and the others from detecting your actions." Zhang Fei then walked towards Hu Lili while taking off his shoes, and he immediately sat beside her before asking her. "Does that mean the Moon Fox race lives in a separate space from the cultivators in the Central Region?"

"Yes." Hu Lili nodded to Zhang Fei. "The necklace I entrusted to Liu Hua is the key to entering our sub-space, so you have to keep it safe and use it to pick up my daughter. However, I don't recommend you go there anytime soon, especially since Hu Gao is stronger than me and his cultivation is at the Saint Realm.
Even though you can suppress him with your bloodline, it won't matter much to him, especially since the difference between your cultivations is too far, so you will die in vain if you go there now."

Zhang Fei himself was not a fool, and he was naturally aware of that. That's why he purposely sent his clone to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, so he could improve his cultivation faster by taking advantage of the women in the sect. He had also planned to go to Diyu Realm, and that place was the best choice for him to increase his demon rank so he could purchase stronger demon abilities.

As for his beast level, Zhang Fei didn't have too much trouble with it for now, especially after he bought the Essence Absorption Technique, so he and his clone could improve it at the same time. Unfortunately, he still had difficulty buying stronger beast abilities, mainly because he needed a lot of beast cores to buy them, so he had to be patient to be able to buy them.

"So what are your plans for now?" Zhang Fei, seeing her curious expression, told Hu Lili some of the plans he had devised or executed, and she listened to his explanation seriously while nodding repeatedly. "This is my first time meeting a Heavenly Fox directly, but there are many stories about it within my race and other fox races, so I'm not surprised by your plans.

After all, the Heavenly Fox is known for being cunning, arrogant, cruel, and self-centered. Moreover, the Yin-Yang Pavilion is a dual-cultivation sect and is filled with so many female cultivators, so I think it is indeed the most suitable place for you."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded with a soft sigh. "I promised Yue'er that I would pick her up in five years, so I don't have much time to relax, and I have to continue to strive hard to become strong. No matter what, I must fulfill my promise to her, and I will do whatever it takes to do so, including taking advantage of the female cultivators in the sect."

Hu Lili smiled after hearing Zhang Fei's words, and she felt that he loved and cared about her daughter so much. But she suddenly asked something he didn't expect. "Yue'er may not have noticed it, but I know that the pink mark you gave her was not a fox mark, and it was something else, right?"

"I didn't expect you to notice it." Zhang Fei said this with a bitter smile, especially since he had not told Hu Yue about his identity as an Incubus, mainly because he was worried that she would hate him. "Would you stop me from being with Yue'er if you knew the truth?"

"No." Hu Li replied by shaking her head. "Yue'er has lived for more than 500 years, and she has never fallen in love with any man before. However, she fell in love with you at first sight, so I know that those feelings came from the deepest part of her heart, and I wouldn't have the heart to hurt her feelings."

After pondering for a moment, Zhang Fei transformed into an incubus, shocking Hu Lili. Her involuntary release of killing intent caused him to tremble. After all, she was too strong for the current him, and he wasn't sure he could stop her if she wanted to attack him.
Even so, Zhang Fei did not blame Hu Lili for her killing intent, especially after Mei told him that Moon Fox was the nemesis of the demons, and it also came out without her knowing.

However, Hu Lili hurriedly retracted her intention to kill as she extended her hands and grasped Zhang Fei's horns, experiencing a strange sensation upon realizing the authenticity of both. "Yue'er once told me that you are a human, but you are also a full-fledged heavenly fox. However, you are also a demon, so I feel that your existence is an anomaly, but I am not sure about your future."

"My future, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he looked up at the sky. "Actually, I don't have lofty dreams about my future, and I just want to become as strong as possible to protect the people closest to me, so we can enjoy a peaceful and quiet life in the future."

"In fact, everyone has the same dream as you, including me." Hu Lili then sighed heavily and looked up at the sky. "Unfortunately, we are cultivators, and we live in a harsh and unpeaceful world, so it is not easy to make our dreams come true.

If you really want that, then you must become the strongest in the universe, and I fully believe you will succeed in realizing your dream because you are a Heavenly Fox, the highest of all fox races."

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at Hu Lili's words. "To become the strongest requires very persistent effort, and it is still far beyond my reach, especially since I haven't cultivated for long, and my cultivation is still in the foundation realm now.
That's why I don't want to think about that for now, so I will take everything step by step, and the most realistic target for me is to fulfill my promise to Yue'er."

"I'm glad that you keep thinking about your promise to Yue'er, and I fully hope that you can pick her up in five years." Hu Lili then stood up from her seat before speaking to Zhang Fei again. "I've been gone for a few days, so I have to go back now, or Hu Gao will get suspicious if I'm gone for too long."
"Wait." Zhang Fei immediately stopped Hu Lili by grabbing her hand, causing her to be a little uncomfortable, especially since no man had touched her for the past few centuries.

Hu Lili's heart skipped a beat as soon as Zhang Fei activated his Demon Charm, coupled with his Heavenly Fox aura, all of which made her flustered. 'Ugh! Was this how Yue'er felt when she first met him?' "Let go of my hand."

"No." Zhang Fei refused as he stood up and faced Hu Lili, then touched her cheek, causing her to tremble. "I don't know how to say it, and this is likely due to the influence of my heavenly fox bloodline. However, I am also interested in you, and I want to have you by my side."

After Zhang Fei said that, Hu Lili's eyes widened, but he didn't give her a chance to refuse by pulling her into his arms, and he immediately sealed his lips, shocking her. 'Ugh, why does he have to behave this way?'

Although Zhang Fei's Demon Charm had an impact on Hu Lili, it was not significant compared to her heavenly fox aura, especially since his bloodline was much stronger than hers. Eventually, she closed her eyes, kissed him back, and even inserted her tongue into his mouth, to which he responded with gentle sucking.
'Mhn~ I haven't kissed a man for too long, and I've forgotten that kissing is really fun.' Hu Lili wondered inwardly as she savored their kiss, her arms already wrapped around Zhang Fe's neck.

[Master, you already have several pairs of oyakodon by your side, but you still want to add another pair.] Even though she said that, Mei laughed in satisfaction with Zhang Fei's action, especially since Hu Lili was very strong and she would be really useful for him.

'Where did you learn such terms, Mei? Does your creator's world also know such a term?' Zhang Fei inquired as he pushed Hu Lili backwards, causing her to lean against the tree behind her. His hands began to squeeze her bouncy buttocks, deepening their kiss.
[Hehe. I don't know anything about my creator's world, but I learned that term from your memories, Master.]

Zhang Fei was speechless after hearing that, especially since Mei was a part of him now, so she could see through his thoughts easily. However, he immediately ignored that and focused on Hu Lili, moving his hands from her rear to her chest while squeezing her breasts.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's action actually brought Hu Lili back to her senses, and she immediately used a bit of her cultivation to push him away, causing him to stagger backwards.
"Lili, I-"
"No need." Hu Lili interrupted Zhang Fei by shaking her head. "You don't need to say anything, and you should focus on fulfilling your promise to Yue'er first."

After she said that, Hu Lili instantly vanished from his sight, causing Zhang Fei to release a heavy sigh. He immediately left the river, but he didn't immediately return to the Chu Clan, choosing to go somewhere else.

He found her sitting alone on the side of the river, dipping her feet into it, and the five white tails behind her kept dancing along with the wind's movements.
Zhang Fei also had a strange feeling towards Hu Lili, but it was different from the one he felt towards Hu Yue.
Instead, it was a feeling of subduing her, which came from his Heavenly Fox bloodline, and his heavenly aura leaked from his body. 'Scan her status, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
[Status]
Name: Hu Lili
Gender: Female
Race: Moon Fox
Rank: Divine Beast
Cultivation: 1 Star Sovereign Realm
Element: Light
Core: Peak Rank Light Core
Physique: Fox Physique
Special Physique:
Special Bloodline:
Abilities: Healing Light, Mass Healing, Light Punishment, Light Prison
Strong: Light
Weak: Darkness
Partner: Hu Yinhu (dead)
Like: Hu Yue
Dislikes: Hu Gao, Hu Dong
Zhang Fei took a deep breath after reading Hu Lili's status; she was the strongest cultivator he had ever met, and Zhang Lingxue was no match for her either.
Even so, he didn't seem worried about her, especially since Mei had already told him that Moon Fox was still below Heavenly Fox, so she would never be able to harm him.
"Since you were the Heavenly Fox, I expected that you would be able to find me.

However, I didn't expect that your bloodline was so strong, and you managed to subdue that divine beast." Hu Lili fell into a daze as she turned her head back and looked at Zhang Fei, and her bloodline immediately urged her to submit to him, just like her daughter had experienced before.
Fortunately, she has lived for a long time, and she has strong self-control, so she can resist the urge.
"No wonder my daughter fell in love with you the first time she saw you, and she's kept thinking about you since returning to our sub-space."

"I didn't anticipate that you were monitoring the Chu Clan from a distance, but your high cultivation prevented Liu Hua and the others from detecting your actions." Zhang Fei then walked towards Hu Lili while taking off his shoes, and he immediately sat beside her before asking her.
"Does that mean the Moon Fox race lives in a separate space from the cultivators in the Central Region?"
"Yes." Hu Lili nodded to Zhang Fei.
"The necklace I entrusted to Liu Hua is the key to entering our sub-space, so you have to keep it safe and use it to pick up my daughter.
However, I don't recommend you go there anytime soon, especially since Hu Gao is stronger than me and his cultivation is at the Saint Realm.
Even though you can suppress him with your bloodline, it won't matter much to him, especially since the difference between your cultivations is too far, so you will die in vain if you go there now."
Zhang Fei himself was not a fool, and he was naturally aware of that.
That's why he purposely sent his clone to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, so he could improve his cultivation faster by taking advantage of the women in the sect.
He had also planned to go to Diyu Realm, and that place was the best choice for him to increase his demon rank so he could purchase stronger demon abilities.
As for his beast level, Zhang Fei didn't have too much trouble with it for now, especially after he bought the Essence Absorption Technique, so he and his clone could improve it at the same time.
Unfortunately, he still had difficulty buying stronger beast abilities, mainly because he needed a lot of beast cores to buy them, so he had to be patient to be able to buy them.

"So what are your plans for now?" Zhang Fei, seeing her curious expression, told Hu Lili some of the plans he had devised or executed, and she listened to his explanation seriously while nodding repeatedly.
"This is my first time meeting a Heavenly Fox directly, but there are many stories about it within my race and other fox races, so I'm not surprised by your plans.
After all, the Heavenly Fox is known for being cunning, arrogant, cruel, and self-centered.
Moreover, the Yin-Yang Pavilion is a dual-cultivation sect and is filled with so many female cultivators, so I think it is indeed the most suitable place for you."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded with a soft sigh.
"I promised Yue'er that I would pick her up in five years, so I don't have much time to relax, and I have to continue to strive hard to become strong.
No matter what, I must fulfill my promise to her, and I will do whatever it takes to do so, including taking advantage of the female cultivators in the sect."
Hu Lili smiled after hearing Zhang Fei's words, and she felt that he loved and cared about her daughter so much.
But she suddenly asked something he didn't expect.
"Yue'er may not have noticed it, but I know that the pink mark you gave her was not a fox mark, and it was something else, right?"

"I didn't expect you to notice it." Zhang Fei said this with a bitter smile, especially since he had not told Hu Yue about his identity as an Incubus, mainly because he was worried that she would hate him.
"Would you stop me from being with Yue'er if you knew the truth?"
"No." Hu Li replied by shaking her head.
"Yue'er has lived for more than 500 years, and she has never fallen in love with any man before.
However, she fell in love with you at first sight, so I know that those feelings came from the deepest part of her heart, and I wouldn't have the heart to hurt her feelings."
After pondering for a moment, Zhang Fei transformed into an incubus, shocking Hu Lili.
Her involuntary release of killing intent caused him to tremble.
After all, she was too strong for the current him, and he wasn't sure he could stop her if she wanted to attack him.
Even so, Zhang Fei did not blame Hu Lili for her killing intent, especially after Mei told him that Moon Fox was the nemesis of the demons, and it also came out without her knowing.
However, Hu Lili hurriedly retracted her intention to kill as she extended her hands and grasped Zhang Fei's horns, experiencing a strange sensation upon realizing the authenticity of both.
"Yue'er once told me that you are a human, but you are also a full-fledged heavenly fox.
However, you are also a demon, so I feel that your existence is an anomaly, but I am not sure about your future."
"My future, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he looked up at the sky.
"Actually, I don't have lofty dreams about my future, and I just want to become as strong as possible to protect the people closest to me, so we can enjoy a peaceful and quiet life in the future."
"In fact, everyone has the same dream as you, including me." Hu Lili then sighed heavily and looked up at the sky.
"Unfortunately, we are cultivators, and we live in a harsh and unpeaceful world, so it is not easy to make our dreams come true.

If you really want that, then you must become the strongest in the universe, and I fully believe you will succeed in realizing your dream because you are a Heavenly Fox, the highest of all fox races."
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at Hu Lili's words.
"To become the strongest requires very persistent effort, and it is still far beyond my reach, especially since I haven't cultivated for long, and my cultivation is still in the foundation realm now.
That's why I don't want to think about that for now, so I will take everything step by step, and the most realistic target for me is to fulfill my promise to Yue'er."
"I'm glad that you keep thinking about your promise to Yue'er, and I fully hope that you can pick her up in five years." Hu Lili then stood up from her seat before speaking to Zhang Fei again.
"I've been gone for a few days, so I have to go back now, or Hu Gao will get suspicious if I'm gone for too long."
"Wait." Zhang Fei immediately stopped Hu Lili by grabbing her hand, causing her to be a little uncomfortable, especially since no man had touched her for the past few centuries.
Hu Lili's heart skipped a beat as soon as Zhang Fei activated his Demon Charm, coupled with his Heavenly Fox aura, all of which made her flustered. 'Ugh!
Was this how Yue'er felt when she first met him?' "Let go of my hand."
"No." Zhang Fei refused as he stood up and faced Hu Lili, then touched her cheek, causing her to tremble.
"I don't know how to say it, and this is likely due to the influence of my heavenly fox bloodline.
However, I am also interested in you, and I want to have you by my side."

After Zhang Fei said that, Hu Lili's eyes widened, but he didn't give her a chance to refuse by pulling her into his arms, and he immediately sealed his lips, shocking her. 'Ugh, why does he have to behave this way?'
Although Zhang Fei's Demon Charm had an impact on Hu Lili, it was not significant compared to her heavenly fox aura, especially since his bloodline was much stronger than hers.
Eventually, she closed her eyes, kissed him back, and even inserted her tongue into his mouth, to which he responded with gentle sucking.
'Mhn~ I haven't kissed a man for too long, and I've forgotten that kissing is really fun.' Hu Lili wondered inwardly as she savored their kiss, her arms already wrapped around Zhang Fe's neck.

[Master, you already have several pairs of oyakodon by your side, but you still want to add another pair.] Even though she said that, Mei laughed in satisfaction with Zhang Fei's action, especially since Hu Lili was very strong and she would be really useful for him.
'Where did you learn such terms, Mei?
Does your creator's world also know such a term?' Zhang Fei inquired as he pushed Hu Lili backwards, causing her to lean against the tree behind her.
His hands began to squeeze her bouncy buttocks, deepening their kiss.
[Hehe.
I don't know anything about my creator's world, but I learned that term from your memories, Master.]
Zhang Fei was speechless after hearing that, especially since Mei was a part of him now, so she could see through his thoughts easily.
However, he immediately ignored that and focused on Hu Lili, moving his hands from her rear to her chest while squeezing her breasts.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's action actually brought Hu Lili back to her senses, and she immediately used a bit of her cultivation to push him away, causing him to stagger backwards.
"Lili, I-"
"No need." Hu Lili interrupted Zhang Fei by shaking her head.
"You don't need to say anything, and you should focus on fulfilling your promise to Yue'er first."
After she said that, Hu Lili instantly vanished from his sight, causing Zhang Fei to release a heavy sigh.
He immediately left the river, but he didn't immediately return to the Chu Clan, choosing to go somewhere else.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Visit Zhao Ziqin
paragraphs: Currently, Ye Lian was sitting in front of a middle-aged woman named Yan Huan'er, who was none other than her mother. However, she was more curious about Boitata, who was coiled casually in his daughter's arms, and she certainly recognized her rank. "Where did you get that divine beast, Lin'er?"
"Haha." Ye Lian laughed softly while rubbing the snake's head. "Her name is Boitata, and she is Zhang Fei's contract beast."

"Oh?" Yan Huan'er was shocked to learn this. "As I recall, you and your little brother told me a few days ago that Zhang Fei's cultivation was still in the body realm. So how was he able to subdue this divine beast?"

Ye Lian was not surprised by her mother's question, especially since no cultivator at that level would be able to fight against a divine beast, let alone make a contract with it. "Mother, as I said before, Zhang Fei went to Blazing Volcano with the others and met Boitata there.
Furthermore, you've personally heard that he freed Aunt Hua from Pang Hong's control, enabling her to reunite with her family, so there's no reason to question his abilities, right?"

"Why do I feel that you are deliberately keeping everything about Zhang Fei a secret from me?" Ye Lian responded to her mother's question by sticking out her tongue, causing Yan Huan'er to sigh softly.

"Honestly, I still find it hard to believe that he could free Liu Hua with his low cultivation, especially since Pang Hong was powerful and no other cultivator had ever managed to free people who had fallen under his control. Moreover, this divine beast is much stronger than him, and she is stronger than me and your father, so I'm really curious how he was able to subdue her."

"Mother, I don't have the right to reveal Zhang Fei's secrets to anyone, including you, so you can ask him directly when he comes here tomorrow." Ye Lian paused for a few moments before reminding Yan Huan'er. "Anyway, you have to be careful when you meet him, lest you be charmed by his charm, and my father will suffer if you fall for him."

Yan Huan'er looked at her daughter dumbfoundedly, as she didn't expect that Ye Lian would say such a thing to her, but she immediately shook her head. "I don't understand how you could fall for Zhang Fei, especially since I haven't met him in person.
However, I am different from you, and your father is the right man for me, so I will never fall for another man, let alone the young man who has captivated my daughter."
"Haha." Ye Lian laughed while listening to her mother. "Gezz! I was just joking with you, mother. I know that you will never turn your back on my father, so you don't need to be so serious."
"So what do you plan to do with your relationship with Gu Zhan? Are you sure about canceling your engagement with him?"
"Yes." Ye Lian responded with a determined nod. "Gu Zhan has many intimate relationships with my sect sisters, but I know that he only uses them for fun, so I don't want to have a husband like him."

Yan Huan'er, who had frequently heard about Gu Zhan's affair, was unsurprised by her daughter's decision and decided to support it. However, she later questioned Ye Lian again. "Doesn't Zhang Fei also have several wives? Chu Ying and Chu Qing are already married to him; not to mention, Liu Hua is also married to him, right? So what's the difference between him and Gu Zhan?"

"You're not wrong about that, Mother." Ye Lian answered with a nod. "In fact, Zhang Fei now has several women, including the three of them. However, he is different from Gu Zhan in that he doesn't play with or deceive their feelings, and he is very serious about his relationship with them.

Moreover, I've spent several days with them, so I know that he treats them equally and fairly, which makes me confident in accepting him as my husband." (A/N: She said a few days because Yan Huan'er didn't know about Zhang Fei coming from Earth, and three days had already passed since she went with him there.)

Yan Huan'er fell silent as she looked at her daughter's face, believing that Ye Lian had completely fallen for Zhang Fei. Moreover, she could also feel a man's yang qi inside her body, which means they had been intimate before, even though she was still a virgin until now.

"I heard that Gu Zhan had returned yesterday, and your father had also agreed with your decision to cancel your engagement with him. That's why I thought it would be better if we went to the Gu Clan today and discussed this matter with Xing Mei, so your relationship with him doesn't drag on, and you can be with the man of your choice."
Ye Lian's expression turned excited after she heard that. "Anyway, don't we have to wait for my father and Uncle Gu Tong to return from the Demon Cave in the northern region?"

"No need." Yan Huan'er responded by shaking her head. "I don't know when they will return from the Demon Cave, especially since they must strengthen the seal that seals the demon portal, or else the demons from other realms will invade our realm again, like in the past.
Moreover, your father has already told me that he will talk to Gu Tong about this matter, and he asked me to talk to Xing Mei, so we will go to the Gu Clan now."

Hearing that, Ye Lian immediately rose from her seat and walked behind Yan Huan'er, hugging her mother from behind. "Mother, I am incredibly grateful to have parents like you two. Both of you always understand and support me, even though sometimes my decisions are not in line with your hopes."

"You are our daughter, and we naturally have to think about your feelings, and we always hope that you will be happy." Yan Huan'er then stood up and faced her daughter. "Moreover, we know you are not a careless person, and you always consider everything seriously before you make a decision, so we will always support your decision.

Unfortunately, your little brother's mindset is still childish, so he never thinks seriously, and he always makes a fuss wherever he goes. Anyway, he still seems angry with Zhang Fei, especially after he beat him up at their first meeting."

"Haha." Ye Lian burst into laughter, recalling the look on Ye Huang's face after Zhang Fei had beaten him up. "Mother, I think I can do something about my little brother, but I will need Fei'er's help for that."
"What do you plan to do for Hang'er?" Yan Huan'er inquired, raising her eyebrows slightly.

Ye Lian just smiled and pulled her mother away with her. "You don't need to worry about him, Mother. I'm sure that my little brother will change after Fei'er trains him, and he may change for the better in the future."

Zhang Fei immediately checked the situation within the Zhao Clan when he arrived, but he did not find Zhao Yun, and he was in another city with Ye Hang. Regarding Huan Ning, he discovered her still secluded in her room, displaying a persistent sense of unease about her circumstances.
However, Zhang Fei immediately ignored Huan Ning and looked for Zhao Ziqin, using his teleportation once he found her.

Before long, Zhang Fei had arrived at Zhao Ziqin's room, but she was painting his half-fox figure with a longing look, and there was a small two-tailed fox at the bottom. 'This girl has strong memories, huh? She's only seen my half-fox form once, including my fox form, but he can paint both in such detail.'

Zhang Fei then decided to change into his half-fox form before hugging Zhao Ziqin from behind, startling her, but her expression changed to joy once she turned back and saw him. She immediately stood up and faced Zhang Fei, hugging his neck while burying her face in his chest, but tears fell from her eyes. "Sob... Sob...
I've been waiting for you for four days, but you never came, and I thought you had forgotten me, Fei."
"I'm sorry, I've made you sad." Zhang Fei gently answered while hugging and rubbing Zhao Ziqing's back. "I've had a lot of business in the past few days, so I was only able to see you today."
"Sob... It's okay." Zhao Ziqin shook his head while speaking. "Sob... I'm glad you finally came to see me, so I'm not sad anymore, and I hope you can accompany me."

"Yeah, I'll accompany you today." Zhang Fei then carried Zhao Ziqing like a princess before laying her on the bed, and he lay beside her while continuing to hug her. "However, I still have a lot of other things to do, so I have to leave again tomorrow, but I will definitely come to see you again."
Hearing that, Zhao Ziqin looked up at Zhang Fei and wiped her tears. "Where are you going? Are you going to continue living in the forest?"

Zhang Fei inwardly laughed when he heard that, because Zhao Ziqin really thought that he was a wild fox. However, he didn't intend to tell her the truth yet, and he wanted to observe the situation in the Zhao Clan and Huan Ning's future plans first. "My house is in the forest, so I have to go back there."

"I see." Zhao Ziqin nodded in understanding before placing a short kiss on Zhang Fei's lips. "Honestly, I want to go with you to the forest, but my mother will be furious if she finds out about my relationship with you, and she will send people to chase and kill you."

'Your mother already tried to kill me twice, you know? Unfortunately, her efforts were in vain, and I have killed everyone she sent to kill me.' Zhang Fei muttered inwardly with a sneer. "It's okay; we don't need to rush, right? In the future, after I become stronger, I will take you away with me, and no one will be able to stop me, including your mother."
"En." After hearing that, Zhao Ziqin nodded with a smile and laid her head on Zhang Fei's chest. "Do you already have another woman, Fei?"
"Do you mind if I have another woman?"

"Not really." Zhao Ziqin shook his head slightly. "We are cultivators, and polygamous relationships are quite normal among us. Even my two grandfathers also had several wives, so I don't think too much about such a relationship. Moreover, I already considered you as my future husband after you did such things to me that night, so I will learn to accept it if you already have another woman."

'Compared to her evil mother, this girl is much kinder, and I don't find any dark side in her heart.' Zhang Fei then told Zhao Ziqin about the number of his women, but he didn't reveal their identities in detail, especially since Huan Ning didn't seem to like the Chu Clan.

"I didn't expect that you have so many women, Fei." Zhang Fei could hear the disappointment in Zhao Ziqin's voice, but he felt that it was natural for her to feel that way. "Do they know each other? Is their relationship very good?"

Zhang Fei nodded and answered her directly. "In fact, they live in the same place now, and their relationship is very good, so you don't need to worry about them because they will warmly accept you if you become my woman in the future."
"I hope so."
*Knock... Knock...*
Suddenly, someone knocked on Zhao Ziqin's door from outside. "Young miss, Madam Huan asked you to go see her now."

"In fact, they live in the same place now, and their relationship is very good, so you don't need to worry about them because they will warmly accept you if you become my woman in the future."
"I hope so."
*Knock...
Knock...*
Suddenly, someone knocked on Zhao Ziqin's door from outside.
"Young miss, Madam Huan asked you to go see her now."

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Trouble
paragraphs: "Are you sure that my mother won't recognize you?" Zhao Ziqin worriedly asked Zhang Fei, who was lying leisurely on her head in his little fox form.

'You don't need to worry about that because my cultivation is still too low, so she won't suspect that I can already turn into a human.' As he looked at the map, Zhang Fei answered her via telepathy, or else Huan Ning would be suspicious of him. 'Hmm? Huan Chong should be a member of the Huan Clan, and his cultivation was at the 3-Star Earth Realm.
The other man is Xuan Yu, and his cultivation is at the 10-Star Soul Realm, so I am not the opponent of the three of them.'
"All right." Before long, they had arrived at the main hall, and Zhao Ziqin immediately greeted Huan Chong. "Long time no see, Uncle."
"Ha ha." Huan Chong laughed while rubbing his long beard. "I haven't seen you in quite some time, but you've matured considerably and are now even more beautiful."

"Thank you, Uncle." Zhao Ziqin then sat down in the empty chair beside her mother, but she raised her eyebrows when she noticed Xuan Yu's lewd glance at her. 'Who is this man? Why did Uncle Chong bring him here?'
Suddenly, Huan Ning asked Zhao Ziqin in a suspicious tone. "Where did you get that fox? Why have I never seen it before?"

"Mother, this fox strayed into our clan a few days ago, and I really liked it, so I decided to keep it." Huan Ning actually became more suspicious after hearing that, but she didn't pay much attention to Zhang Fei, especially since his cultivation was still at the 5-Star Foundation Realm, and Zhao Ziqin spoke to her again.
"You've been shutting yourself in your room for the past few days, so I haven't had the chance to tell you about it."

"I see." Huan Ning nodded in understanding and informed her. "Your grandfather has already arranged your marriage with Xuan Yu, and you two will be getting married in a month, so he sent brother Chong here to introduce him to you."

"Eh?" Zhao Ziqin was shocked to hear her mother's words, especially since she didn't know anything about Xuan Yu, and they had never discussed the matter before. Moreover, she had already chosen Zhang Fei to be her husband, but she still couldn't reveal their relationship to her.

After hearing that, Zhang Fei also frowned, and he glanced at Xuan Yu with a sharp gaze. However, he chose to hold back first, especially since Huan Ning and Huan Chong could kill him easily, and Boitata was also not by his side. 'This bitch! It looks like the lesson I gave her a few days ago wasn't harsh enough, huh? In that case, I will teach you an even harsher lesson and make you despair.'

Seeing his shocked expression, Huan Chong immediately explained it to Zhao Ziqin. "Xuan Yu is a good man, and his seniors in his sect recognize his talents in cultivation and alchemy, so you will be happy to be his wife. Moreover, his grandfather is an old friend of your grandfather, so they want the two of you to get married to strengthen the relationship between the two clans."

'Not on earth, nor in the Sky Jade Realm, many women are always used to increase their family's status.' Zhang Fei muttered inwardly as he searched for a way to thwart their plan to marry Zhao Ziqin to Xuan Yu, especially since no one could help him except Boitata, who was currently with Ye Lian.
"But-"
"No buts." Huan Ning interrupted Zhao Ziqin directly. "Your grandfather's decision is final, so you can't refuse it, and you will marry Xuan Yu in a month."

After hearing that, Zhao Ziqin lowered her face and bit her lower lip, and her palms clenched into fists, but Zhang Fei immediately said something to calm her down. 'You have me, so you don't need to feel sad like this, and I will find a way to take you away from this clan.'

'Can you really take me away from this clan, Fei?' Zhao Ziqin asked expectantly, especially since she didn't want to be forced to marry a man she didn't know, but she was powerless to go against her grandfather's decision.

'One hundred percent!' Since he had no other solution, Zhang Fei thought of sending Zhao Ziqin to his portable mansion, and he intended to take her away to Earth. 'I have a place they will never be able to find, so you will be completely safe there, but I can't do that now, and we have to wait for the right time to leave.'
'All right, I believe in you, so you have to take me away from here as soon as possible.'

"Niece Ziqin, how about you take Xuan Yu for a walk in this city?" Zhao Ziqin looked at Huan Chong with a complicated look because she was not used to walking around the city, let alone having to go with a man, which made her feel uncomfortable.
"I know how you feel, but this is his first time coming to this region, especially since his Xuan Clan resided in the Central Region, so I hope you can accompany him."

'Central Region, huh?' Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, but he remembered that Zhang Lingxue and her Zhang Clan also lived in that region, so he immediately looked for her location on the map. 'Oh? What a coincidence! She's on her way back to this region.'

After that, Zhang Fei sent a voice transmission directly to Zhang Lingxue and asked her to speed up her journey, and she agreed to his request right away, especially since she herself couldn't wait to meet him.
"All right." Zhao Ziqin, compelled by his uncle's request, promptly guided Xuan Yu into the city, eliciting a smile of satisfaction from Huan Chong and Huan Ning upon their departure.

However, Zhang Fei cast a savage glance at Huan Chong and Huan Ning, then activated his demon pheromone. The pink gas that emanated from his body swiftly engulfed them, and they inhaled it without their knowledge. 'Heh! It's really convenient to be a lust demon! I can't fight you guys, but that doesn't mean I can't do anything to you two, and you can enjoy that!'

Quickly, both of them became horny due to the effects of Zhang Fei's pink gas, and a pink heart-shaped symbol appeared in their eyes. However, they were still experienced cultivators, and Huan Ning immediately fled to her room as soon as she felt something was wrong with herself.

As for Huan Chong, he tried to restrain himself from giving in to his lustful urges, but they became more and more intense, so he immediately disappeared from the Zhao Clan to look for a brothel in the city.

Zhao Ziqin, who was walking beside Xuan Yu, immediately slapped his hand away when he was about to hug her waist. "My grandfather wants us to get married, but I don't agree with that yet. Furthermore, I'm unfamiliar with you and not used to your presence, so I kindly request that you refrain from touching me for the time being.

'This little bitch! I'll definitely make you regret treating me this way!' Xuan Yu cursed in his heart, but he immediately put on a smiling face. "You don't need to apologize to me; I should be the one apologizing to you. So where are you taking me?"
"I don't know." Zhao Ziqin answered briefly while shaking her head.
"Are there any interesting places in this city?"
Once again, Zhao Ziqin shook her head at Xuan Yu because she really didn't know any interesting places in the city, especially since she rarely went out and spent most of her time in her clan.

Xuan Yu felt irritated by Zhao Ziqin's attitude, but he also didn't dare vent his frustration to her, so he could only grumble in his heart. 'Tch! What a useless woman! I don't understand why my grandfather insisted on marrying me to this woman! She is indeed pretty, but her cultivation is too low, and her character is also pathetic!'
'What a fool! Ziqin is mine, and you can dream of getting her.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he observed Xuan Yu with his bloody red eyes. 'Hmm? What should I do with this guy?'

[Hehe.] Mei suddenly laughed in Zhang Fei's mind, and she immediately presented her ideas. [Master, there is a pill in the shop that you can use on him, and its effect will make him lose his mind for a while, so he will definitely cause chaos in the city, but the price is a little expensive.

Another solution is that you can use your demon pheromone on him when the three of you are in a crowded place, and he will definitely act like a lustful beast, but you have to protect Zhao Ziqin, so she won't pounce on him. ]
Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment after hearing Mei's words. 'Somehow I feel that you are much more evil than me, but I like your ideas.'
[It's not me who's evil, but you, Master. After all, I'm integrated with your brain, so I give you ideas according to your evil character.]
Zhang Fei's lips twitched in her response. 'Anyway, what kind of pill is that? How much does it cost?'
[The pill is called Shenqi Pill, and it costs 100 green jewels.]

'100 green jewels, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered with a heavy sigh, especially since he didn't have too many green jewels, so he didn't want to use them to buy that pill. Instead, he wanted to buy another pill, which was very expensive. 'Sigh, I'll look at the situation first, and if the opportunity arises, I'll use my demon pheromone on him.'

Before long, they had arrived at the city, but Zhao Ziqin remained silent as she walked by Xuan Yu's side, and her expression looked uncomfortable being among so many people, but Zhang Fei kept talking to her to calm her down.

On the other hand, Xuan Yu felt increasingly frustrated because Zhao Ziqin only said a word or two when he engaged her in conversation, and he had never met a woman so indifferent to him before, mainly because his Xuan Clan was quite big in the Central Region, so there are many women who try to approach him to get his attention.
'Sigh, it would be better if I contacted my grandfather and asked him to speed up our marriage, and I'll put her aside after I pluck her virgin yin qi, so I don't have to feel frustrated like this.'
Meanwhile, Yan Huan'er and Ye Lian were already at the Gu Clan, and a middle-aged woman who was none other than Xing Mei greeted them warmly.
Gu Zhan, who was sitting next to his mother, kept staring at Ye Lian while occasionally licking his lips, making her feel disgusted by his behavior.

"Why did you two suddenly come here, Sister Huan'er?" Xing Mei inquired curiously, as they usually arrived after delivering the news first. However, their sudden appearance caught her attention, especially Ye Lian's unusual expression.

Before telling him, Yan Huan'er let out a soft sigh. "Sister Mei, I wanted to apologize to you before, but I came here to cancel Lian'er's engagement with Zhan'er. Moreover, my husband has also agreed to this matter, and he should have already spoken to Brother Tong, so you can confirm the matter to him."
"What!?" Gu Zhan shouted as he stood up from his seat. "Why did you suddenly decide like this, Aunt Huan'er?"
