chapters.title: Chapter 158: Gu Zhan's Death
paragraphs: Yan Huan'er sighed softly before turning to ask Gu Zhan. "Shouldn't you already know the reason, Zhan'er? You were Lian'er's fiancé, but you cheated on her by having a relationship with some of your sect sisters. Moreover, she has warned you repeatedly to stop your lascivious nature, but you always ignore her warnings, so it's natural that she wants to cancel her engagement with you, right?"

"Heh! Aren't you going to deny that?" Ye Lian shook her head, then pulled out a storage ring that held the items Gu Zhan had given her. "Since you prioritize your lust and enjoy your time with those women more, I decided to let you go because I don't want to have a treacherous husband."
*Swoosh*
Gu Zhan immediately caught the storage ring Ye Lian threw as he continued to glare fiercely at her, but he quickly released his cultivation and crushed it.
Seeing that, Xing Mei grabbed her son's hand and asked him to return the things Ye Lian had given him, and Gu Zha reluctantly complied with his mother's request.
Like her ex-fiancé, Ye Lian also destroyed the storage ring because she no longer wanted to keep her old memories with him, especially since she had already made a decision about her future.

"This way, our engagement is over, and we won't have any more relationships after this, so I hope you don't bother me again in the future, especially since I have already found the man who will be my husband in the future."

Yan Huan'er was shocked to hear her daughter's words, as she didn't expect Ye Lian to reveal her relationship with Zhang Fei. As expected, Xing Mei was shocked by her revelation, but Gu Zhan's anger boiled after hearing that, and his facial muscles bulged. "Tell me! You deliberately broke off our engagement because you slept with him, right? Who is that man?
I will definitely kill him because he stole you from me."

"So what?" Ye Lian replied with an indifferent shrug. "You can sleep with those women; then why can't I sleep with another man? Moreover, he is much better than you because he didn't lie or cheat on me, and he explained everything before I decided to accept him."
"You-"

"Do you think you can kill him? Have you forgotten the lesson he gave you when we hunted the fire flower in Blazing Volcano Mountain?" Ye Lian decided to interrupt her ex-fiancé, and Gu Zhan's body stiffened after hearing that. "That's right; my future husband is Zhang Fei, and you should remember the identities of the people by his side.
That's why you should forget about wanting to kill him; you will never be able to do it."

Gu Zhan's expression turned even uglier after remembering the events of that day, and his hands gripped the arms of the chair he was sitting on, especially since he remembered Liu Hua's presence by Zhang Fei's side.
Xing Mei, who had not said anything before, decided to ask Yan Huan'er. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei? Is he a member of the Zhang Clan in the Central Region?"
"No." Yan Huan'er shook her head at Xing Mei. "Honestly, I have never met Zhang Fei in person; he is not a member of that clan, and he comes from another region."
"Another region?" Xing Mei often traveled to various regions, but she had never heard of the existence of another Zhang Clan, so she felt confused about it.
Yan Huan'er responded with a nod before telling her again. "Moreover, he is a member of the Liu and Chu Clans now, mainly because he is married to Liu Hua, Chu Qing, and Chu Ying."

"What?" After listening to Yan Huan'er's answer, Gu Zhan was also as shocked as his mother, and Xing Mei asked her again. "Are you serious about that? I already knew about Liu Hua's return, but I never heard that he was married, let alone the marriage of those two little girls from the Chu Clan."

"They married Zhang Fei a few days ago, but they only had a traditional wedding." Xing Mei immediately turned to Ye Lian and looked at her in confusion. "Like I said before, I already knew about their relationship before I knew him, and he didn't hide everything from me either.
At first, I found it hard to accept his polygamous relationship, so I decided to spend a few days with him, and he is different from your son, who repeatedly lied and cheated on me."

Xing Meng couldn't help but sigh, especially since she always dreamed of Ye Lian as her daughter-in-law. But she was aware that her son had changed a lot since he became a core disciple in the Heavenly Sword Sect.

"Even though you are no longer Zhan'er's fiancée, our clans have been on good terms for a long time, and you are also like my own daughter, so I hope you will still come here to visit me in the future."
"That's for sure, Aunt Mei." Yan Huan'er then followed Ye Lian as she stood up. "Now that we have resolved everything, we will head back to our clan."

After that, they immediately walked out of the Gu Clan's main hall. However, Gu Zhan, whose heart was boiling with anger, suddenly mustered his Qi and took out his sword before moving to attack Ye Lian from behind.
"Zhan'er!" Xing Mei screamed in shock, as she was truly shocked to see her son attack Ye Lian from behind.
Ye Lian and her mother looked back at her after hearing her shout, but Gu Zhan's sword was already so close to her that she didn't have time to dodge it.
Fortunately, Boitata had already slid from Ye Lian's arms to attack Gu Zhan before his sword hit her body, and he immediately returned to his original form after blowing him away.
"Guah!" Gu Zhan was flown far away before his body slammed hard against the wall.
*Crumble... Crumble...*
Since Boitata's body continued to enlarge, the Gu clan's main hall instantly collapsed due to her size as soon as her body stood upright.

Xing Mei, who was shocked to see Boitata's appearance, immediately jumped in front of her son to protect him from her. However, she was horrified to see all the eyes on her body glaring at her, especially the two fiery eyes on her head, and the contour of her face changed after she sensed her cultivation level. 'Sigh, the situation is really bad.
This beast is a divine beast, and her cultivation is at 10-Star Heaven Realm, and I won't possibly win against her with my cultivation still at 2-Star Earth Realm.'

As soon as Boitata glanced at Gu Zhan, his expression turned completely pale, and pee immediately soaked his trousers. Still fresh in his memory was the horror when he witnessed her fighting against Zhang Lingxue and the others at Blazing Volcano Mountain, and they were defeated by her. 'Fuck! I'm dead! I didn't expect that bastard would give this fucking snake to Ye Lian!'
Yan Huan'er also pulled her daughter away, but Ye Lian immediately shouted at Boitata. "Please! Don't kill him!"

"No." As she swung her tail towards Xing Mei, Boitata rejected Ye Lian's request, sending her slamming into the wall before falling further to the ground. Instantly, she spat out a mouthful of blood, and she could feel that her internal injuries were extremely serious. "My master ordered me to kill anyone who has evil intentions towards you, so I have to kill this idiot brat."
"But-"
"If you want to save him, you can contact my master now, and if he agrees to that, I won't kill him."
Hearing that, Ye Lian immediately contacted Zhang Fei, but his reaction was as she expected, and he didn't care if Gu Zhan died, especially since he had already tried to kill her.

"How is the result?" Ye Lian shook her head at Yan Huan'er, causing her to sigh helplessly, especially since her own cultivation was still in the 3-Star Earth realm, so there was no way she could save Gu Zhan from Boitata. 'Sigh. I didn't expect the situation to turn out like this, and Zhan'er was truly stupid for trying to kill Lian'er.'

"Hiss~" Boitata angrily gazed at Gu Zhan, recalling that he had previously tried to steal the Fire Yang Flower from her. Now, he was trying to kill her master's woman. Immediately, she curled the tip of her tail around his body and lifted him up to her face. "Hiss~ You imbecile! You tried to kill my master's woman, so you must die!"

"No!" When she saw Boitata swallow her son alive, Xing Meng screamed desperately, and tears flowed freely from the corners of her eyes, especially since Gu Zhan was her only son. "Why... why did things have to turn out like this? Why are you not willing to spare my son?"

"Hiss~" Instead, Boitata disdainfully looked at Xing Mei. "Your son's death was his own fault! My master will never spare anyone who dares to do bad things to those closest to him. If you are so sad about his death, I can send you to the afterlife to accompany him there."

"No!" Both women shouted as they moved in front of Xing Mei, and Ye Lian immediately begged the snake. "Please don't kill her, Boitata. Aunt Mei didn't do anything wrong to me, so you shouldn't kill her."
"Lian'er is right, Boitata." Yan Huan'er also tried to persuade her. "Sister Mei loves her very much, and she has always treated her like her own daughter, so I hope you are willing to let her go."

Compared to both women, Botitata has lived for more than a thousand years, and she is very experienced in human character. That's why she didn't immediately agree to their request, especially since she thought that there was a possibility that Xing Mei would take revenge for her son's death against Ye Lian.
She thought of the best plan to protect her, or else Zhang Fei would blame her if something bad happened to her.

After she thought about it for a while, Boitata suddenly spewed her flame, and a small flame serpent similar to her quickly moved into Xing Mei's body through her mouth, shocking the three women, so she explained to Ye Lian. "I would let her go, but I couldn't let her go just like that, and I was forced to do that for her to protect you, especially since human hearts are hard to predict.

At times, they may be allies, yet they can swiftly transform into adversaries without warning. As long as she doesn't have any evil intentions towards you, then it won't activate, but vice versa, and it will immediately destroy her internal organs."
After she said that, Boitata's body quickly shrank to the size of a normal snake, and she immediately coiled around Ye Lian's arms again.
Even though Boitata had done such a thing to Xing Mei, Ye Lian and Yan Huan'er felt relieved, especially since she was at least still alive.

"Lian'er, you go back to the clan first, and I will accompany Sister Mei." Yan Huan'er spoke as she picked up Xing Mei, who looked devastated by her situation and her son's death, and immediately ushered her away to her room.

Ye Lian sighed heavily before leaving the Gu Clan, but her feelings were filled with guilt over the terrible incident that happened to Xing Mei, and she blamed herself for disclosing her relationship with Zhang Fei. If she had not done that, Gu Zhan might not have attacked her, and he might not have died in Boitata's hands.

sentences.text: Yan Huan'er sighed softly before turning to ask Gu Zhan.
"Shouldn't you already know the reason, Zhan'er?
You were Lian'er's fiancé, but you cheated on her by having a relationship with some of your sect sisters.
Moreover, she has warned you repeatedly to stop your lascivious nature, but you always ignore her warnings, so it's natural that she wants to cancel her engagement with you, right?"
"Heh!
Aren't you going to deny that?" Ye Lian shook her head, then pulled out a storage ring that held the items Gu Zhan had given her.
"Since you prioritize your lust and enjoy your time with those women more, I decided to let you go because I don't want to have a treacherous husband."
*Swoosh*
Gu Zhan immediately caught the storage ring Ye Lian threw as he continued to glare fiercely at her, but he quickly released his cultivation and crushed it.
Seeing that, Xing Mei grabbed her son's hand and asked him to return the things Ye Lian had given him, and Gu Zha reluctantly complied with his mother's request.
Like her ex-fiancé, Ye Lian also destroyed the storage ring because she no longer wanted to keep her old memories with him, especially since she had already made a decision about her future.

"This way, our engagement is over, and we won't have any more relationships after this, so I hope you don't bother me again in the future, especially since I have already found the man who will be my husband in the future."
Yan Huan'er was shocked to hear her daughter's words, as she didn't expect Ye Lian to reveal her relationship with Zhang Fei.
As expected, Xing Mei was shocked by her revelation, but Gu Zhan's anger boiled after hearing that, and his facial muscles bulged.
"Tell me!
You deliberately broke off our engagement because you slept with him, right?
Who is that man?
I will definitely kill him because he stole you from me."
"So what?" Ye Lian replied with an indifferent shrug.
"You can sleep with those women; then why can't I sleep with another man?
Moreover, he is much better than you because he didn't lie or cheat on me, and he explained everything before I decided to accept him."
"You-"
"Do you think you can kill him?
Have you forgotten the lesson he gave you when we hunted the fire flower in Blazing Volcano Mountain?" Ye Lian decided to interrupt her ex-fiancé, and Gu Zhan's body stiffened after hearing that.
"That's right; my future husband is Zhang Fei, and you should remember the identities of the people by his side.
That's why you should forget about wanting to kill him; you will never be able to do it."

Gu Zhan's expression turned even uglier after remembering the events of that day, and his hands gripped the arms of the chair he was sitting on, especially since he remembered Liu Hua's presence by Zhang Fei's side.
Xing Mei, who had not said anything before, decided to ask Yan Huan'er.
"Who exactly is Zhang Fei?
Is he a member of the Zhang Clan in the Central Region?"
"No." Yan Huan'er shook her head at Xing Mei.
"Honestly, I have never met Zhang Fei in person; he is not a member of that clan, and he comes from another region."
"Another region?" Xing Mei often traveled to various regions, but she had never heard of the existence of another Zhang Clan, so she felt confused about it.
Yan Huan'er responded with a nod before telling her again.
"Moreover, he is a member of the Liu and Chu Clans now, mainly because he is married to Liu Hua, Chu Qing, and Chu Ying."
"What?" After listening to Yan Huan'er's answer, Gu Zhan was also as shocked as his mother, and Xing Mei asked her again.
"Are you serious about that?
I already knew about Liu Hua's return, but I never heard that he was married, let alone the marriage of those two little girls from the Chu Clan."
"They married Zhang Fei a few days ago, but they only had a traditional wedding." Xing Mei immediately turned to Ye Lian and looked at her in confusion.
"Like I said before, I already knew about their relationship before I knew him, and he didn't hide everything from me either.
At first, I found it hard to accept his polygamous relationship, so I decided to spend a few days with him, and he is different from your son, who repeatedly lied and cheated on me."
Xing Meng couldn't help but sigh, especially since she always dreamed of Ye Lian as her daughter-in-law.
But she was aware that her son had changed a lot since he became a core disciple in the Heavenly Sword Sect.

"Even though you are no longer Zhan'er's fiancée, our clans have been on good terms for a long time, and you are also like my own daughter, so I hope you will still come here to visit me in the future."
"That's for sure, Aunt Mei." Yan Huan'er then followed Ye Lian as she stood up.
"Now that we have resolved everything, we will head back to our clan."
After that, they immediately walked out of the Gu Clan's main hall.
However, Gu Zhan, whose heart was boiling with anger, suddenly mustered his Qi and took out his sword before moving to attack Ye Lian from behind.
"Zhan'er!" Xing Mei screamed in shock, as she was truly shocked to see her son attack Ye Lian from behind.
Ye Lian and her mother looked back at her after hearing her shout, but Gu Zhan's sword was already so close to her that she didn't have time to dodge it.
Fortunately, Boitata had already slid from Ye Lian's arms to attack Gu Zhan before his sword hit her body, and he immediately returned to his original form after blowing him away.
"Guah!" Gu Zhan was flown far away before his body slammed hard against the wall.
*Crumble...
Crumble...*
Since Boitata's body continued to enlarge, the Gu clan's main hall instantly collapsed due to her size as soon as her body stood upright.
Xing Mei, who was shocked to see Boitata's appearance, immediately jumped in front of her son to protect him from her.

However, she was horrified to see all the eyes on her body glaring at her, especially the two fiery eyes on her head, and the contour of her face changed after she sensed her cultivation level. 'Sigh, the situation is really bad.
This beast is a divine beast, and her cultivation is at 10-Star Heaven Realm, and I won't possibly win against her with my cultivation still at 2-Star Earth Realm.'
As soon as Boitata glanced at Gu Zhan, his expression turned completely pale, and pee immediately soaked his trousers.
Still fresh in his memory was the horror when he witnessed her fighting against Zhang Lingxue and the others at Blazing Volcano Mountain, and they were defeated by her. 'Fuck!
I'm dead!
I didn't expect that bastard would give this fucking snake to Ye Lian!'
Yan Huan'er also pulled her daughter away, but Ye Lian immediately shouted at Boitata.
"Please!
Don't kill him!"
"No." As she swung her tail towards Xing Mei, Boitata rejected Ye Lian's request, sending her slamming into the wall before falling further to the ground.
Instantly, she spat out a mouthful of blood, and she could feel that her internal injuries were extremely serious.
"My master ordered me to kill anyone who has evil intentions towards you, so I have to kill this idiot brat."
"But-"
"If you want to save him, you can contact my master now, and if he agrees to that, I won't kill him."
Hearing that, Ye Lian immediately contacted Zhang Fei, but his reaction was as she expected, and he didn't care if Gu Zhan died, especially since he had already tried to kill her.

"How is the result?" Ye Lian shook her head at Yan Huan'er, causing her to sigh helplessly, especially since her own cultivation was still in the 3-Star Earth realm, so there was no way she could save Gu Zhan from Boitata. 'Sigh.
I didn't expect the situation to turn out like this, and Zhan'er was truly stupid for trying to kill Lian'er.'
"Hiss~" Boitata angrily gazed at Gu Zhan, recalling that he had previously tried to steal the Fire Yang Flower from her.
Now, he was trying to kill her master's woman.
Immediately, she curled the tip of her tail around his body and lifted him up to her face.
"Hiss~ You imbecile!
You tried to kill my master's woman, so you must die!"
"No!" When she saw Boitata swallow her son alive, Xing Meng screamed desperately, and tears flowed freely from the corners of her eyes, especially since Gu Zhan was her only son.
"Why... why did things have to turn out like this?
Why are you not willing to spare my son?"
"Hiss~" Instead, Boitata disdainfully looked at Xing Mei.
"Your son's death was his own fault!
My master will never spare anyone who dares to do bad things to those closest to him.
If you are so sad about his death, I can send you to the afterlife to accompany him there."
"No!" Both women shouted as they moved in front of Xing Mei, and Ye Lian immediately begged the snake.
"Please don't kill her, Boitata.
Aunt Mei didn't do anything wrong to me, so you shouldn't kill her."
"Lian'er is right, Boitata." Yan Huan'er also tried to persuade her.
"Sister Mei loves her very much, and she has always treated her like her own daughter, so I hope you are willing to let her go."
Compared to both women, Botitata has lived for more than a thousand years, and she is very experienced in human character.
That's why she didn't immediately agree to their request, especially since she thought that there was a possibility that Xing Mei would take revenge for her son's death against Ye Lian.
She thought of the best plan to protect her, or else Zhang Fei would blame her if something bad happened to her.

After she thought about it for a while, Boitata suddenly spewed her flame, and a small flame serpent similar to her quickly moved into Xing Mei's body through her mouth, shocking the three women, so she explained to Ye Lian.
"I would let her go, but I couldn't let her go just like that, and I was forced to do that for her to protect you, especially since human hearts are hard to predict.
At times, they may be allies, yet they can swiftly transform into adversaries without warning.
As long as she doesn't have any evil intentions towards you, then it won't activate, but vice versa, and it will immediately destroy her internal organs."
After she said that, Boitata's body quickly shrank to the size of a normal snake, and she immediately coiled around Ye Lian's arms again.
Even though Boitata had done such a thing to Xing Mei, Ye Lian and Yan Huan'er felt relieved, especially since she was at least still alive.

"Lian'er, you go back to the clan first, and I will accompany Sister Mei." Yan Huan'er spoke as she picked up Xing Mei, who looked devastated by her situation and her son's death, and immediately ushered her away to her room.

Ye Lian sighed heavily before leaving the Gu Clan, but her feelings were filled with guilt over the terrible incident that happened to Xing Mei, and she blamed herself for disclosing her relationship with Zhang Fei.
If she had not done that, Gu Zhan might not have attacked her, and he might not have died in Boitata's hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Take Zhao Ziqin Away
paragraphs: Yan Huan'er hugged Xing Mei, who kept crying over her son's death, and she felt guilty towards her because Gu Zhan's death was caused by her daughter. Unfortunately, everything has already happened, and he doesn't have the power to turn back time.

Xing Mei continued to cry, and her crying became louder and louder. "Sob... my Zhan'er is no longer by my side, Sister Huan'er! What should I do now? Sob... how can I tell my husband that our son is dead now?"

"Sister Mei, I really want to apologize to you, especially since this matter happened because of us." Yan Huan'er replied with a heavy sigh. "As for your husband, I know that you must inform him of Zhan'er's death, but I hope you are willing to wait for Brother Tong to return first.

They are currently traveling to the northern region to fortify the seal on the demon portal, as failure to do so could result in its destruction and the re-invasion of our realm by demons from other realms.

Although she was deeply saddened by her son's death, Xing Mei herself realized the gravity of the matter, so she did not immediately contact Gu Tong for the sake of many people's future. "Sob... If only Zhan'er hadn't attacked Lian'er, he wouldn't have died at the hands of that divine beast. Moreover, that divine beast swallowed him alive, and I can't give him a proper burial."

As she hugged Xing Mei tighter, Yan Huan'er spoke to her in a regretful tone. "Lian'er was the one in the wrong in this matter, and Zhan'er wouldn't have attacked her if she hadn't revealed her relationship with Zhang Fei to him."

"No." Xing Mei shook her head at Yan Huan'er. "I don't blame Lian'er because I am a woman myself, so I understand her anger and disappointment towards Zhan'er, and I would definitely do the same if my husband cheated on me repeatedly. Furthermore, despite her repeated reminders, he refused to listen and continued his affair.
Not only her, but Yan Huan'er herself would also do the same if her husband dared to cheat on her with multiple women. "For the time being, I will stay here to accompany you, Sister Mei."
"All right."

Meanwhile, Ye Lian didn't return to her clan but went to the Chu Clan instead, and her expression was still filled with regret and guilt over Gu Zhan's death. 'Sigh, I'm such a fool! I should have more control over myself, and if I could, this incident would not have happened.'
"Lian'er?" Ye Lian immediately turned to Liu Hua, who was approaching her. "What happened to you? Why is your expression like that?"

Ye Lian hugged Liu Hua and sobbed, confusing her with her strange attitude, especially since she was previously fine when she returned from Earth. She explained everything to her right away, including Zhang Fei's decision not to spare Gu Zhan.

Liu Hua let out a soft sigh and hugged Ye Lian. "Honestly, you don't need to blame yourself, and we both know that Gu Zhan is indeed arrogant and an idiot. He always acts without thinking about the consequences, so his death was his own fault."
"But-"

"All right, you don't need to think too much about this matter; we are cultivators, and we have to be responsible for our own lives. Moreover, there are always consequences for all our actions, and Gu Zhan has already borne the consequences for his rash actions." Ye Lian fell silent after hearing that, and Liu Hua then spoke to her again.

"I fully support Fei'er's decision, especially since you are his future wife, so it's natural that he wouldn't be willing to spare the person who tried to kill you. If I were in his position, I would definitely take the same decision."
Ye Lian sighed softly and released her hug from Liu Hua before wiping her tears. "Where is Fei now?"
Liu Hua grabbed Ye Lian's hand and took her away. "Fei was strolling around the city with Zhao Ziqin, but someone disturbed their time together, so we will follow them from a distance."

"Zhao Ziqin?" Ye Lian was really surprised after hearing the name. "How could Fei approach her? She always closed herself off due to her introverted character, and she always felt uncomfortable around many people."

"Haha." Liu Hua laughed and turned to Ye Lian. "You still don't understand your future husband's character well, huh? Have you forgotten what he did to you when you two first met? If he hadn't acted aggressively with you, you wouldn't have fallen into his arms this quickly, right? Zhao Ziqin may be an introverted girl, but he definitely has a way to approach her."

"Well, that's true." Ye Lian nodded in agreement. "Fei is truly aggressive when he wants to get something, and I was really shocked by his attitude. However, he treated me so gently, and he could also understand my feelings, even though we had just met for the first time.
Besides, I was too disappointed in Gu Zhan at that time, so he could enter and carve his figure in my heart, and I decided to accept him."

"Judging from Zhao Ziqin's character, I'm sure that she's fallen for Fei'er now, and she'll probably become our sister soon." Following his statement, Liu Hua's expression took on a serious tone, which initially confused Ye Lian, and she told her. "The man who is with them now is Xuan Yu, and his Xuan Clan lives in the Central Region, so they must be powerful.
He told me that Hua Jingtian wants to marry his granddaughter to him in order to strengthen the relationship between their two clans, and their wedding will take place in a month."

Ye Lian released a heavy sigh, especially since many clans have always used their descendants as tools for their clan's interests. That's why she felt lucky to have her parents, especially since they never imposed their will on her and always followed her wishes instead. "What do you think would happen if Xuan Yu knew about Fei's relationship with Zhao Ziqin?"
"Hey! I'm back!" Liu Hua and Ye Lian promptly turned towards the voice, and Zhang Lingxue swiftly approached them before posing a question. "Do you guys intend to follow Fei'er?"
"Yes." Liu Hua then said to her. "Fotunately, you have returned, so you can help Fei'er get rid of that Xuan Yu."

"Haha." That made Zhang Lingxue laugh. "Fei'er contacted me before and told me about that brat from the Xuan Clan, but you guys don't need to mind him, and he wouldn't dare mess with him if he knew that I was his woman."
"Just how strong is the Xuan Clan, Aunt Lingxue?"

Zhang Lingxue immediately turned to Ye Lian. "In fact, there is not a single clan in other regions that can fight the Xuan Clan, including the Liu Clan. However, they are no different from the other minor clans in the central region, and they still need my Zhang Clan's help to be able to exist there, so that brat will definitely back off if he finds out about our relationship."
"Even a minor clan in the central region is so strong, huh?" Ye Lian muttered to herself upon hearing that. "Doesn't that mean that all the major clans in the central region are too strong for us?"

"That's for sure." Zhang Lingxue spoke while proudly puffing out her chest. "There are only five major clans in the central region: the Chang, Di, Feng, Lan, and my Zhang Clan. Out of the five clans, the Chang Clan is the strongest, and my clan is the second strongest.

Aside from us, there is the Moon Fox tribe, but they live in a separate subspace and don't like to interfere in outside affairs, especially since they don't like humans. That's why very few people can have relations with them; my father, Zhang Long, and Aunt Chang Wuhen were some of the people who had a relationship with them."

"Did you know that Fei'er has a relationship with the Moon Fox?" Zhang Lingxue immediately turned to Liu Hua in shock, especially since Zhang Fei had never been to the Central Region before. "She met Hu Yue by chance, and they had been intimate before, so she is our sister. A few days ago, Hu Lili came here on behalf of her daughter, and she gave him the key to enter their subspace."

"That's insane! Hu Lili is one of the Moon Fox race's top officials! I didn't expect that Fei'er had that kind of relationship with her daughter." Zhang Lingxue expressed her shock and amazement, especially since no human had ever had such a relationship with the Moon Fox race before. However, she sighed as she remembered something. "Sigh.
I just remembered that Fei'er is a cunning fox, so I shouldn't be surprised if he can attract the heart of a female fox of that race."

"Moreover, Fei'er is not an ordinary fox; he is a Heavenly Fox, which is the strongest of all fox races." Zhang Lingxue wore a confused look after she heard Liu Hua's words, especially since she didn't know much about the fox races. "Like you, I also don't know for sure about it, but Hu Lili told me about it, so I think it's true."
"Aunts, do you think Fei'er will also seduce Hu Lili?"
"That's possible." They answered Ye Lian at the same time, but Zhang Lingxue suddenly pointed in a certain direction. "They're over there."

After they looked in that direction, Ye Lian said to Liu Hua. "Now, I understand how Fei approached Zhao Ziqin. Look at her; her expression clearly shows that she likes his fox form so much, and he must have used it to seduce her."
"That's true." Liu Hua's gaze then turned to Xuan Yu, who looked very annoyed, especially since Zhao Ziqin kept ignoring him and was more focused on playing with Zhang Fei. "Shall we meet them now?"
"Let's go then."

"Ziqin, you-" Once Zhang Lingxue landed in front of them, Xuan Yu didn't continue his words, and he instinctively took a step back before greeting her with cupped hands. "I pay my respects to Young Miss Zhang."
However, Zhang Lingxue paid him no heed and turned to Zhang Fei with a strange smile, causing him to raise his eyebrows. "Zhao Ziqin, right?"
"Huh?" Zhao Ziqin was surprised that Zhang Lingxue knew her, but she was sure that they had never met before. "Who are you, Big Sister? How do you know me?"

"I am the owner of that fox." Zhang Lingxue replied, pointing her finger at Zhang Fei. "Aside from that, I know Huan Ning quite well, but she probably hates me so much now, especially after the problems between us in the past."
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly after hearing that. 'You dare say that you are my owner, huh? I'll definitely teach you a lesson later!'
"Eh?" Zhao Ziqin was even more shocked by Zhang Lingxue's confession. "How can you possibly be Fei's owner, Big Sis? I found him lost in my clan, so I took him in as my pet."
"Pft!" Liu Hua and Ye Lian burst into laughter because of Zhao Ziqin's answer, and they glanced at Zhang Fei while smiling strangely, making him feel irritated by their behavior.
Zhang Lingxue then took Zhao Ziqin's hand. "Come with me! You don't need to care about this brat from the Xuan Clan; I will protect you if your mother dares to punish you for abandoning him."

After Zhang Lingxue and the others took Zhao Ziqin away with them, Xuan Yu's expression became completely gloomy. "Damn it! I didn't expect to meet that vicious woman in this region, and she intends to protect that stupid girl!"

After that, Xuan Yu contacted his grandfather directly and informed him about Zhang Lingxue and Zhao Ziqin, but he did not give him an answer straight away, so he decided to return to the Zhao Clan while waiting for his instructions.

paragraphs: "Li Lian?" Liu Hua turned to Wen Xuan in surprise.

Wen Xuan nodded her head. "Ever since Mei Xiang told her about Li Ming's situation, Li Lian has been going back and forth to the Li Clan frequently, and they seem to have started plotting something against us, Big Sis."

"I see." Liu Hua wasn't too surprised by that, especially since Li Lian was Li Bao's sister. "All right, you go back to the Li Clan to monitor them with Yuan, and one of you can report to me again when you find out their plans."
"Yes, Big Sis."

"What do you think they will do?" Liu Hua answered Liu Qingyu's question by shaking her head, especially since she still didn't know the details of their plans, so she chose to wait for clarity. "Back then, our Liu Clan helped them prosper, but they became so arrogant after they prospered, so I think we should destroy them if they were plotting against us."

Liu Hua agreed with that. "I've thought about that too, but I want to see their plans first, and we'll destroy them once everything is clear. Anyway, Fei'er just broke through thanks to Lingxue's virgin yin qi, and he previously told me that they would be in seclusion for two days, so I hope he can reach the core realm soon."
"Lingxue is much stronger than us, and the quality of her yin qi is also much more potent than ours, so I think he'll definitely pull it off." Liu Qingyu then turned to her little sister.

"You should also send members of the Hua Assassins to monitor the Zhao Clan, especially since Zhao Ziqin is with us now and Xuan Yu saw you guys bring her here, so I think Huan Ning will be furious if he finds out about this matter."

"Hehe." Liu Hua chuckled and replied to her. "Big Sis, after Fei'er revealed to me what he had done to her and the Zhao Clan, I immediately dispatched someone to monitor Huan Ning as a precautionary measure.

However, Huan Ning had been locking herself in her room since the incident, particularly due to her feelings of guilt towards Zhao Liang, which prevented her from fully understanding the situation. Moreover, she is currently experiencing another incident due to his actions, and I'm sure today's incident will make her sink even deeper into feelings of guilt."

"What did Fei'er do to her?" Liu Hua smiled faintly before telling Liu Qingyu about the incident between Huan Ning and her son, Zhao Yun. In addition, Liu Hua shared with her elder sister a report from her spy, revealing that she had engaged in sexual relations with Xuan Yu. "Sometimes I forget that Fei'er is a lust demon, and his demon abilities can influence other people to succumb to their lust.

However, I didn't expect that he would get the mother and son involved in such a relationship, but I even more didn't expect that a brat from the Xuan Clan would dare to do that to her, and I really feel sorry for Zhao Liang."

"Why should you feel sorry for Zhao Liang, Big Sis?" Liu Qingyu wanted to say something to her, but Liu Hua immediately spoke again. "Actually, he is not much different from Huan Ning, but he is more neat and meticulous in doing everything, and he never uses his emotions in making decisions like his wife."

Liu Qingyu nodded understandingly at her. "Honestly, I still can't understand why Huan Ning wanted to kill Fei'er over and over again, but I have a feeling that she didn't do that just because she wanted to help Zhao Yun get Ying'er, and I think she had another reason behind her actions."

Liu Hua raised his eyebrows after he heard that, especially since she had never thought about other reasons behind Huan Ning's actions, and she had always thought that she wanted to kill Zhang Fei because of his relationship with Chu Ying, but she suddenly remembered something before telling Liu Qingyu.

"Big Sis, I just remembered she joined the Blazing Phoenix Sect in the past, but her talent couldn't compare to Lingxue's, and she had always lagged behind her in everything. Moreover, I've heard that she humiliated her during the sect's internal competition, and she grew to hate her so much from then on, which made her decide to leave the sect."

After hearing that, Liu Qingyu pondered for a moment before coming to a conclusion. "If your words are true, it means that Huan Ning misunderstood many things, and she must have thought that Fei'r was a member of the Zhang Clan. In addition, Zhou Yun was infatuated with Ying'er, but she chose him as her husband, so she wanted to kill him to take out her revenge on Lingxue and that problem."

"En, I agree with you, Big Sis." Liu Hua answered with a nod. "Fei'er could have sent Boitata to kill Huan Ning and Zhao Yun, but his pride as a Heavenly Fox likely prevented her from doing so. I heard from Hu Lili that a heavenly fox is very cunning and evil, and he doesn't even hesitate to kill his brother and ex-lover, so he probably wants to make them suffer first before killing them."
Liu Qingyu didn't comment on it, but she also agreed with her little sister, especially since she herself had witnessed Zhang Fei mercilessly killing the people sent by Huan Ning to kill him.

"Sigh, I hope Fei'er doesn't leave them alone for too long, or else she will realize everything, and she might ask for help from people from the Huan and Qiao Clans to attack us, which will make it too difficult for us to face the three clans at a time."

"Hmm?" Liu Hua raised her eyebrows after hearing that, as she just remembered that Huan Ning had a connection with the Qiao Clan, especially since her mother was the matriarch of that clan, and that clan was no less powerful than their Liu Clan. "I will send someone to watch over the Qiao Clan right away."
"That's good."

Meanwhile, two women were sitting not far from the Li Clan's residence, and they were the Wen Twins, who were assigned by Liu Hua to monitor the people of that clan. "Have you managed to discover their plans?"

"No." Wen Yuan responded to her twin sister by shaking her head. "Mei Xiang and Li Lian acted very carefully, even though they were within their clan, and they also covered the area around them with an anti-spy formation, so I couldn't eavesdrop on their conversation. As for Li Bao, he's away to meet his son first, and he'll probably ask him to persuade his parents-in-law to help them."

Instead, Wen Xuan laughed at her last sentence. "The Wu Clan's strength is no different from the Li Clan's, and I'm sure that Wu Ling wouldn't dare fulfill Li Yuan's request if he knew that they wanted to fight Big Sis Hua."

"You're right about that." While nodding, Wen Yuan spoke. "However, you forgot that Patriarch Liu Ming is on his way to the Demon Cave, and Ancestor Liu Rong has already been there for several months along with the ancestors of the major clans, so they won't be able to help Big Sis Hua resist the combined forces of the Li, Mei, and Wu Clans.
Besides, there is still Huan Ning, so we all have to be careful, or we ourselves will suffer losses."

"Aish! Why are you so worried about them?" Wen Xuan then hugged her twin sister's shoulders. "Did you forget that Boitata was by Zhang Fei's side? Not only is she stronger than Patriarch Liu and Ancestor Liu, but she is also much stronger than the combined forces of those clans, so I'm sure that everything will be fine because she could protect them much better than either of them."
Wen Yuan sighed softly as she remembered the divine beast, and Boitata had even killed Gu Zhan before. "Speaking of Zhang Fei, what is he doing now?"
"Haha." Instead, Wen Xuan teased her. "Do you miss Zhang Fei? He's having fun with Zhang Lingxue now, but they won't be out in two days, so we have to wait for them to come out to meet him."

"Aren't you the same as me?" Wen Yuan responded with a shake of her head. "We are twin daughters, and I can also feel your feelings. Aside from that, I often hear you calling his name in your sleep, so you don't need to pretend in front of me."

Wen Xuan shamelessly admitted it directly. "You're right; I did miss Zhang Fei, especially after we did that with him, and I kept thinking about him. However, I still don't feel ready to accept him, especially since he's Big Sis's husband, and she's been so good to us since we were little, so I don't feel worthy to be in the same position as her."

"Me too." Wen Yuan replied with a nod. "Big Sis is our savior, and she also taught us many things, so I also feel the same as you. In fact, I never thought about being his woman, but I don't mind serving him and Big Sis."
Wen Xuan wanted to say something again, but they suddenly saw Mei Xiang and Li Lian leaving the Li Clan, so they hurried to follow them.

After quite a while, Xuan Yu decided to stop fucking Huan Ning, especially since she already looked exhausted, and he felt satisfied after flooding her womb with his seeds. 'Haha! Her physique was quite strong despite her old age, and I found great satisfaction in fucking her.

Otherwise, I will tell Zhao Liang about our relationship, and you definitely don't want that to happen, right?"

Huan Ning didn't say anything and just watched Xuan Yu get dressed, but she felt regretful in her heart for cheating on her husband with two different men. She had unknowingly had sex with Zhao Yun a few days ago, and another young man fucked her for so long today.
After he left her room, Huan Ning immediately sat on the side of the bed and cleaned up any traces of their sexual activity, or else her son would find out that she had done it with Xuan Yu.

However, Huan Ning also realized something, which made him even more angry. "Damn it! What actually happened to me? Bad luck kept coming and going since the appearance of that man named Zhang Fei, and the people I sent to kill actually died at his hands.

I can't go on like this, and I'm sure that everything that happened to me must have something to do with him, so I have to do something to get rid of him as soon as possible, or I will continue to suffer like this."
Huan Ning took a pill and immediately swallowed it, which helped her recover her strength. After that, she immediately went to another room and called someone to meet her.

Soon, a female servant entered the room, and Huan Ning immediately asked her, but she frowned after hearing her answer. "Young Master Xuan went home alone, and I don't know where Young Miss Ziqin is. As for your cousin, he went to town and hasn't returned until now."

"All right, you can go now, and tell Huan Chong to come see me when he returns." After the servant left, Huan Ning took out a red talisman from her desk drawer and activated it, and it immediately flew out of the room. "I actually didn't want to summon them, but I have no other choice now, and only they can help me get rid of that guy."

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Conflict
paragraphs: After they followed Mei Xiang and Li Lian, the Wen Twins arrived at a place not far from a spacious but simple residence, and it was none other than the residence of the Mei Clan.

"As expected, Mei Xiang plans to ask her clan for help, especially since the Li clan would never dare to fight us openly." Wen Yuan concurred with Wen Xuan's statements. "Do you think Li Bao will succeed in convincing the Wu Clan? If he really succeeds in doing that, then we will have to face three clans at once."

Wen Yuan shook her head at her twin sister. "I can't confirm that yet, and we have to wait for reports from our spies in the Wu Clan. However, Wu Ling is not a fool, and he definitely realizes the risks if he goes against the Liu and Chu Clans, which will only be detrimental to his clan."
"Have you contacted our spies in the Mei Clan?"

"I've already ordered her to eavesdrop on their conversation, so we just have to wait for now." Wen Yuan then took out her communication device and informed Liu Hua about the situation, after which she spoke to her twin sister again. "Actually, I don't think much about the Mei Clan; I think more about Li Jue's purpose in going out of town.

Moreover, some of our people who were stationed in other regions gave me information that people from the Pang Clan have been moving more actively recently, especially in the eastern region. They seem to be looking for something, but they don't know what they are looking for.
Unfortunately, they don't have any information about the movements of their higher-ups, such as Pang Hong, so I ordered them to spread out and stalk them."
Wen Xuan raised her eyebrows upon hearing that. "Do you think that Li Jue wants to have a relationship with that clan?"
"There is such a possibility."

"Sigh." Wen Xuan sighed softly. "Li Jue is truly stupid if he decides to do that, especially since all of our realm's cultivators hate the Pang Clan so much and will not hesitate to attack anyone who has a relationship with them."

"Isn't that a good thing for us?" Wen Yuan inquired, turning to face her. "If Li Jue truly establishes ties with the Pang Clan, then we only need to spread this news to the other clans, so we won't have to go to great lengths to destroy him and the Li Clan, and people will definitely flock together to attack them."
"Well, that's true."

After they waited for some time, they saw Mei Xiang and Li Lian leaving the Mei Clan, and their spies immediately contacted Wen Yuan, informing her of the results of the two women's conversation with the clan members.
"How is the result?"

Wen Yuan released a heavy sigh before telling her. "Mei Jie decided to help Mei Xiang against us, but they wouldn't act immediately, and he asked her to wait for Li Jue to return. According to our spies in the Wu Clan, Wu Ling rejected Li Bao's request, so our burden was reduced by one, but we still have to remain vigilant against them in case he changes his mind."

"This way we just have to wait for reports from our spies who are following Li Jue, and we will immediately report everything to Big Sis Hua, so we can devise countermeasures against all of them." Wen Xuan suddenly got news from someone else. "Hey, Huan Ning decided to summon those people, and they will probably arrive in this city in two days."

"Oh?" Wen Yuan raised an eyebrow in surprise. "Huan Ning seems to be getting more and more frustrated, and she's probably already aware of Zhang Fei's actions against her. Otherwise, she wouldn't have summoned the higher-ups of the Gui Assassins to help her, and the Qiao Clan would definitely have heard of this news, especially since Qiao Ran is the true leader of their group."

"Let's go back to the Li Clan and monitor the movements of the two women again." Wen Yuan immediately followed Wen Xuan, who had already flown away first, but she felt that there was something wrong with the situation.
"Where have you been, Old Man? Are you looking for a woman to have fun with?" Xuan Yu asked Huan Chong, who had just returned to the Zhao Clan.
"Hahaha." As he approached Xuan Yu, Huan Chong laughed heartily at his question, but he turned to ask him. "What about Ziqin? Did you have fun with her?"

"Fuck!" Xuan Yu cursed angrily after hearing Zhao Ziqin's name. "That little bitch doesn't pay attention to me at all, and she's more busy with her white fox pet! Moreover, some people took her away from me, and she hasn't returned to this clan."
"Who are those people?"

"One of them is Zhang Lingxue, the young miss of the Zhang Clan." Huan Chong instantly fell on his buttocks after hearing Xuan Yun's reply, and his eyes shot wide open. "If I remember correctly, the other woman should be Liu Hua, especially since I've seen her once in the past, and they probably brought that little bitch to the Chu Clan.
That's why you have to think of a way to bring her back to me; otherwise, I will ask my grandfather to destroy your Huan Clan."

'Tch! This brat! He only dared to use his grandfather's name to suppress others, and he would be nothing if it weren't for the fact that people are afraid of that old man!' Even so, Huan Chong did not have the guts to say such a thing to Xuan Yu, especially since he did not want to bring trouble to his Huan Clan. But a servant suddenly informed him that Huan Ning wanted to see him.
"I'm going to meet my first cousin, and we'll think of a way to bring Ziqin back to you, but I'm not sure if we can do that as long as she's under Zhang Lingxue and Liu Hua's protection."
Suddenly, Xuan Yu felt a killing intent directed at him before looking for its source, and he discovered that its owner was Zhao Yun, who was standing in the distance with a sharp gaze towards him.

Zhao Yun himself arrived not long after Huan Chong, and he overheard his uncle talking to Xuan Yu about his little sister while on his way to his room, which made him angry because he called her a little bitch.

Xuan Yu grinned faintly and released his aura and killing intent towards Zhao Yun, which forced him to fall and kneel on one knee, especially since his cultivation was higher than his. 'Damn it! Who exactly is this man? What is he doing in our clan? What does he want from Ziqin?'
"Haha! Is this all the young master of this small clan is capable of? Do you think a weak cultivator like you can do anything to me?

Even your grandfather Huang Jingtian and Zhao Feng have to respect me, but a weak brat like you dares direct your killing intent at me." Xuan Yu then moved in front of Zhao Yun, grabbed him by the neck, raised his body high, and punched his abdomen with full force, causing him to spurt blood from his mouth.

"This is just a small lesson from me, especially since I still have to get your little sister and take her with me to the Central Region. Even so, if you dare to threaten me with your weak killing intent one more time, I will kill you outright, and your two grandfathers won't be able to save you from me."
*Bam*

"Cough... Cough..." Zhao Yun vomited blood once more after being thrashed to the ground quite forcefully, and Xuan Yu left him directly. 'Fuck! What really happened? Why did that bastard want to bring Ziqin with him to the Central Region? Tch!
I have to go to my mother right now to ask her about this matter, and I will stop him from taking her away.'

Zhao Yun immediately wiped the blood from his mouth as he stood up, and he hurriedly went to his mother's study. When he arrived, he heard Huan Ning speaking seriously with Huang Cong, and they were talking about Zhang Fei and the Chu Clan, so he didn't disturb them and turned to leave directly. 'Does my mother really intend to fight them?

I would be grateful if she managed to kill that bastard, so I could get Chu Ying. However, that clan is not an easy opponent, and we will definitely lose if we fight them head-on. Even so, we can fight them if he asks for help from my grandparents, and they won't be able to face the attacks of our three clans at once.'

In the room, the two people who were talking together naturally noticed Zhao Yun's presence just now. "Your son seemed to have been looking for trouble with Young Master Xuan, and you were lucky that he didn't kill him outright, or else you would have lost your only son.
Anyway, I didn't expect there to be a member of the Zhang Clan living in this city, so it's no surprise that Zhang Lingxue is here now, and she brought Ziqin with her."
"How did you know that damn woman was in this city?" Huan Ning asked with a frown that made her muscles bulge out, especially since she hated Zhang Lingxue with all her heart.

"Young master Xuan told me about it, and Liu Hua was also with them, so Ziqin should be in the Chu Clan now." Huan Chong then advised Huan Ning. "I know that you hate Zhang Lingxue very much, but you have lived in the Central Region for a few years before, so you should already understand the strength of the Zhang Clan.

That's why you shouldn't act on your anger, particularly since you will never prevail against her, and if Zhang Long discovers that you tried to kill his beloved daughter, our clan will face destruction."

Instead, Huan Ning's expression became even more furious because of his words, but she was also fully aware that she would never be able to defeat Zhang Lingxue, so she immediately calmed herself down before asking her cousin. "What do you think we should do next?"

"What else?" Huan Chong responded with a shrug. "Young master Xuan told me that there will be an internal sect competition in a few days, and Zhang Lingxue definitely won't stay too long in this city, so you can wait for her to leave first while waiting for the people from the Gui Assassins to arrive.
After that, we will attack Zhang Fei and the Chu Clan, and the people from the Liu Clan won't be able to save them, especially since Liu Ming and Liu Rong are in the northern region now."

Hearing that, Huan Ning nodded in understanding. "You're right, I'll wait for Zhang Lingxue to leave first, and the people from the Gui assassins will arrive in this city in two days, so we'll move straight away once everything is ready."

"That's good." Huan Chong then rose to his feet before speaking to her again. "Moreover, Ziqin is in their hands now, so I'm sure Young Master Xuan will be willing to help us, and this is the best chance to get rid of the Chu Clan once and for all."

After her cousin left the room, Huan Ning leaned back in her chair while thinking about many things, especially about Zhang Lingxue. "I can't kill you now, but I will make you regret your past humiliation of me by killing that damn brat from your clan first."

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Tang Ziyu's Dilemma
paragraphs: Early in the morning on earth, Tang Ziyu, who had just opened her eyes, lay on the bed, staring at the bedroom ceiling. Even though she had slept for quite a long time, she still felt very tired after having sex with Zhang Fei for so long. "Sigh, I don't know what to do now. I still have a husband, but I gave him my body instead. What's the difference between me and my husband?
He cheated on me over and over, but I've cheated on him now."

Tang Ziyu then sat on the side of the bed, but her eyes fell on the paper on the bedside table, so she picked it up and read it. Involuntarily, tears dripped from her eyes, and she squeezed the paper tightly. "Are you really willing to accept an old woman like me, Zhang Fei?"
After she cried for some time, Tang Ziyu wiped her tears and went to the bathroom to clean herself and get dressed. She left the room right away.

Arriving at the first floor of the penthouse, Tang Ziyu's eyes widened in shock because the five women were still sleeping in a mess, and there was a lot of dried semen in their pussies. They were none other than Yang Lu'er, Fang Chen, Zhou Ling, Ren Xia, and Qiu Mei.

'Zhang Fei was too strong in bed; he was even able to have sex with all six of us at once, but it was clear that we were the ones who were too overwhelmed to serve him.' Tang Ziyu could only shake her head at their condition and walk to the door, but she looked inside once more. 'This will be the first and last time I come to this place, and I will never forget my memories with him.
However, I'm still hesitant about deciding my future, so I'm going somewhere to be alone for a while, and I want to think about my future, or rather, our future.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 1,400 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 1,400 red jewels sent to inventory]
Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened his eyes after he completed the daily quest, but two female disciples were already waiting for him. "Why are you two here so early?"

"Haha." Luo Yu giggled and sat on his lap. "Actually, Gu Yan and I wanted to dual-cultivate with you, but you were engrossed in your cultivation and didn't notice our presence, so we decided to wait for you to wake up. However, we didn't expect that you would break through to the 6 Star Foundation Realm, and your cultivation might soon catch up with ours."

"That's true; I'm also surprised by your fast breakthrough, Fei. Anyway, dual-cultivating with you is too satisfying, and we are already on the verge of breaking through to the Core Realm, so we want to continue dual-cultivating with you." Gu Yan also joined in, sitting on his lap.
"However, I think it would be better if we get out now and go find a mission first, and you could perhaps ask the two senior sisters to join us, so our trip will be more lively like before."

Zhang Fei [1] contacted Ning Xiang and Du Yuan directly, but both of them told him that they were out of the sect on a mission with their team, so they couldn't accompany him. "They're not in the sect right now, so the three of us will go on a quest."
[Master, I have an idea that can help you gain more sect points faster.]
'What's your idea, Mei?'

[Hehe.] Mei giggled before telling him. [Master, given the potency of your Yang Qi compared to ordinary cultivators and the fact that this sect is a dual-cultivation sect, I believe you should consider selling it at the treasure hall. That way, you won't have to bother carrying out those missions, and you can focus more on dual-cultivating with these women.
Moreover, Shi Yue hasn't come to you since you guys returned to the sect, so you might as well go look for her.]

However, Zhang Fei [1] immediately rejected her idea. 'Mei, you know that I wasn't a martial arts expert before I became a cultivator, so my fighting abilities are still inferior to those of the Wen Twins, and I don't want to continue relying on them to fight my enemies.
After all, I am a man, and I have to be responsible for all of them, so I carry out these missions to hone my battle instincts at the same time.'
[Well, you can do it if you really want it to be that way, Master.]

'Even so, your idea is good, but I will only sell it after I become an inner disciple.' Zhang Fei [1] then brought the two women down from his lap and hugged their waists. "Anyway, I haven't gone to look at other important areas, so I want to look at those places before we go to the mission hall to look for missions, especially the treasure hall."

Hearing that, the two women immediately pulled him out of his room. "In that case, we will take you there, but you don't have many sect points right now, so you won't be able to buy anything valuable there."
"En, I know." Zhang Fei [1] had also realized that, so he wanted to look around first, and he would only think about how to buy the items if he found things that were suitable for him or his wives.

Zhang Fei [1] casually walked towards the treasure hall, with Gu Yan and Luo Yu flanking him intimately on his right and left, making the male disciples who saw them feel envious and jealous of him, especially since both women were quite beautiful. Unfortunately, they were a lily couple, so they always rejected men who tried to approach them. But now they have fallen into his arms.

However, Zhang Fei [1] couldn't care less about their gazes and hugged both women tightly to show them that both were his. Before long, they had arrived near the treasure hall, but he was curious to see three huge steles not far from that location, so he brought the two women there, and he saw that there were so many names engraved there. 'Oh? So they are the top ten of every class, huh?'

Zhang Fei [1] smiled as he looked at the top name on the core disciple stele, especially since Shen Yu occupied the top spot. He didn't pay attention to the others, especially since they were still out of his reach. He was more interested in the outer and inner disciple ranks, especially since he would break through to the core realm soon so he could rise to become an inner disciple.
[Outer Disciples - Top 10]
1. Luo Yu - Female - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm 150,000 points.
2. Gu Yan - Female - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm - 150,000 points.
3. Xia Leng - Male - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm - 145,000 points.
4. Hao Yun - Male - 19 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 140,000 points.
5. Ming Hao - Male - 21 Years Old - 8 Star Foundation Realm - 135,000 points.
6. Gong Zhi - Male - 20 Years Old - 8 Star Foundation Realm - 135,000 points.
7. Shan Yun - Male - 22 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 125,000 points.
8. Yue Qingya - Female - 18 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 120,000 points.
9. Yun Kexin - Female - 19 Years Old - 7 Star Foundation Realm - 110,000 points.
10. Xia Qianqian - Female - 18 Years Old - 5 Star Foundation Realm - 105,000 points.
[Inner Disciple - Top 10]
1. Lin Dong'er - Female - 24 Years Old - 6 Star Core Realm - 350,000 points.
2. Lan Zhen - Female - 25 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 340,000 points.
3. Yin Tong - Male - 28 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 320,000 points.
4. Yuan Zheng - Male - 26 Years Old - 7 Star Core Realm - 300,000 points.
5. Wang Jie - Male - 24 Years Old - 7 Star Core Realm - 275,000 points.
6. Mu Lingshu - Female - 22 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 250,000 points.
7. Ying Sha - Female - 25 Years Old - 4 Star Core Realm - 230,000 points.
8. Sun Bing - Male - 26 Years Old - 4 Star Core Realm - 210,000 points.
9. Zhu Cun - Male - 24 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 175,000 points.
10. Qing Ya - Female - 22 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 150,000 points.
"You two are rank 1 and 2 in the outer disciple rank, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] then turned to the two women. "Aren't Yue Qingya, Yun Kexin, and Xia Qianqian the ones you told me about before?"

"Yes." Both women responded with a nod, and Luo Yu immediately told him. "Xia Qianqian is actually still weak, but she is lucky because her brother, Xia Leng, continues to help her, so she can enter the top 10. Notwithstanding her unattractive countenance, she possesses a seductive body that will undoubtedly win your affections."

"Yun Kexin has a unique personality, but she's too tomboyish, so I'm not sure if you'll like her. Moreover, she already has a partner, and her partner is Yin Tong, ranked third on the inner core disciple rank.

Despite this, I am confident that you will be able to seduce her, especially since you are a lust demon, and his partner frequently ignores her because his other partner is a fellow inner disciple." Gu Yan then pointed to the last woman's name. "Compared to the two of them, Yue Qingya is the prettiest, and she has a devilish body, but her character is a bit rough."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows and searched for Yin Tong's location through his map; he found him with a woman named Ni Wenwei in the inner disciples area, but he immediately ignored them. "What do you know about the other inner disciples?"

"We don't know them very well." Both women answered by shaking their heads. "However, you can ask Senior Sister Du Yuan and Ning Xiang about them, especially since both of them are also inner disciples."

Gu Yan then told him about one of the disciples. "Anyway, Lin Dong'er is the daughter of Elder Lin Hao, but her character is too childish and mischievous. She joined this sect because of her father, and since she is not a dual cultivator, she is still a virgin.

That's why you have to be careful if you intend to approach her, or her father will punish you if he finds out your intentions, especially since he doesn't want her to get a dual-cultivator as her husband."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding to them, and he would not possibly do such a reckless action with his current strength and status as an outer disciple, so he then took the two women to the treasure hall.

When they arrived, the place was filled with sect disciples, whether they were outer, inner, or core disciples. A large wooden bulletin board stood next to the entrance, displaying a list of desired items that could earn points. Unfortunately, Zhang Fei [1] didn't have any of the items listed there, so he simply ignored them and entered the place directly.

A middle-aged woman watched Zhang Fei [1] and the two women from a distance, and a faint smile appeared on her face after she sensed his Yang Qi in the two women's bodies. 'Hmm? Judging from his uniform, that kid should still be an outer disciple, but his Yang Qi's power has surpassed that of the inner disciples and even the core disciples.'
Zhang Fei [1] naturally noticed the middle-aged woman, so he asked the two women. 'Who is that woman?'

'She is Elder Tang Rou, who is in charge of managing the Yin-Yang Chamber, and she is the most perverted among all the elders.' Luo Yu told him in a whisper while glancing at her. 'Anyway, she seems to have already targeted you, so you can take your chances with her, just like you did with Elder Shi.'

[Master, given the potency of your Yang Qi compared to ordinary cultivators and the fact that this sect is a dual-cultivation sect, I believe you should consider selling it at the treasure hall.
That way, you won't have to bother carrying out those missions, and you can focus more on dual-cultivating with these women.
Moreover, Shi Yue hasn't come to you since you guys returned to the sect, so you might as well go look for her.]

However, Zhang Fei [1] immediately rejected her idea. 'Mei, you know that I wasn't a martial arts expert before I became a cultivator, so my fighting abilities are still inferior to those of the Wen Twins, and I don't want to continue relying on them to fight my enemies.
After all, I am a man, and I have to be responsible for all of them, so I carry out these missions to hone my battle instincts at the same time.'
[Well, you can do it if you really want it to be that way, Master.]
'Even so, your idea is good, but I will only sell it after I become an inner disciple.' Zhang Fei [1] then brought the two women down from his lap and hugged their waists.
"Anyway, I haven't gone to look at other important areas, so I want to look at those places before we go to the mission hall to look for missions, especially the treasure hall."
Hearing that, the two women immediately pulled him out of his room.
"In that case, we will take you there, but you don't have many sect points right now, so you won't be able to buy anything valuable there."
"En, I know." Zhang Fei [1] had also realized that, so he wanted to look around first, and he would only think about how to buy the items if he found things that were suitable for him or his wives.

Zhang Fei [1] casually walked towards the treasure hall, with Gu Yan and Luo Yu flanking him intimately on his right and left, making the male disciples who saw them feel envious and jealous of him, especially since both women were quite beautiful.
Unfortunately, they were a lily couple, so they always rejected men who tried to approach them.
But now they have fallen into his arms.
However, Zhang Fei [1] couldn't care less about their gazes and hugged both women tightly to show them that both were his.

Before long, they had arrived near the treasure hall, but he was curious to see three huge steles not far from that location, so he brought the two women there, and he saw that there were so many names engraved there. 'Oh?
So they are the top ten of every class, huh?'
Zhang Fei [1] smiled as he looked at the top name on the core disciple stele, especially since Shen Yu occupied the top spot.
He didn't pay attention to the others, especially since they were still out of his reach.
He was more interested in the outer and inner disciple ranks, especially since he would break through to the core realm soon so he could rise to become an inner disciple.
[Outer Disciples - Top 10]
Luo Yu - Female - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm 150,000 points.
Gu Yan - Female - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm - 150,000 points.
Xia Leng - Male - 20 Years Old - 10 Star Foundation Realm - 145,000 points.
Hao Yun - Male - 19 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 140,000 points.
Ming Hao - Male - 21 Years Old - 8 Star Foundation Realm - 135,000 points.
Gong Zhi - Male - 20 Years Old - 8 Star Foundation Realm - 135,000 points.
Shan Yun - Male - 22 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 125,000 points.
Yue Qingya - Female - 18 Years Old - 9 Star Foundation Realm - 120,000 points.
Yun Kexin - Female - 19 Years Old - 7 Star Foundation Realm - 110,000 points.
Xia Qianqian - Female - 18 Years Old - 5 Star Foundation Realm - 105,000 points.
[Inner Disciple - Top 10]
Lin Dong'er - Female - 24 Years Old - 6 Star Core Realm - 350,000 points.
Lan Zhen - Female - 25 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 340,000 points.
Yin Tong - Male - 28 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 320,000 points.
Yuan Zheng - Male - 26 Years Old - 7 Star Core Realm - 300,000 points.
Wang Jie - Male - 24 Years Old - 7 Star Core Realm - 275,000 points.
Mu Lingshu - Female - 22 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 250,000 points.
Ying Sha - Female - 25 Years Old - 4 Star Core Realm - 230,000 points.
Sun Bing - Male - 26 Years Old - 4 Star Core Realm - 210,000 points.
Zhu Cun - Male - 24 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 175,000 points.
Qing Ya - Female - 22 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 150,000 points.
"You two are rank 1 and 2 in the outer disciple rank, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] then turned to the two women.
"Aren't Yue Qingya, Yun Kexin, and Xia Qianqian the ones you told me about before?"
"Yes." Both women responded with a nod, and Luo Yu immediately told him.
"Xia Qianqian is actually still weak, but she is lucky because her brother, Xia Leng, continues to help her, so she can enter the top 10.
Notwithstanding her unattractive countenance, she possesses a seductive body that will undoubtedly win your affections."
"Yun Kexin has a unique personality, but she's too tomboyish, so I'm not sure if you'll like her.
Moreover, she already has a partner, and her partner is Yin Tong, ranked third on the inner core disciple rank.

Despite this, I am confident that you will be able to seduce her, especially since you are a lust demon, and his partner frequently ignores her because his other partner is a fellow inner disciple." Gu Yan then pointed to the last woman's name.
"Compared to the two of them, Yue Qingya is the prettiest, and she has a devilish body, but her character is a bit rough."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows and searched for Yin Tong's location through his map; he found him with a woman named Ni Wenwei in the inner disciples area, but he immediately ignored them.
"What do you know about the other inner disciples?"
"We don't know them very well." Both women answered by shaking their heads.
"However, you can ask Senior Sister Du Yuan and Ning Xiang about them, especially since both of them are also inner disciples."
Gu Yan then told him about one of the disciples.
"Anyway, Lin Dong'er is the daughter of Elder Lin Hao, but her character is too childish and mischievous.
She joined this sect because of her father, and since she is not a dual cultivator, she is still a virgin.

That's why you have to be careful if you intend to approach her, or her father will punish you if he finds out your intentions, especially since he doesn't want her to get a dual-cultivator as her husband."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding to them, and he would not possibly do such a reckless action with his current strength and status as an outer disciple, so he then took the two women to the treasure hall.
When they arrived, the place was filled with sect disciples, whether they were outer, inner, or core disciples.
A large wooden bulletin board stood next to the entrance, displaying a list of desired items that could earn points.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei [1] didn't have any of the items listed there, so he simply ignored them and entered the place directly.
A middle-aged woman watched Zhang Fei [1] and the two women from a distance, and a faint smile appeared on her face after she sensed his Yang Qi in the two women's bodies. 'Hmm?
Judging from his uniform, that kid should still be an outer disciple, but his Yang Qi's power has surpassed that of the inner disciples and even the core disciples.'
Zhang Fei [1] naturally noticed the middle-aged woman, so he asked the two women. 'Who is that woman?'

'She is Elder Tang Rou, who is in charge of managing the Yin-Yang Chamber, and she is the most perverted among all the elders.' Luo Yu told him in a whisper while glancing at her. 'Anyway, she seems to have already targeted you, so you can take your chances with her, just like you did with Elder Shi.'
