paragraphs: 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
Name: Tang Rou
Age: 65
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 1-Star Earth Realm
Element: Earth [intermediate stage]
Core: Lower-Rank Earth Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partners: Too many.
Like: Men
Dislikes: Shen Huang, Shen Xinya, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu.

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei [1] frowned after he read Tang Rou's data one by one, especially after he saw Shen Yu's name on the list of people she didn't like. 'Hmm? The three women with the surname Shen should belong to Yu'er's family, but I don't understand why that old woman hates them.'
[Are you interested in that woman, Master?]

'Not really.' Zhang Fei [1] replied with a slight shake of his head. 'She's much older than Qingyu, but her cultivation is two levels below hers, and her core is also only lower-rank. That's why I think her yin qi is also weaker than hers, so she's not that useful for my cultivation.
Furthermore, her face and body are unappealing, and she also has too many male partners, so I'm not interested in dual cultivating with her.'

[Well, that's true. She was indeed weaker than Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua, and Shi Yue was even better than her. However, you can at least use her to harvest her female essence, and you can put her aside if you no longer need her.]
'Seriously, Mei, you are more evil than me, you know?'
[Hehe, you are my master, and I learned everything from you.]

Zhang Fei [1]'s lips twitched upon hearing that, but he saw a male elder pass something on to Tang Rou, who immediately disappeared from the scene. However, he suddenly receives a voice transmission from her, inviting him to meet her in the Yin-Yang Chamber and offering him complimentary facilities. 'Tsk! That cougar! Does she think I'll fall for her seduction just like that?'
"What are you thinking? Are you thinking about approaching Elder Tang?" Suddenly, Luo Yu asked him.
"No." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Luo Yu. "Even though her cultivation is higher than the two of you, you guys are so much better than her, so I didn't think about approaching her."

"Unfortunately, Elder Tang has already targeted you, and I'm sure that she will come for you soon, so you better be prepared to face her." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Gu Yan, who told him again. "I heard that her lust is very high, and she often forces male disciples to serve her.
Although some of them have complained to the Sect Master, she hasn't done anything to her, and her behavior seems to be getting worse because she's on her way to the northern region."
"Who exactly is the sect master of this sect? Is she a member of Shen Yu's clan?"

Both women were no longer surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei [1]'s mouth, especially since he and the two female senior disciples had already told them about their meeting at Blazing Volcano Mountain, which Luo Yu then told him.

"The Shen Clan is the founder of this sect, but Yan Zixiu holds the status of sect master, as they no longer manage this sect directly and only supervise everything from behind the scenes. Since she was on her way to the northern region to help other senior cultivators strengthen the seal in the demon cave, Yan Luan'er took over her position for the time being.
However, she was not as good as her big sister, and she was more indifferent than her."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] was a little surprised when he heard that, but he immediately looked for Yan Luan'er and the members of the Shen Clan on his map. However, he only found her name and Shen Xueyi there, and he couldn't find the names Shen Huang and Shen Xinya. Aside from that, he still couldn't find Shen Yu, who was still in seclusion in a special place. 'Interesting!

The two women were stronger than Qingyu and the others, especially Xueyi, who was also a sea serpent like Yu'er. Unfortunately, I'm still an outer disciple, and I can't meet them for now, so I have to advance to the inner disciple as soon as possible. That way, I can get closer to them and think of a way to get them both.'

After that, Zhang Fei [1] took the two women to look through the list of items in the treasure hall, and he found several items that should be useful for all his women. However, he only had seven thousand sect points now, and the points he needed to get those items were simply too many, so he decided to take them to the mission hall to look for missions.

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [1] immediately looked at the mission bulletin board specifically for outer disciples to look for missions that were suitable for them, and he found five missions that were not too far from each other, so he took them all because their sect point rewards are quite good.

Besides, he tried checking the special inner disciple bulletin board, especially since he was sure that his cultivation would reach the core realm after his real body finished dual cultivating with Zhang Lingxue.
"Eh? Do you intend to take on missions specifically for inner disciples?" Gu Yan asked in surprise.
Zhang Fei [1] turned to her and asked. "Are outer disciples prohibited from taking missions for inner disciples?"

"Not really." Luo Yu answered him while shaking her head. "Usually, outer disciples can also take missions for inner disciples, but they have to bring other students from that class, especially since their strength is not yet enough to complete those missions by themselves.
Unfortunately, Senior Sister Yuan and Senior Sister Xiang are not with us now, so we won't be able to take on the mission for that class."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, but he was really interested in taking on the mission, especially since he only needed to capture an adult owl bear, and the sect points offered on the mission were quite high at sixty thousand points. Moreover, he is a heavenly fox, and he can suppress the beast easily by using his bloodline.
'Sigh, forget it; I'll wait for my cultivation to break through and advance to inner disciple first, and I'll take on higher missions straight after.'

Zhang Fei [1] then brought the two women to report to the male elder in charge of the mission hall, and he frowned because he wanted to take on so many missions at once. However, he later agreed because of Luo Yu and Gu Yan's presence in their group, and the missions were not too difficult for them either.

After getting the elder's approval, Zhang Fei [1] immediately took the two women to leave the sect, and Luo Yu estimated that it would take them at least ten days to be able to complete all five missions. After they walked quite far from the sect, Gu Yan informed him. "Fei, the furthest mission is in a village not far from the Southern Ocean, which takes three days by air from here.
That's why I think it would be better if we went there first, and we could complete the other four missions on the way back to the sect."
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] immediately agreed, took out the pandora odyssey, and took the two women on board before speeding away from that place.
Elsewhere, an old man with white hair was sitting with a man wearing a straw hat as they enjoyed their cup of wine, and they seemed to be talking seriously.

The man wearing the straw hat took out a small bottle and handed it to the old man. "Pour this thousand poison into the Chu Clan's water well, and you must inform me directly after you succeed in doing so, so I can give a report to my master."
"Won't they find out about this poison?" The old man inquired seriously while examining the bottle.

"Ha ha ha!" The man in the straw hat laughed at his question. "Are you doubting my master's abilities? My master concocted this poison using various special ingredients, the effect of which is very lethal to paralyze their nerves, and he is the only person who has the antidote.
Moreover, this poison is colorless and odorless, so I'm sure they won't be able to realize that you've mixed it into their well."

"Alright." The white-haired old man replied with a nod before storing the poison bottle in his storage ring, and he asked the person again. "What exactly is your master's purpose in helping me to fight against the Chu Clan?"

"Do you still need to ask, Li Jue? Don't you already know that Liu Hua was my master's puppet?" The man in the straw hat turned to inquire with narrowed eyes. "Unfortunately, that male demihuman messed up his plans when he was about to capture Liu Qingyu, and his puppet was also snatched by him, which caused him quite serious injuries.

That's why he sent me to look for people who have grudges against the Chu Clan, and I heard that she already castrated your second grandson, so I deliberately chose you and your clan. However, my master will not accept failure, so you should carry out this task carefully.
Besides, our Pang Clan will not forgive traitors, so you better show your loyalty to us, or else you and your clan will suffer the consequences."
Li Jue shuddered at his words, coupled with his killing intent. "Don't worry. My clan and I will definitely be loyal to your Pang Clan, and I will do my job as soon as possible."

"In any case, your recklessness is such that you are oblivious to the fact that someone is following you." After saying that, the man wearing the straw hat disappeared from Li Jue's sight, but a few moments later, he reappeared with a woman with short black hair in his arms. "Do you recognize this woman?"
"If I'm not mistaken, she is a member of the Hua Assassin, and she is Liu Hua's subordinate." Li Jue replied to him as he observed the black-haired woman, who was unconscious.

"Oh?" The man wearing the straw hat was taken back for a moment before taking out a bottle and opening it directly, and a small insect walked out from inside, shocking Li Jue. "Hehehe! Since this woman is Li Hua's subordinate, I have to use her to smooth out our plans, and they won't definitely notice the difference in her."

After that, the man wearing the straw hat put the insect on the woman's face, and it went straight into her body through her nose before moving to her brain, making her twitch several times before opening her eyes. She then kneeled on one knee and faced him, making him smile in satisfaction at that.
After giving the woman some instructions, the man wearing the straw hat said a few things to Li Jue, and he immediately vanished from the scene.

"Li Hua! You have made my second grandson's life miserable!" Li Jue said this while tightly clenching his fists. "Soon! I will make you and everyone around you suffer, and the people of the Pang Clan will definitely be very grateful to me if I manage to hand you all over to them."
After that, Li Jue left the room and hurried back to his clan, and the woman also left there to report to Liu Hua.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Core Realm
paragraphs: After some time, Li Jue arrived at the Li Clan and explained everything. He also showed his clan members the bottle containing the poison. "Besides, that guy already controlled one of the women of the Hua Assassins, and he ordered her to give them heart fissure poison, so the Liu and Chu Clans will disappear along with that group once our plan succeeds."
Li Ming was the most ecstatic upon hearing this, especially since he couldn't wait to exact vengeance on Liu Hua, whose act of crushing his dick had destroyed his pride as a man.
"Are you sure that this poison will not kill them, Father?" Li Bao seriously asked.
"It would be good if they died! Liu Hua has turned my son into an eunuch, so they have to pay the price for her actions." Mei Xiang angrily said this after she heard her husband's words.

"You two don't need to argue." Before explaining, Li Jue shook his head at them. "This poison will not kill them, but it will only paralyze their nerves because the Pang Clan doesn't want them to die, and they want to use them as their puppets."
"Heh! That's not bad! Living as puppets would be more miserable than dying."
Li Lian then asked Li Jue. "So, how are we going to get the poison into their well, Father?"
"You don't have to worry; I've thought of a way." Li Jue replied with a mysterious smile.

Unfortunately, they didn't realize that there were two people eavesdropping on them from the roof, and they were none other than the Wen Twins. They exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to each other, and they disappeared from the Li Clan residence instantly.

After they arrived at the Chu Clan, the Wen Twins immediately reported the Li Clan's conversation to Liu Hua, and she ordered everyone within the Chu Clan to be wary of all foreigners who intended to enter the clan.

"I didn't expect that Li Jue would actually make such a decision to become the Pang Clan's vassal, and the man who contacted him was definitely Pang Hong's subordinate, especially since he was the only member of that clan who kept targeting us. Moreover, Fei'er managed to release me from under his control, so he will definitely target us even more."
The Wen Twins nodded in agreement with Liu Hua, and Wen Yuan asked her. "What about our spy, Big Sis? What should we do for her?"

"Since she's already fallen under that guy's control, we have no other choice but to get rid of her, so you can tell the others to kill her once he returns to our base." Liu Hua then pondered and thought about a few things before ordering them again. "Besides, you can order them to spread out and search for that man's whereabouts, and we have to get rid of him at once."
"Won't that just alert the Pang Clan, Big Sis?" Wen Xuan questioned Liu Hua.

"You're right." Liu Hua nodded in agreement with that. "However, the people from the Pang Clan won't dare to blatantly attack us, and I'm sure that Pang Hong has also not recovered from his injuries, so we don't need to think about them for now."
"Then what about the Li and Mei Clans? Should we move directly against them?"

chapters.title: Chapter 168: New Abilities
paragraphs: Half an hour later, a pillar of light pierced the night sky and illuminated the area around the Chu Clan. Furthermore, a fairly large ball of light appeared within the formation, as Zhang Fei had already successfully formed his second core. Like before, the light ball immediately entered his body, and he became a cultivator with two cores.

However, Zhang Fei's next feat once again shocked those people, as he unknowingly transformed into his incubus form while activating his darkness element. The entire area of the Chu Clan that was previously bright quickly became pitch black, making it difficult for them to see him, so Liu Hua and the others used their senses to observe him.

"Fei'er is simply absurd." Liu Qingyu made a comment while shaking her head. "A cultivator with two elements is already rare, but he is now trying to form his third core, and he is probably the first cultivator to have three cores in this realm."

"Fortunately, this clan has a protective formation; otherwise, people will know that Fei'er has the darkness element, and they will definitely flock to attack us." After she said that, Liu Hua immediately ordered everyone in the Chu Clan to shut their mouths tightly, and she threatened to kill them if outsiders were to find out about Zhang Fei's darkness element.

"If they dare attack Fei'er, I will destroy them all at once." Immediately, the Liu Sisters turned to Zhang Lingxue, who had released her fire element, enveloping her body in a dark red aura, and smiled with satisfaction at her serious demeanor. "However, he is indeed absurd because he has light and darkness elements at the same time, especially since those two elements always oppose each other."

The Liu Sisters nodded at him, and Liu Qingyu muttered softly. "From the beginning, Fei'er's existence was already too absurd, especially since he was an ordinary human, but he was also a heavenly fox and a lust demon."

"I still don't understand how his savior could change him into something like that." Liu Hua said it with a soft sigh. "However, Fei'er will eventually become the best cultivator in this realm, and he will probably surpass the cultivators in the central region, including Chang Wuhen and Zhang Long."

"Haha." Zhang Lingxue laughed and nodded in agreement after hearing that. "You're right; I also believe that Fei'er will be able to surpass them to become the best of the best. However, I'm worried about someone, especially since she really hates darkness cultivators, and she has also killed countless of them."
Liu Hua frowned and turned to Zhang Lingxue. "You mean the Sect Master of the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Yao, right?"

"Yeah." Zhang Lingxue responded with a node. "Big Sister Yao is no less special than Fei'er; I got my bloodline from her. Unfortunately, their characters are opposite each other, and she might be hostile to him if she finds out his true identity as a lust demon, so I sincerely hope that she won't find out about that.
Besides, she has something unique that no female cultivator has, and his charm will be useless against her, so he must be very careful when meeting her in the future."

Liu Hua suddenly thought of someone. "Hey, isn't your sister-in-law also not different from Feng Yao? As I recall, the demons who invaded our realm in the past massacred Zi'er's family, leading to her subsequent hatred towards the darkness cultivator.

"Sigh." Zhang Lingxue let out a deep sigh in response to Liu Hua's comment. "You're right about her, and Zi'er does hate darkness cultivators so much. She's different from Big Sister Yao, but I'm not too worried about her, and I'm confident that Fei'er can handle her."
"I hope so."

After they waited for some time, the situation within the Chu Clan gradually returned to normal as the darkness began to dissipate, and Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes after his darkness core entered his body. 'Phew! I didn't expect that I would have three cores, especially since all the cultivators I met only had single cores, and I'm sure that this isn't without drawbacks, right?'

[You are right, Master. A cultivator with multiple cores would need more qi to break through compared to a typical single-core cultivator. However, I'm sure it won't be a significant problem for you because you and your clone have many partners, so your cultivation speed won't be much different from theirs.
Instead, you will be able to cultivate even faster if you add another clone, and all of you can add more partners.]

'Haha.' When he heard that, Zhang Fei laughed, and he himself had actually thought about upgrading his demon body double. However, he didn't want to use it for cultivation; he wanted to harvest female essence from female demons. 'Hey, Mei, I should have 4000 female essences, right? I want you to buy the Demon Slave Mark and Demon Transformation II.'
[All right, I will buy both straight away.]
{You got Demon Slave Mark Ability x1} (A/N: You don't need to worry that Zhang Fei will use it carelessly, and he will only use it on truly evil people.)
{You got Demon Transformation II Ability x1}
{3,500 female essence has been deducted from your balance}
After Mei bought both of them, Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction, and he immediately read their descriptions.

[Demon slave mark: If the user instills this slave mark on another person, then that person will completely submit to the user's commands, even if the user asks him or her to commit suicide. If they have malicious intent toward the user, they will feel excruciating pain throughout their body.]

[Demon Transformation II: This is an upgraded version of demon transformation, and the user can transform himself into various other types of demons, including their demon aura, so he will not be different from the demon he imitates.]

'Haha! These two new abilities are not bad, and I can use my slave mark on people like Pang Hong, so I can use him to destroy his own clan from within.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered while laughing, but he suddenly remembered something. 'Hey, Mei, what exactly is the use of beast essences besides evolving? For now, I have 200,000 beast essences, so I think I can use them for something else.'

[Actually, to buy beast techniques, you not only need beast cores, but you also need beast essence to buy some of them, especially high-level beast techniques. Unfortunately, each of them is very expensive, and you can only use them after you reach three-tails, so I didn't recommend them to you before. However, now that you've reached three tails, you can purchase one technique.
I believe the most useful technique for you at this point is the invisibility ability.]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after hearing that. 'In that case, you can buy that ability now, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
{You got the invisibility ability x1}
{150,000 beast essence has been deducted from your balance}

'Cough!' Zhang Fei instantly choked as soon as he saw the price of the new ability, especially since it was incredibly expensive, and he didn't dare imagine the price of other high-level abilities, as he was sure that they would be even more expensive. 'Damn it! I have to use the essence absorption technique more often, or else I won't be able to afford them.'

[Hahaha! You're right, master. There are many more advanced techniques, and their prices are exorbitant. Furthermore, the need for your beast essence to evolve is increasing, so you must use that ability more often to be able to evolve faster.]

[Invisibility: The user can disappear from the sight of others, and the user will be able to move more freely. However, this ability is not perfect because humans, demons, or beasts with sensor abilities can still detect the user's presence.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh and nodded in agreement with him. He then looked at his wives and family, who were approaching him. "Why are you guys looking at me like that?"

"You cheated, Fei!" Chu Qing was the first to answer him, pouting her lips. "I had to cultivate for so long to be able to reach my current level, but you can catch up with me in just a few days, and you will definitely leave me far behind soon."
Chu Ying nodded in agreement with her little sister. "Sooner or later, you will definitely surpass me too, Fei."

"It's not just you, Ying." Ye Lian expressed this sentiment, shaking her head. "Fei will definitely surpass all of us in a short time, especially since the number of his women will continue to increase, and his clones are also building their own harem.
Unfortunately, we can't learn his clone technique, especially since that is one of his demon abilities; otherwise, we and our clones can dual-cultivate with it continuously.

Not only Ye Lian and the Chu Sisters, but Zhang Lin and the others also felt increasingly left behind by Zhang Fei. Even so, they were aware that he would never neglect them, so they weren't too worried about it.

Liu Qingyu then spoke to them. "You guys don't need to feel jealous like that, and you all just need to cultivate harder. Moreover, Fei'er will continue to help you all, so you don't need to be discouraged like this."
"Fei'er, let's go somewhere else. We want to discuss some things with you first before we take our next action."

Zhang Fei frowned after hearing Liu Hua's words, but he then asked his grandmother and the others to focus on cultivation first, especially since it was almost time for them to return to earth, and he immediately followed the three senior women and the Wen Twins to another area.

Upon their arrival, Liu Hua immediately explained to Zhang Fei the plans of the Li and Mei Clans, and she also told him about Huan Ning's action to summon the senior members of the Gu Assassins group.

"Huan Ning, huh? I have to discuss this matter with Ziqin first, so I'll make a decision later, but we have to quickly deal with the people from the Gui Assassins group." Zhang Fei spoke to them while searching for the straw hat man on his map, and discovered him hiding in a fairly remote area. He promptly informed the five of them of his location.
"Since Li Jue and the others want to poison you guys, I will deal with them directly, and I will make them regret their decision for the rest of their lives."
They could understand Zhang Fei's decision regarding Huan Ning, but Liu Qingyu then posed an inquiry. "What are your plans for the Li and Mei Clans?"
"Are you confident that you can handle the Li Clan alone? Li Jue is almost as strong as us, so it will be dangerous for you." Liu Hua said to him worriedly.
"You don't have to worry about that." Zhang Fei replied with a confident smile before using his invisibility ability. "How is it? Can you guys feel my presence?"

"What the hell? What kind of technique are you using? How could you disappear like this?" They exclaimed in shock as they were unable to sense Zhang Fei's presence, even though he was in front of them.

Zhang Fei then canceled his invisibility and reappeared before them. "Hehe. This is my newest beast's ability after I evolved, and not many people can detect my presence, especially if they don't have sensor abilities, so you don't need to worry about me. Anyway, you guys can move now to capture that guy, or he will run away if we put it off too long."
After that, Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, and Zhang Lingxue immediately left the Chu Clan. Meanwhile, the Wen Twins also left the clan, but Zhang Fei asked them to monitor the Mei Clan.
On the other hand, Zhang Fei had long made plans for Huan Ning, but he decided to go to meet Zhao Ziqin to discuss the matter first, especially since she was her mother.

However, I'm worried about someone, especially since she really hates darkness cultivators, and she has also killed countless of them."
Liu Hua frowned and turned to Zhang Lingxue.
"You mean the Sect Master of the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Yao, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Lingxue responded with a node.
"Big Sister Yao is no less special than Fei'er; I got my bloodline from her.
Unfortunately, their characters are opposite each other, and she might be hostile to him if she finds out his true identity as a lust demon, so I sincerely hope that she won't find out about that.
Besides, she has something unique that no female cultivator has, and his charm will be useless against her, so he must be very careful when meeting her in the future."
Liu Hua suddenly thought of someone.
"Hey, isn't your sister-in-law also not different from Feng Yao?
As I recall, the demons who invaded our realm in the past massacred Zi'er's family, leading to her subsequent hatred towards the darkness cultivator.
"Sigh." Zhang Lingxue let out a deep sigh in response to Liu Hua's comment.
"You're right about her, and Zi'er does hate darkness cultivators so much.
She's different from Big Sister Yao, but I'm not too worried about her, and I'm confident that Fei'er can handle her."
"I hope so."

After they waited for some time, the situation within the Chu Clan gradually returned to normal as the darkness began to dissipate, and Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes after his darkness core entered his body. 'Phew!
I didn't expect that I would have three cores, especially since all the cultivators I met only had single cores, and I'm sure that this isn't without drawbacks, right?'
[You are right, Master.
A cultivator with multiple cores would need more qi to break through compared to a typical single-core cultivator.
However, I'm sure it won't be a significant problem for you because you and your clone have many partners, so your cultivation speed won't be much different from theirs.
Instead, you will be able to cultivate even faster if you add another clone, and all of you can add more partners.]
'Haha.' When he heard that, Zhang Fei laughed, and he himself had actually thought about upgrading his demon body double.
However, he didn't want to use it for cultivation; he wanted to harvest female essence from female demons. 'Hey, Mei, I should have 4000 female essences, right?
I want you to buy the Demon Slave Mark and Demon Transformation II.'
[All right, I will buy both straight away.]
{You got Demon Slave Mark Ability x1} (A/N: You don't need to worry that Zhang Fei will use it carelessly, and he will only use it on truly evil people.)
{You got Demon Transformation II Ability x1}
{3,500 female essence has been deducted from your balance}
After Mei bought both of them, Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction, and he immediately read their descriptions.
[Demon slave mark: If the user instills this slave mark on another person, then that person will completely submit to the user's commands, even if the user asks him or her to commit suicide.
If they have malicious intent toward the user, they will feel excruciating pain throughout their body.]

[Demon Transformation II: This is an upgraded version of demon transformation, and the user can transform himself into various other types of demons, including their demon aura, so he will not be different from the demon he imitates.]
'Haha!

These two new abilities are not bad, and I can use my slave mark on people like Pang Hong, so I can use him to destroy his own clan from within.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered while laughing, but he suddenly remembered something. 'Hey, Mei, what exactly is the use of beast essences besides evolving?
For now, I have 200,000 beast essences, so I think I can use them for something else.'
[Actually, to buy beast techniques, you not only need beast cores, but you also need beast essence to buy some of them, especially high-level beast techniques.
Unfortunately, each of them is very expensive, and you can only use them after you reach three-tails, so I didn't recommend them to you before.
However, now that you've reached three tails, you can purchase one technique.
I believe the most useful technique for you at this point is the invisibility ability.]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after hearing that. 'In that case, you can buy that ability now, Mei.'
[Alrighty.]
{You got the invisibility ability x1}
{150,000 beast essence has been deducted from your balance}

'Cough!' Zhang Fei instantly choked as soon as he saw the price of the new ability, especially since it was incredibly expensive, and he didn't dare imagine the price of other high-level abilities, as he was sure that they would be even more expensive. 'Damn it!
I have to use the essence absorption technique more often, or else I won't be able to afford them.'
[Hahaha!
You're right, master.
There are many more advanced techniques, and their prices are exorbitant.
Furthermore, the need for your beast essence to evolve is increasing, so you must use that ability more often to be able to evolve faster.]
[Invisibility: The user can disappear from the sight of others, and the user will be able to move more freely.
However, this ability is not perfect because humans, demons, or beasts with sensor abilities can still detect the user's presence.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh and nodded in agreement with him.
He then looked at his wives and family, who were approaching him.
"Why are you guys looking at me like that?"
"You cheated, Fei!" Chu Qing was the first to answer him, pouting her lips.
"I had to cultivate for so long to be able to reach my current level, but you can catch up with me in just a few days, and you will definitely leave me far behind soon."
Chu Ying nodded in agreement with her little sister.
"Sooner or later, you will definitely surpass me too, Fei."
"It's not just you, Ying." Ye Lian expressed this sentiment, shaking her head.
"Fei will definitely surpass all of us in a short time, especially since the number of his women will continue to increase, and his clones are also building their own harem.
Unfortunately, we can't learn his clone technique, especially since that is one of his demon abilities; otherwise, we and our clones can dual-cultivate with it continuously.
Not only Ye Lian and the Chu Sisters, but Zhang Lin and the others also felt increasingly left behind by Zhang Fei.
Even so, they were aware that he would never neglect them, so they weren't too worried about it.
Liu Qingyu then spoke to them.
"You guys don't need to feel jealous like that, and you all just need to cultivate harder.
Moreover, Fei'er will continue to help you all, so you don't need to be discouraged like this."
"Fei'er, let's go somewhere else.
We want to discuss some things with you first before we take our next action."

Zhang Fei frowned after hearing Liu Hua's words, but he then asked his grandmother and the others to focus on cultivation first, especially since it was almost time for them to return to earth, and he immediately followed the three senior women and the Wen Twins to another area.

Upon their arrival, Liu Hua immediately explained to Zhang Fei the plans of the Li and Mei Clans, and she also told him about Huan Ning's action to summon the senior members of the Gu Assassins group.
"Huan Ning, huh?

I have to discuss this matter with Ziqin first, so I'll make a decision later, but we have to quickly deal with the people from the Gui Assassins group." Zhang Fei spoke to them while searching for the straw hat man on his map, and discovered him hiding in a fairly remote area.
He promptly informed the five of them of his location.
"Since Li Jue and the others want to poison you guys, I will deal with them directly, and I will make them regret their decision for the rest of their lives."
They could understand Zhang Fei's decision regarding Huan Ning, but Liu Qingyu then posed an inquiry.
"What are your plans for the Li and Mei Clans?"
"Are you confident that you can handle the Li Clan alone?
Li Jue is almost as strong as us, so it will be dangerous for you." Liu Hua said to him worriedly.
"You don't have to worry about that." Zhang Fei replied with a confident smile before using his invisibility ability.
"How is it?
Can you guys feel my presence?"
"What the hell?
What kind of technique are you using?
How could you disappear like this?" They exclaimed in shock as they were unable to sense Zhang Fei's presence, even though he was in front of them.
Zhang Fei then canceled his invisibility and reappeared before them.
"Hehe.
This is my newest beast's ability after I evolved, and not many people can detect my presence, especially if they don't have sensor abilities, so you don't need to worry about me.
Anyway, you guys can move now to capture that guy, or he will run away if we put it off too long."
After that, Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, and Zhang Lingxue immediately left the Chu Clan.
Meanwhile, the Wen Twins also left the clan, but Zhang Fei asked them to monitor the Mei Clan.
On the other hand, Zhang Fei had long made plans for Huan Ning, but he decided to go to meet Zhao Ziqin to discuss the matter first, especially since she was her mother.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Against Two Clans I
paragraphs: In another area of the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei and Zhao Ziqin were standing side by side, and he openly explained to her about Huan Ning's intention to kill him, which was based on her desire to help Zhao Yun get Chu Ying.

Zhao Ziqin's expression became complicated after listening to everything, and she never expected that her mother had repeatedly sent people to kill Zhang Fei. "Are you approaching me because you want to use me to take revenge on them?"

"No." Zhang Fei immediately denied this. "That night, I came to your clan with the sole intention of teaching your mother and big brother a lesson, but I saw you sad and lonely, so I decided to approach you. Moreover, you already knew my other identity, so I knew from the start that you were different from them, and I could see that you had a pure soul.
That's why I didn't have such a plan for you; I approached you because I wanted you to be my woman."

"Did you really not plan anything against me that night?" Zhang Fei responded to her question with a head shake, and Zhao Ziqin asked him again. "What exactly did you do to them that night? Since that day, my mother has kept herself locked up in her room, and my brother also acted strangely when I asked him about her."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed awkwardly and turned to her. "Do you really want to know what I did to them that night?"

"Yes." After thinking about it, Zhang Fei decided to tell her the truth, making Zhao Ziqin stare at him in shock, especially since he had done something crazy by influencing her mother and brother to have sex. "Fei, you are truly insane! Your actions towards them were truly excessive."

"I knew you would think that." Zhang Fei then fell silent for a moment before speaking to her again. "Actually, your mother is not as good as you always think, and she has even had sex with Xuan Yu in the past few days."
"Are you serious?" Zhao Ziqin inquired with a look of disbelief.

"I don't need to lie to you." Zhang Fei then explained to her about the reports of spies from the Hua Assassins who infiltrated the Zhao Clan, shocking Zhao Ziqin even more. "I decided to talk to you about this matter because I have decided to take action against Huan Ning, especially since she has repeatedly tried to kill me and has summoned the Gu Assassins higher-ups just to kill me."
"Are you going to kill my mother, Fei?" Zhao Ziqin inquired in a tone of uncertainty, and she was in a dilemma about whether to side with him or her mother.

"Yes." Without any hesitation, Zhang Fei uttered those words before grabbing her shoulders. "I know how you feel about this matter, but your mother was the one who started all this by sending those assassins to kill me, so I will never spare her.
To tell you the truth, I killed my big brother with my own hands, mainly because he kidnapped one of the people closest to me and collaborated with several people to kill me."

As she continued to stare at him, Zhao Ziqin clenched both of her fists tightly, and her emotions were in complete turmoil after hearing his answer. After all, Huan Ning was her mother, and Zhang Fei was the man she chose to be her husband, so she didn't want her to die in his hands.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and hugged her. "I'm sorry, Ziqin. I know that my decision put you in a complicated situation, but I will never change it. Furthermore, you should already be aware that your family doesn't care about you and only sees you as a tool to fulfill their ambitions, so I hope you can decide what's best for your future.
Even if you hate me after this, I will still kill Huan Ning."
After he said that, Zhang Fei released Zhao Ziqin from his embrace and sent a message to Boitata to follow him. He also asked his other women to comfort her before disappearing from her sight.

Shortly after his departure, Zhang Lin, along with several other women, approached Zhao Ziqin. "Big Sis, all actions have consequences, and your mother has tried to kill my big brother again and again, so she has to bear the consequences for her actions."

"Lin'er's right, Ziqin." Chu Ying also spoke to her. "The source of this problem lies with your mother, and this kind of situation would never have happened if she didn't send those assassins to kill Fei."

Chu Qing also stepped in to persuade Zhao Ziqin. "Big Sis, your family doesn't even care about your feelings, and they forced you to marry Xuan Yu for their status, so you don't have to think about their fate. If you choose them, then you won't be able to refuse their wishes, and you will lose Fei forever."

"Moreover, you already know a lot about Fei, and you should already know which of them is better for you." Ye Lian then put her arm around Zhao Ziqing's shoulders. "That's why you should think things over carefully, lest you regret taking the wrong decision."

Naturally, Zhao Ziqin understood the truth of their words, and her family never cared about her feelings. Even so, they were still her family, and she didn't have the heart to see them die at the hands of the man she chose, which would make her continue to feel guilty if that really happened.
"I'm sorry, but I want to think things over first, and I want to try to persuade my mother to stop her action, so I will return to my clan right now."

Afterwards, Zhao Ziqin hurriedly left the Chu Clan, and none of them had any intention of stopping her. After all, they had tried to convince her, but the decision for her future lay in her own hands, and they couldn't force her to choose between Zhang Fei and her family.
"What do you think will happen to her?" Ye Lian questioned the three women.

Chu Ying was the first to respond by shaking her head. "I can't say for sure, but they will probably lock her up in their clan, and we can't do anything to help her, especially since our cultivation is still too low compared to those people. If we follow her to the Zhao Clan now, then they might capture us, and we will add trouble for Fei, so we can only wait here."

"Even so, we have to tell Fei about this matter, Big Sis. That way, he can think of a way to help her, or else Xuan Yu will take her away." Chu Ying nodded in agreement with Chu Qing, so she immediately sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei and informed him of Zhao Ziqin's decision.

Zhang Fei, who had arrived above the Li Clan, let out a heavy sigh after hearing Chu Ying's message. Even so, he couldn't blame Zhao Ziqin for deciding to return to her clan, but he chose to ignore it and focus on his goals first.

Zhang Fei then opened his map to spot the locations of the clan's people, and he used his divine senses to check them directly. "Heh! They seem to still be fast asleep, so this will make it easier for me to act on them."
[Are you going to move now, Master?]

"Yeah, I'll take care of them right now, and I hope none of them have sensor abilities, or it will be troublesome for me." Zhang Fei then turned to Boitata, who was standing beside him. "Wait here, and you only need to act if I'm in danger."
"All right." Boitata answered with a nod.
After that, Zhang Fei immediately used his invisibility ability to infiltrate the Li clan, and his first destination was Li Ming's room.

When he arrived there, Zhang Fei smiled faintly, approached Li Ming on his bed, and sealed his cultivation before knocking him unconscious. However, he was hesitant to use the heart fissure pills that Liu Hua gave him, especially since he didn't want to kill them too soon and wanted to torture them first. 'Hey, Mei! Are there any useful pills in the shop?'
[Hmm? There is one pill that is quite useful, Master. The name of the pill is the crippling pill, and it will cripple their cultivation instantly if they swallow it.]
'You're really cruel, huh? However, I like your idea, so you can buy the pill now.'
[Alrighty.]
{You got Crippling Pill x5}
{25,000 Red Jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

After he took it, Zhang Fei immediately put the pill into Li Ming's mouth and forced him to swallow it, and he then waited for the pill's effect to take effect first. Even so, he didn't have to wait too long, and he could already feel that his cultivation was slowly disappearing. 'Tch! That pill is too terrifying, and its effects work so quickly!'

After Li Ming became crippled, Zhang Fei took him to another room, which was Li Lian's room. He felt relieved after entering the room, especially since she was still sleeping soundly and didn't notice his presence. 'Show her status, Mei.'

Age: 45
Race: Human

Dislikes: Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu

'Oh?' When Zhang Fei saw Chu Hong's name on Li Lian's status, he was momentarily stunned. 'Hey, I didn't expect that she was interested in Qingyu's husband, so it's no surprise that she hates her, and she hates Hua'er definitely because of her actions towards her nephew.'
[What will you do to this woman, Master? Are you going to implant your demon slave mark on her?]

'No.' Zhang Fei immediately rejected that. 'Mei, look at her status. She's almost as old as Qingyu and Hua'er, but her cultivation still hasn't broken through to the Earth Realm, and her other stats are also low-level, which means her talent in cultivation isn't comparable to theirs, so she won't be of any use to me.'

[Well, that's true. Liu Hua's talent is actually better than Liu Qingyu, and she is not inferior to Zhang Lingxue, but she fell under Pang Hong's control for so long, so her cultivation was unable to improve, or else she would have been much stronger now.]

In the end, Zhang Fei decided to seal Li Lian's cultivation, but she suddenly opened her eyes as soon as she felt his touch. However, she felt confused because she didn't see anyone there, so she immediately sat on the side of the bed and tried to check around her room, but her face turned pale after realizing that her cultivation was sealed.

"Are you confused by that?" Zhang Fei inquired as he appeared in front of Li Lian, but he immediately grabbed her by the neck as soon as she was about to scream. "Hey, you certainly didn't think that I would allow you to alert them, right? For now, you are still useful to me, so I won't kill you outright.
However, you and the members of this clan are already vassals of the Pang Clan, and you guys are planning to poison my wives in the Chu Clan, so all of you have to pay a heavy price for it."

After listening to Zhang Fei's words, Li Lian was in shock, and she grabbed her hand to try to remove her stranglehold from her neck, but she didn't have the ability to do so with her sealed cultivation. "Ugh! Who are you? How did you manage to sneak in here? Why did you do this to me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Against Two Clans II
paragraphs: "I am Zhang Fei, the husband of Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Liu Hua. So you should already know the reason I infiltrated this clan and did this to you, right?" Li Lian was even more shocked after hearing his answer.

"I will never forgive anyone who has malicious intentions towards them, and your clan has also become an accomplice to the Pang Clan, which compounds your mistakes, so all of you must die to bear the consequences of your actions."

Boitata nodded to him. "Yes, this old man should be the last one, Master."

"Also, we took the ownership documents of all the buildings belonging to this clan, and they will be yours." Wen Xuan then asked him. "So, what are your plans next? Are we going to the Zhou Clan now?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "Ziqin has almost arrived at the Zhao Clan, and I don't want anything to happen to her. Moreover, people from the Gui Assassins group have also arrived there, along with a woman named Qiao Ran."
"Qiao Ran?" The Wen Twins frowned, as they hadn't anticipated that she would also come alone. "That woman is Huan Ning's mother, and she is the true leader of that group."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and hugged the three women, and he immediately took them away from the Mei Clan using his teleportation ability.

sentences.text: "Argh!" Mei Xiang screamed in even more pain as Zhang Fei pulled her hair up hard.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly at Mei Xiang's pained expression.
"Did you enjoy the pain?
You will continue to feel this kind of pain if you have bad intentions towards me or people related to me."
"What?" Mei Xian exclaimed in shock after hearing that.
"Who... who are you?
Why... why are you doing this to me?"
"Heh!
You guys are truly ungrateful rabid dogs!" Zhang Fei said it with a loud snort.
"This matter began because you failed to properly educate your second son, which led to him becoming arrogant and using his grandfather's name for his own actions.
As a result, Hua'er harshly punished him.
Unfortunately, you didn't realize your mistake, and you actually planned sinister schemes against her and the others.

Furthermore, the Chu and Liu Clans have helped your clans prosper, but you all want to bite them back by collaborating with the Pang Clan to poison them, as well as hand them over to those rotten people.

"You... you..." Mei Xiang was so frightened that she couldn't speak, imagining her fate of becoming a slave, which was the most terrible punishment for her.

Zhang Fei then turned Mei Xiang's face towards the bed, making her eyes widen in shock to see her husband and father-in-law acting so wildly by fucking a woman at the same time, but she couldn't recognize the woman's identity.
"Do you recognize that woman?
She is Li Ming, and I used something to turn him into a woman.
Unfortunately, they will never realize their situation because I used my abilities to influence them, and they will continue doing this until all three of them die of exhaustion."
Mei Xiang was even more shocked after listening to Zhang Fei's words, and she didn't understand how he would do such a thing to her second son.
However, she realized that the woman was indeed her second son, especially after she saw the same birthmark on her arm as her son's.
Seeing that her expression was getting more and more miserable, Zhang Fei let go of Mei Xiang's hair.
"Anyway, my name is Zhang Fei, and I will be your master from now on.
Aside from that, I am Chu Qing, Chu Ying, and Hua'er's husband, so you will serve them as a servant.
From now on, you'd better be thoughtful in your actions, or you will continue to suffer because of the slave mark I implanted in your soul."
Mei Xiang then turned to Zhang Fei with eyes full of tears, but not a single word could come out of her mouth to beg him after she saw the evil smile on his face.

However, as soon as Botitata appeared in the room, her face turned completely pale, especially since Li Yuan's head was in her hands with blood flowing from his neatly cut neck, and he died with his eyes wide in fright.
"Blargh!" Instantly, Mei Xiang vomited on the floor because of that gruesome sight, and she once again fell unconscious because the situation in front of her dealt a severe blow to her mind and soul.
"Master, if you don't do something to this woman, she will probably die.

Maybe she will also go crazy if she wakes up later, and she will be of no use to you." Even so, Zhang Fei didn't worry too much and squatted down by Mei Xiang's side before channeling his light qi into her body and ordering Boitata to obliterate Li Yuan's head.
"Anyway, what are you going to do with those three?"

"I've already crippled their cultivation, and they'll stay like that until they die." After he said that, Zhang Fei took out his portable mansion and sent Mei Xiang into it, and he asked Shi Wu and Shi Xi to look after him.
He then took the three men's storage rings, and he also took Boitata to clean out the clan's treasure room.
"Have you cleared out the Li Clan?" As soon as Zhang Fei appeared in front of them, Wei Yuan asked him.

"Li Yuan and Li Lian are dead, and Mei Xiang is in my hands.
Furthermore, the crippled state of those three men indicates their imminent death, thereby ending the Li Clan's existence in this city.
As they took a deep breath, the Wen Twins looked at Zhang Fei in shock, as they did not expect that he would completely wipe out the Li Clan.
"Why are you two looking at me like that?" Zhang Fei asked while hugging the Wen Twins and kissing their lips in turns, and they didn't refuse, especially since they've been intimate with him before.
"Do you guys feel that killing them is too cruel of me?"
"Yes." Wen Xuan nodded to him.
"At first, we thought that you would only kill their important people, but instead you killed them all."
Wen Yuan nodded in agreement with her twin sister, then asked him again.
"What are your intentions for the Mei Clan?
Are you going to wipe them all out, too?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei answered her question without the slightest hesitation.
"If we leave a few of them, then they will bring many other problems for us in the future, so it would be better if we move now and clear them out at once."

Two daggers pierced the hearts of a couple in the third bedroom, leaving them covered in blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Capture
paragraphs: Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, and Zhang Lingxue stood side by side on top of a large tree, their eyes fixed on the cave not far from their location, which was the straw hat man's hiding place.
"Lingxue, it seems we have to rely on you, especially since that man's cultivation is at 5-Star Earth Realm, so Hua'er and I are not his opponents."
Zhang Lingxue answered Liu Qingyu with a nod. "Leave him to me, but I still don't understand why Fei'er wants this man alive; could it be that she wants to do something to him?"

"Hahaha." Liu Hua laughed softly and turned to her. "Even though Fei'er is our man, he is still secretive from us in some ways. Moreover, he still has many strange abilities, such as the invisibility ability that he showed us earlier, so I think he has his own plans for this man, and we'll find out once we've captured him."

"That's true; Fei'er is indeed too mysterious." Zhang Lingxue nodded in agreement with her. "Even so, I think it's a good thing, especially since many of his abilities are too absurd, so it would be better for him if not many people knew all his secrets, including us."
"Shall we go in now?"
"The sooner the better." After that, the Liu Sisters suppressed their presence, and Zhang Lingxue very carefully led them into the cave.

Even though their opponent was only one person, the three of them still acted carefully to avoid falling into the straw hat man's trap, especially since the people from the Pang Clan were too cunning and had many abnormal abilities.

Inside the cave, the straw hat man sat cross-legged, but his expression became irritated because his master kept urging him to quickly capture the people from the Chu Clan and destroy the Hua Assassins group. Unfortunately, the two people he chose to carry out those tasks still hadn't given him any news, as the woman had died two days ago, and Li Jue was also on the verge of death.

"That Li Jue is such a bastard! I've waited two days, but he still hasn't reported to me about the task I gave him." The man in the straw hat said it in an angry tone. "Tsk! That woman, too, is useless! She actually died in their hands!

However, I still don't understand how Liu Hua and the others could have seen through her actions, or whether I was too careless and didn't realize the presence of their other spies. If that's really true, then there's a big possibility that she already knows about my other plans.
Sigh, I'd better leave this place now, but my master will definitely punish me severely if I do fail to carry out his orders."

Just as the straw hat man was thinking about that, a red rope rushed towards him, startling him. Unfortunately, he didn't have time to dodge it, especially since a powerful aura from Zhang Lingxue directly pressed down on him from above, and their significant cultivation difference rendered him helpless.

Quickly, the red rope wrapped around the straw hat man's body, which immediately drained his strength at a fast pace, and the knot became tighter as he struggled. 'Fuck! What kind of rope is this? How can this drain my strength?
Moreover, this aura definitely doesn't belong to Liu Qingyu or Liu Hua, especially since my cultivation is still above theirs, so they wouldn't be able to suppress me like this.'
*Tap... Tap...*

The straw hat man's eyes immediately widened when he saw Zhang Lingxue walking leisurely towards him, followed by Liu Qingyu and Liu Hua. 'Shit! Why is the young miss of the Zhang Clan in this city? How can they find my hiding place? I didn't even tell Li Jue about this cave, so they shouldn't be able to find me, even if they captured him.'

"Are you confused about how we can find you?" Zhang Lingxue asked as she crouched beside him and sealed his cultivation directly, especially since Zhang Fei wanted him alive. "Hey, you are too confident in your ability to hide, but you don't know that there is a monster by our side. Not only your hiding place, but that person was also able to discover the hiding place of your master.

Luckily, he is far away in the northern region, so we can't do anything to him now. However, your case is different because that person wants you alive, so I can't kill you now, but you will feel suffering that you have never experienced before at the hands of that person."
Before he could say anything, Zhang Lingxue had already knocked the man in the straw hat unconscious, but she did not remove the red rope from his body.

"I still don't understand how this man could fall into Pang Hong's hands, especially since his cultivation was several minor stages higher than his." Liu Qingyu said to the two women as he observed the straw-hat man.

Liu Hua also squatted beside the straw hat man and examined his body; he found a plaque with the words Guan written on it. "Big Sis, this person is a member of the Guan Clan in the eastern region, so I think that clan has become a vassal of the Pang Clan now."

After hearing that, Liu Qingyu sighed heavily. "All the cultivators in this realm already know that the Pang Clan is a heretical clan, and they are our eternal enemy, but they instead gave in to their greed and joined them."
"Do you think we should inform the other clans in the eastern region about this matter?" Zhang Lingxue asked them.

However, Liu Hua immediately rejected Zhang Lingxue's idea. "For now, we still don't have information about which clans have submitted to the Pang Clan, so we can't spread this information rashly. Otherwise, not only do we have to face those heretics, but we also have to face the people from the other clans, so we have to keep this information to ourselves for now."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Lingxue replied with a nod of approval. "Even so, I will inform my father about this matter after I return to my clan later, so he can send some strong cultivators from our clan to monitor them, and we might be able to get information about the clans that have already joined that heretic clan."

"You can do that." Liu Hua then lifted the straw-hat man from the ground and handed him to Liu Qingyu. "Big Sis, you can take this man back to our clan, but Lingxue and I have to go to the Zhao Clan now, especially since the people from the Gu Assassins have gathered there, including Qiao Ran, so we will help Fei'er and the Wen Twins."
After that, they took the straw hat man away from the cave, and Liu Qingyu brought him back to the Chu Clan. On the other side, Liu Hua and Zhang Lingxue rushed towards the Zhao Clan.

Zhao Ziqin, who had just arrived at the Zhao Clan main hall, was surprised when she saw her grandmother there. However, she felt that something was wrong with their expressions, especially her brother, who looked so angry. However, she didn't see her mother and Xuan Yu there, making her think that Zhang Fei's previous words were true, and they did have such a relationship.

Qiao Ran's age was indeed very old, but like the other female cultivators, she still looked quite young thanks to her already high cultivation level. Her figure is quite tall and curvaceous; her breasts are truly big around E-Cup, and her buttocks still look full.
Qiao Ran immediately stood up from her seat and walked over to Zhao Ziqin. "It's been quite a while since I last saw you, and I almost couldn't recognize you as you became more mature and beautiful."
However, Zhao Ziqin was at a loss to respond to her grandmother, especially since she still remembered Zhang Fei's words that she came together with her subordinates to kill him.
"Why are you silent? Aren't you happy to meet me?" Qiao Ran asked him.
*Tap... Tap...*

Suddenly, they heard some footsteps and saw Huan Ning walking into the main hall, but her expression looked tired, in contrast to Xuan Yu, who looked happy and excited after dual-cultivating with her.
However, Xuan Yu's gaze suddenly fell on Zhao Ziqin, and he immediately moved in front of her, knocking her unconscious and carrying her on his shoulders.

Even though Qiao Ran and the people from the Zhao Clan were irritated by Xuan Yu's actions, none of them had any intention of stopping him, especially since they needed help from his Xuan Clan, so it was no problem for them to sacrifice Zhao Ziqin.

Huan Ning casually said this to Xuan Yu. "You have my daughter now, so it would be better if you take her to the Central Region right now, or else Zhang Lingxue and the others will find out about this matter and snatch her from you again."

"Haha." Xuan Yu laughed at that and squeezed Huan Ning's buttocks, making Zhao Yun frown. "Hey, I've managed to get your daughter now, but I enjoyed dual-cultivating with you, and I still want to do it again with you. How about you forget your husband and go with me to my clan? That way, you can join us in dual cultivation, and I will satisfy both of you at once."

"Bastard!" Zhao Yun's anger immediately exploded after hearing that, and he moved to attack Xuan Yu. However, Qiao Ran immediately restricted his movements, especially since he was much stronger than him, and she didn't want her grandson to die in his hands. "Grandma! Let me go! I have to kill this bastard! He's done dirty things to my mother!"
"Yun'er, you-"

They wanted to persuade him, but Xuan Yu suddenly released his aura towards Zhao Yun, causing him to fall to the ground. "Do you think a weakling like you can kill me? It seems you've forgotten about the lesson I gave you a few days ago, huh? In that case, I will teach you an even more severe lesson, so you will never dare act impudent in front of me again."
"Young master Xuan!" Qiao Ran exclaimed softly as she used her aura to dispel Xuan Yu's. "I don't mean to be rude to you, but Yun'er is our only male descendant, so I hope you can spare him."

"Hmm?" Xuan Yu turned to Qiao Ran and narrowed his eyes as he felt irritated by her actions, but he ultimately nodded in agreement with her. "All right, I will spare this weakling this once, but you guys better educate him better so he knows his place. Otherwise, I won't care about that anymore, and I will kill him straight away if he dares to be impudent in front of me again."

Qiao Ran, Huan Ning, and Huan Chong breathed a sigh of relief because of that, especially since they really didn't want Zhao Yun to die. Meanwhile, Zhao Yun, who was already in his mother's arms, continued to angrily stare at Xuan Yu.

However, Xuan Yu no longer cared about Zhao Yun and walked away from the clan's main hall. He immediately took out his flying artifact to return to his clan in the Central Region. Unfortunately, before he could get the unconscious Zhao Ziqin to board it, she had already disappeared from his shoulders.
Not only was Xuan Yu shocked when he saw that, but even Qiao Ran and the others were also shocked by Zhao Ziqin's disappearance, and they immediately spread their senses to all corners of the clan.

However, they couldn't detect the intruder's presence in the clan, especially since Zhang Fei's teleportation ability was an instant movement, and Boitata also disguised his presence with her aura, so he was able to fool them easily.
*Boom*
Xuan Yu's aura instantly exploded, and his face became extremely red as his anger overflowed. "Who's there? Come out! Fight me like a man!"

However, Xuan Yu's gaze suddenly fell on Zhao Ziqin, and he immediately moved in front of her, knocking her unconscious and carrying her on his shoulders.

Even though Qiao Ran and the people from the Zhao Clan were irritated by Xuan Yu's actions, none of them had any intention of stopping him, especially since they needed help from his Xuan Clan, so it was no problem for them to sacrifice Zhao Ziqin.
Huan Ning casually said this to Xuan Yu.
"You have my daughter now, so it would be better if you take her to the Central Region right now, or else Zhang Lingxue and the others will find out about this matter and snatch her from you again."
"Haha." Xuan Yu laughed at that and squeezed Huan Ning's buttocks, making Zhao Yun frown.
"Hey, I've managed to get your daughter now, but I enjoyed dual-cultivating with you, and I still want to do it again with you.
How about you forget your husband and go with me to my clan?
That way, you can join us in dual cultivation, and I will satisfy both of you at once."
"Bastard!" Zhao Yun's anger immediately exploded after hearing that, and he moved to attack Xuan Yu.
However, Qiao Ran immediately restricted his movements, especially since he was much stronger than him, and she didn't want her grandson to die in his hands.
"Grandma!
Let me go!
I have to kill this bastard!
He's done dirty things to my mother!"
"Yun'er, you-"
They wanted to persuade him, but Xuan Yu suddenly released his aura towards Zhao Yun, causing him to fall to the ground.
"Do you think a weakling like you can kill me?
It seems you've forgotten about the lesson I gave you a few days ago, huh?
In that case, I will teach you an even more severe lesson, so you will never dare act impudent in front of me again."
"Young master Xuan!" Qiao Ran exclaimed softly as she used her aura to dispel Xuan Yu's.
"I don't mean to be rude to you, but Yun'er is our only male descendant, so I hope you can spare him."
"Hmm?" Xuan Yu turned to Qiao Ran and narrowed his eyes as he felt irritated by her actions, but he ultimately nodded in agreement with her.
"All right, I will spare this weakling this once, but you guys better educate him better so he knows his place.
Otherwise, I won't care about that anymore, and I will kill him straight away if he dares to be impudent in front of me again."
Qiao Ran, Huan Ning, and Huan Chong breathed a sigh of relief because of that, especially since they really didn't want Zhao Yun to die.
Meanwhile, Zhao Yun, who was already in his mother's arms, continued to angrily stare at Xuan Yu.
However, Xuan Yu no longer cared about Zhao Yun and walked away from the clan's main hall.
He immediately took out his flying artifact to return to his clan in the Central Region.
Unfortunately, before he could get the unconscious Zhao Ziqin to board it, she had already disappeared from his shoulders.
Not only was Xuan Yu shocked when he saw that, but even Qiao Ran and the others were also shocked by Zhao Ziqin's disappearance, and they immediately spread their senses to all corners of the clan.

However, they couldn't detect the intruder's presence in the clan, especially since Zhang Fei's teleportation ability was an instant movement, and Boitata also disguised his presence with her aura, so he was able to fool them easily.
*Boom*
Xuan Yu's aura instantly exploded, and his face became extremely red as his anger overflowed.
"Who's there?
Come out!
Fight me like a man!"

chapters.title: Chapter 173: One Side Battle
paragraphs: Zhang Fei, who was hiding in the distance under Boitata's protection along with the Wen Twins, paid no attention to Xuan Yu's screams. Instead, he channeled his light qi into Zhao Ziqin's body to wake her up. "Fortunately, I wasn't late, or she would have been taken away by that bastard to the Central Region, and it would be troublesome to bring her back here." 'Hey, Mei, show Qiao Ran's status.'
[Yes, Master.]
Name: Qiao Ran
Age: 72
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 3-Star Earth Realm
Element: Poison [Intermediate Stage]
Core: High-Rank Poison Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Huan Jingtian (in-name)
Likes: Qiao Fei, Huan Ning, Zhao Yun, and Zhao Ziqin.
Dislikes: Liu Rong, Liu Ming, Chu Hong, and many more

'Poison element, huh?' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered with an evil smile on his face, making Mei laugh out loud in his mind. 'Hey! You don't have to laugh so loud, okay? She is quite strong, and her status is not bad. Moreover, her poison element will be very useful for me, so I will use my demon slave mark on her.'

"Master, this little girl is really pitiful. Her family clearly had the ability to stop that little brat, but instead they allowed him to take her away." Boitata suddenly commented while watching them.
The Wen Twins also felt sorry for Zhao Ziqin's situation, but they chose not to comment on the matter, and they only hoped that she could make the best decision for his future after he woke up.

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Boitata, particularly since Huan Ning and Huan Chong were already stronger than Xuan Yu, and Qiao Ran was even stronger with her cultivation at 3-Star Earth Realm. "They never thought about Ziqin's feelings, and they cared more about the status of their three clans than her."
Before long, Zhao Ziqin opened her eyes, and she immediately hugged Zhang Fei as soon as she saw him. "Fei, I-"

"It's okay; I'm here, so you're safe now." Zhao Ziqin gave a slight nod, exhaling a breath of relief, and Zhang Fei resumed his conversation with her. "I can understand your feelings for your family, but they don't even care about you.
They should have been able to stop Xuan Yu from doing that to you, but they didn't do it because you were just a tool for them, so I hope you won't stop me from destroying them."

Zhao Ziqin's heart tightened at Zhang Fei's words, but she was fully aware that his words were facts because her family was strong enough to stop Xuan Yu, especially her grandmother. However, they chose to remain silent and let him knock her unconscious; if not for his rescue, she would have been taken away to the Central Region.

"Look at them." Zhao Ziqin immediately turned towards her clan and saw people from the Gu Assassins appearing there, plus she could hear that his mother and grandmother ordered them to attack the Chu Clan to capture Zhang Fei and the others. "Honestly, this matter would have been too trivial if your mother hadn't sent them to kill me, especially since it started with my relationship with Chu Ying.
Unfortunately, she decided to take such a route to settle the matter, and it was impossible for me to forgive the person who wanted to kill me."

Suddenly, two other women landed beside them, but both let out soft sighs when they saw Zhao Ziqin's expression, and Liu Hua then spoke to him. "Fei'er, they seem to be moving soon, so we have to act now, and we will settle everything in this place."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement and lifted Zhao Ziqin to her feet. "What about that guy? Did you manage to capture him?"

"We've captured him, and Qingyu brought him to the Chu Clan so you could take care of him later." Zhang Lingxue then spoke to Zhao Ziqin. "If you don't want to witness their fall, you can leave for the Central Region first with my flying artifact, and I'll catch up with you after I help Fei'er deal with these people."
"No! I'll stay here." After he rejected Zhang Lingxue, Zhao Ziqin turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you really going to kill them all?"

"Honestly, I originally wanted to kill them all, but I had something else in mind, which would make them suffer more." Zhao Ziqin and the others raised their eyebrows at Zhang Fei. "Even if I don't kill them, you still won't be able to meet them again, because I plan to send them to another realm, and that realm is not a human realm but a demon realm."
"Huh?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at their expressions. "I've never shown it to you guys, but I have access to another realm, which is the Netherworld Realm. However, I've never been there myself, so I don't know for sure about the situation in that place, and only the demons live there."
"What happens if you send them there, Fei'er?" Liu Hua asked with a serious look, and the other five also looked at him while waiting for his answer.
[Master, there is a possibility that they will turn into demons, especially since the demon aura in that place will affect them if they stay there too long.]

'Oh?' Hearing that momentarily took Zhang Fei aback, especially since he had sent Qin Feng and the others there, but he didn't dwell on their fate. 'Does that mean the previous people will also turn into demons?'

[Yes, I think they will turn into demons. However, Qin Feng and the others are ordinary humans, so they are unlikely to be able to fight against the demons, and they are probably dead by now. Moreover, when you asked me to open the portal to the Netherworld Realm last time, I couldn't detect Qi's presence, so Huan Ning and the others wouldn't be able to cultivate there.]

A faint smile immediately appeared on his face after hearing that, and Zhang Fei then informed them according to Mei's answer. However, they didn't seem surprised by that, especially since demons from another realm had invaded their realm in the past, and they could also turn people into demons.

Zhao Ziqin released a heavy sigh and held Zhang Fei's hand. "I know you hate them, but I don't want to see them die in your hands. After all, they are my family, so you can send them away there. They are also cultivators, so they should be able to protect themselves and look for a way to survive the demons."

Zhang Fei felt completely satisfied with Zhao Ziqin's decision, and he then briefly kissed her lips before asking the five women to move, especially since those people were about to leave the Zhao Clan. "I'm sorry, Ziqin. I-"

Zhao Ziqin immediately stopped Zhang Fei, covering her mouth with her hands. "At first, I found it hard to believe that they wanted to use me as a tool, but I've realized everything now. Even though I must be sad about losing them, I don't want to continue being treated like that by them. That's why I made such a decision and chose you over them, so you don't need to apologize to me."
Zhang Fei nodded and immediately took Zhao Ziqin's hand. "Let's join them. Since Xuan Yu dares to try to take you away by force, I won't spare him either."
Just as they were about to leave the Zhao Clan, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins immediately attacked the group of Gui Assassins, and the battle between them soon began.
Liu Hua directly targeted assassins with cultivation at the Soul Realm, while the Wen Twins targeted those with cultivation at the Core Realm, making the battle between them unbalanced.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lingxue confronted Huan Ning and Huan Chong, who immediately took out their weapons to face her.
"Zhang Lingxue!" Hua Ning shouted angrily as soon as she saw her. "You bitch! I will kill you today to repay all the humiliations you gave me in the past."

"Ha ha." Zhang Lingxue laughed softly as red clothes with two daggers on the ends appeared in her hand. "You were not my opponent in the past, and you are not my opponent in the present, especially given the difference in our current cultivation.

However, I did not expect that your arrogance and stupidity have never changed, and you have already committed a grave mistake by sending people to kill my husband, which will end the existence of this clan today."
"Bitch! I'll kill you!" Huan Ning immediately made her move without thinking twice, followed by Huan Chong, who intended to help his cousin attack Zhang Lingxue.

Zhang Lingxue, on the other hand, was still relaxed watching them attack her simultaneously, but a phoenix silhouette appeared behind her as soon as she activated her fire phoenix bloodline, which quickly made the area within the clan hot.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Instantly, two fireballs shot towards Huan Ning and Huan Chong, but they immediately dodged both of them sideways before moving again towards Zhang Lingxue.

Seeing that, Zhang Lingxue decided to fly into the sky, but the two people immediately chased after her, and the fight between them broke out in the air. However, it was clear that she was not experiencing the slightest distress; she was just playing around with the two of them, which made Huan Ning even more annoyed and dark-eyed.

Qiao Ran, who wanted to move to help them, suddenly stopped in his tracks, especially since Boitata strangled her neck from behind and sealed her cultivation directly. 'What the hell? I didn't notice her presence before! Moreover, her cultivation seems to be higher than my mother's, and she can stop me so easily.'
As for Zhao Yun, he had already fallen unconscious on the chair, especially after Boitata hit him on the back of the neck from behind.

"Do you understand the situation now?" Boitata asked in a whisper into Qiao Ran's ear. "In fact, I can kill all of you without breaking a sweat, but my master has other plans for you and your family, so I can't kill you now."
"Who is your master? Why are you interfering in our affairs?"

"Are you senile now?" Boitata turned to ask, strengthening his grip on Qiao Ran's neck. "Didn't you already know my master's identity? My master is Zhang Fei, and Huan Ning tried to kill him several times before, so he will destroy this clan today.
As for you, my master is interested in you, so you will not suffer this fate as badly as they are, but you will be his slave and serve him for the rest of your life."

"What?" Qiao Ran exclaimed in shock after hearing that. Of course, she, like most people, doesn't want to be someone else's slave, especially since such a life is truly terrible. "No! I don't want to be anyone's slave! Please let me go, and I won't bother your master again."

"Hehehe." Boitata took out a cloth before stuffing it in her mouth, and she then took Qiao Ran to sit on a chair to watch Liu Hua and the Wen Twins slaughter her subordinates. Regrettably, it's too late for you, as you've already sealed your fate by bringing your subordinates into this clan.

Therefore, you should remain here and patiently wait for my master to settle his business with that little brat from the Xuan Clan. Moreover, you don't know much about his abilities yet, and you will definitely enjoy yourself so much once you become his slave."

'Damn it! Why did things turn out like this? Where did that bastard find a strong cultivator like her?' Qiao Ran cursed in her heart, her expression filled with pain as she watched the subordinates she had trained for so long fall one by one.
