chapters.title: Chapter 174: Killing Xuan Yu
paragraphs: As soon as Zhang Fei appeared in front of him in his half-fox form, Xuan Yu's face darkened, especially since Zhao Ziqin was in his arms.

However, Xuan Yu burst out laughing after he sensed Zhang Fei's cultivation. "Hahaha! I originally thought you would be as strong as those women, but it turns out you are so weak! Do you believe you can beat me with your current cultivation? I'll kill you first, and then I'll take that bitch with me to the central region."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei then used the Soul Connect with Boitata, which allowed him to gain half of her power. The significant increase in his power was sufficient to face Xuan Yu, whose cultivation was at the 10-Star Soul Realm. "What about now?"
'What the fuck! How could his cultivation skyrocket so suddenly?' Xuan Yu muttered as he took several steps back, fully aware that he would not be able to face the current Zhang Fei.

In fact, the current Zhang Fei can even deal with cultivators at 10-Star Earth Realm easily, especially since Boitata's cultivation is at 10-Star Heaven Realm, reversing the difference between their strengths.
'Damn it! I have to escape right now, or I will die in his hands!' Xuan Yu immediately took out his returning jade.

However, Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of him, snatching the returning jade before Xuan Yu had a chance to break it. He immediately threw a powerful fist at his chest, knocking him backwards before slamming into the wall.

"Guah!" Xuan Yu immediately fell to the ground and vomited a mouthful of blood. He clutched his painful chest while inwardly grumbling. 'Fuck! I've never had such a heavy punch before! Even my father's blows weren't as heavy and painful as his!'

After all, Zhang Fei's heavenly body tempering had already upgraded to silver level when he broke through to the Core Realm, which increased his body strength by 30% and his attack power by 20% compared to ordinary cultivators. In addition, he is also in a soul-connected state with Boitata, enhancing his strength even further.
Zhang Fei casually stood at his spot with a faint smile on his face, and he then crushed the returning jade in his hand so that Xuan Yu would no longer be able to escape.

'Shit! I have to think of another way to escape from this place!' After he wiped the blood from his mouth, Xuan Yu immediately got up from the ground, but he still felt excruciating pain in his chest. 'Ugh! His attack seems to have just broken my sternum!'

"Hey, you don't need to think of a way to escape; you will never be able to escape from me without your returning jade." Zhang Fei then stretched his hand forward and made a gesture to lure Xuan Yu. "Weren't you previously so confident in your strength? Why are you acting so cowardly now?
Apparently, you're just a coward who can only rely on the power of your clan, and you can't do anything without their help."

"Bastards!" After hearing that, Xuan Yu's anger instantly overflowed, especially since there had never been anyone who dared to belittle him like that except for his seniors in the sect. He immediately took out two small spears and released his aura before moving to attack Zhang Fei, but he just shook his head and dodged his attacks with his teleportation ability. 'Shit! How could he move that fast?
Even my grandfather couldn't move so fast!'
The moment he thought that, Zhang Fei had already appeared right behind Xuan Yu and punched his back with a powerful punch, causing a loud cracking sound to be heard from his back.
*Crack*
However, Zhang Fei didn't stop there; he swiftly kicked both of Xuan Yu's legs from behind, causing more cracking sounds.
*Crack... Crack...*
"Argh!" Zhang Fei immediately stepped on Xuan Yu's back after breaking both of his legs, causing him to feel extreme pain throughout his body. "Argh!"

Zhao Ziqin, who watched this from a distance, immediately closed her eyes. She didn't expect that Zhang Fei would torture Xuan Yu to such an extent, but she somehow felt happy with it because he was doing it for her, especially since he previously intended to take her away by force.

Despite his situation, Xuan Yu maintained his arrogance and attempted to intimidate Zhang Fei. "Argh! Let me go now! You will feel the anger of my father and grandfather if you hurt me more than this, let alone if you dare kill me; they will slaughter your entire family!"

"Hahaha!" Instead, Zhang Fei laughed at Xuan Yu's threat, and he then spoke to him in a mocking tone. "Did you forget that I have Zhang Lingxue by my side? She is my wife, so I am now a member of her Zhang clan. If you can rely on your clan's strength to act as you please, then I can rely on their strength to destroy your family, right?"

"What?" Xuan Yu was truly shocked to hear Zhang Fei say that Zhang Lingxue was his wife, especially since everyone in the Central Region knew that she had never been willing to get close to any man, so she had never had a lover before. "Bastard! You must be bragging! There's no way she's willing to be your wife!"

"It's up to you to believe it or not." Zhang Fei then squatted down and touched Xuan Yu's back. "However, one thing is certain: you will die today, but I will not kill you; you will commit suicide, so your family will never know that you died because of me."
After he said that, Zhang Fei used his demon slave mark on Xuan Yu, which made him panic, especially when he felt something unknown appear in his soul.

"Stop! What are you doing to me!?" Xuan Yu screamed as he struggled to get away from him, but Zhang Fei had restricted his movements, and his current strength was higher than his, rendering him helpless under his feet. "Stop!"

"Heh." Zhang Fei snorted coldly after he finished implanting his slave mark into Xuan Yun's soul, and he then moved next to Zhao Ziqin, who immediately opened her eyes. "How would you like to see him die?"
"Eh?" Zhao Ziqin looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, but he immediately told her about his slave mark, so Xuan Yu would do everything he ordered of him, including committing suicide.

Xuan Yu himself could naturally hear Zhang Fei's words, and his body trembled violently at the thought, so he immediately begged Zhao Ziqin. "Young miss! Please tell him to spare me! I will never set foot in this region again, and I will never bother you again from now on."

Unlike Zhang Fei, Zhao Ziqin had a soft heart, so she couldn't bear to see Xuan Yu die. Even so, she understood that while everyone would attempt to plead for their lives in a desperate situation, she also understood that a man like him would never change, and allowing him to live would only cause them more trouble. "Can you give him an easy death?
He's a bad guy, but I don't want to see him die a horrible death, so I hope you can do that for me."
"No! No! Please spare me, young miss!"

"All right." Zhang Fei then turned to Xuan Yu with a faint smile. "You are lucky because Ziqin begged me not to kill you cruelly, so you can commit suicide by exploding your cultivation core right now."
"No!" Although he didn't want to do that, Xuan Yu couldn't go against Zhang Fei's orders, and he directly exploded his cultivation core.
*Boom*

As soon as Xuan Yu's body exploded, Zhang Fei enveloped him and Zhao Ziqin with his aura to prevent his blood from drenching their bodies, and he canceled his soul connection with Boitata, causing his strength to decrease rapidly and return to its original level.
Zhang Fei then turned to another area, and the battle there was also over, especially since he only saw three red dots remaining. He immediately took Zhao Ziqin's hand before leading her there.

When they arrived there, Zhao Ziqin was horrified to see the corpses of members of the Gui Assassins scattered on the ground as Liu Hua and the Wen Twins slaughtered them until nothing remained. In addition, she saw her mother, uncle, and grandmother in a helpless situation under the pressure of Zhang Lingxue and Boitata, who were clearly much stronger than the three of them.
Even so, Huan Ning continued to glare fiercely at Zhang Lingxue, but her expression was also full of pain from their fight wounds.
Huan Chong's condition was worse than that of his cousin, especially since Zhang Lingxue did not hold back when beating him and broke both his arms and legs.

As for Qiao Ran, she was the luckiest among them because Boitata only sealed her cultivation and didn't beat her up, so she didn't suffer any injuries at all, mainly because Zhang Fei wanted her as his slave.
"Are you going to send them there now, Fei'er?" As she approached them, Liu Hua inquired.

Zhang Fei nodded and asked Mei to open the gate to the Netherworld realm, but he immediately felt a strange feeling that prompted him to enter the gate, which came from his demon bloodline. However, he immediately held himself back from that urge, especially since he didn't feel ready to go there with his current strength.
As she continued to restrict Qiao Ran's movements, Boitata brought Huan Ning, Huan Chong, and Zhao Yun, who were still unconscious, before Zhang Fei.

Seeing her mother and uncle's angry expressions, Zhao Ziqin, who previously couldn't bear to see them sent to the Netherword Realm, became even more determined to send them there. Furthermore, she was fed up with them treating her only as a tool for their interests, so she turned to Boitata, nodding at her.
Wasting no time, Boitata threw the three people into the gate, and Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to close it.
"What are you going to do to my grandma, Fei?" Zhao Ziqin inquired as she gazed at Qiao Ran, who was slumped in the chair.
After all, Zhao Ziqin had already chosen him as her future husband, so Zhang Fei didn't want to hide it from her, and he told her about his true plans for Qiao Ran.

Zhao Ziqin let out a soft sigh as she felt strange seeing her grandmother become Zhang Fei's slave, but she thought that it was still better than having her die at his hands. "All right, you can do that to her."
Zhang Fei rushed over to Qiao Ran and touched her chest. He immediately implanted his demon slave mark into her soul, making her completely his slave.

Liu Hua asked the Wen Twins to call their group members to clean up the corpses after everything had settled, and she hurriedly went to the Zhao Clan's treasure room to do so. However, she didn't give them to Zhang Fei; she gave them to Zhao Ziqin instead, especially since she was the clan's heir.
Zhang Lingxue suddenly spoke to Zhao Ziqin. "Do you want to stay here? After all, they are no longer here, so no one can force you anymore, and you can meet Fei more easily."

"No." Zhao Ziqin refused, shaking her head. "Even though they are no longer here, my father and two grandfathers are still there, as well as my great-grandfather and great-grandmother. That's why I want to go with you to the Central Region, so they won't be able to find me, and I might be able to forget this incident faster by going there."
Zhang Lingxue turned to Zhang Fei, who nodded at her, and he then said to Zhao Ziqin. "It's okay, you can go there with her, and I will definitely meet you soon."

sentences.text: As soon as Zhang Fei appeared in front of him in his half-fox form, Xuan Yu's face darkened, especially since Zhao Ziqin was in his arms.
However, Xuan Yu burst out laughing after he sensed Zhang Fei's cultivation.
"Hahaha!
I originally thought you would be as strong as those women, but it turns out you are so weak!
Do you believe you can beat me with your current cultivation?
I'll kill you first, and then I'll take that bitch with me to the central region."
"Is that so?" Zhang Fei then used the Soul Connect with Boitata, which allowed him to gain half of her power.
The significant increase in his power was sufficient to face Xuan Yu, whose cultivation was at the 10-Star Soul Realm.
"What about now?"
'What the fuck!
How could his cultivation skyrocket so suddenly?' Xuan Yu muttered as he took several steps back, fully aware that he would not be able to face the current Zhang Fei.

In fact, the current Zhang Fei can even deal with cultivators at 10-Star Earth Realm easily, especially since Boitata's cultivation is at 10-Star Heaven Realm, reversing the difference between their strengths.
'Damn it!
I have to escape right now, or I will die in his hands!' Xuan Yu immediately took out his returning jade.
However, Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of him, snatching the returning jade before Xuan Yu had a chance to break it.
He immediately threw a powerful fist at his chest, knocking him backwards before slamming into the wall.
"Guah!" Xuan Yu immediately fell to the ground and vomited a mouthful of blood.
He clutched his painful chest while inwardly grumbling. 'Fuck!
I've never had such a heavy punch before!
Even my father's blows weren't as heavy and painful as his!'

After all, Zhang Fei's heavenly body tempering had already upgraded to silver level when he broke through to the Core Realm, which increased his body strength by 30% and his attack power by 20% compared to ordinary cultivators.
In addition, he is also in a soul-connected state with Boitata, enhancing his strength even further.
Zhang Fei casually stood at his spot with a faint smile on his face, and he then crushed the returning jade in his hand so that Xuan Yu would no longer be able to escape.
'Shit!
I have to think of another way to escape from this place!' After he wiped the blood from his mouth, Xuan Yu immediately got up from the ground, but he still felt excruciating pain in his chest. 'Ugh!
His attack seems to have just broken my sternum!'
"Hey, you don't need to think of a way to escape; you will never be able to escape from me without your returning jade." Zhang Fei then stretched his hand forward and made a gesture to lure Xuan Yu.
"Weren't you previously so confident in your strength?
Why are you acting so cowardly now?
Apparently, you're just a coward who can only rely on the power of your clan, and you can't do anything without their help."
"Bastards!" After hearing that, Xuan Yu's anger instantly overflowed, especially since there had never been anyone who dared to belittle him like that except for his seniors in the sect.
He immediately took out two small spears and released his aura before moving to attack Zhang Fei, but he just shook his head and dodged his attacks with his teleportation ability. 'Shit!
How could he move that fast?
Even my grandfather couldn't move so fast!'
The moment he thought that, Zhang Fei had already appeared right behind Xuan Yu and punched his back with a powerful punch, causing a loud cracking sound to be heard from his back.
*Crack*
However, Zhang Fei didn't stop there; he swiftly kicked both of Xuan Yu's legs from behind, causing more cracking sounds.
*Crack...
Crack...*
"Argh!" Zhang Fei immediately stepped on Xuan Yu's back after breaking both of his legs, causing him to feel extreme pain throughout his body.
"Argh!"
Zhao Ziqin, who watched this from a distance, immediately closed her eyes.

She didn't expect that Zhang Fei would torture Xuan Yu to such an extent, but she somehow felt happy with it because he was doing it for her, especially since he previously intended to take her away by force.
Despite his situation, Xuan Yu maintained his arrogance and attempted to intimidate Zhang Fei.
"Argh!
Let me go now!
You will feel the anger of my father and grandfather if you hurt me more than this, let alone if you dare kill me; they will slaughter your entire family!"

If you can rely on your clan's strength to act as you please, then I can rely on their strength to destroy your family, right?"

There's no way she's willing to be your wife!"

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Meet Yan Huan'er
paragraphs: Once everything was done, Qiao Ran reached out to the remaining members of the Gui Assassin group, urging them to head to Western Forest City without delay. Even though she didn't want to do that, Zhang Fei's order was absolute because of his slave mark.

After that, Zhang Fei sent Qiao Ran into his portable mansion, especially since he would return to earth and go to Diyu Realm soon. Furthermore, due to the realm's connection to Earth, it lacked Qi, prompting Zhang Fei to utilize her and Mei Xiang for his cultivation during his stay.

"Hua'er, I want you to take care of that group member." Not only was Liu Hua surprised by Zhang Fei's decision, but even the Wen Twins were surprised by it. "I want the Hua assassin group to develop more, which will be beneficial for us, especially since we will probably face many enemies in the future.
That's why I want you to accept those who are willing to submit, and you can kill those who try to oppose you."

"All right." Liu Hua then took out the profound elemental fruit and gave it to Zhang Fei. "You've been busy since you came here, so I just gave it to you, and your elements will improve after you consume it."

Zhang Fei happily accepted the fruit, especially since all his elements were still at the initial level, and the fire-yang flower also couldn't help him upgrade his fire elements. 'Hey Mei! Can I master other elements besides light, darkness, and fire?'

[Yes, Master, you can master other elements. The problem is that you have to look for other elemental seeds to master them, but finding one isn't an easy task, and I'm not sure if you can find one in this realm, especially since this realm is a lower realm.]
'Elemental Seeds?'

Mei explained it to him right away. [Cultivators commonly use elemental seeds to master other elements, but there's no guarantee of instant mastery, Master. Even if you use them, they still have a percentage to awaken other elements within you, and the percentage of success is not very high.]
'So to awaken other elements like gambling, huh?'
[Awakening a new element is indeed a gamble, Master. Otherwise, all cultivators will possess all the elements with the help of elemental seeds.]
'That's true too.'

Before long, they had arrived at the Chu Clan, making the other women feel relieved to see that Zhang Fei had successfully brought Zhao Ziqin back. Immediately, they inquired about the fate of the three clans, with the majority feeling relieved upon learning of the complete destruction of the Mei and Li clans.
Even though Zhao Liang and Zhao Feng were still alive, the Zhao Clan had significantly weakened.
Zhang Chen and the other women, who were still not used to such things, felt that Zhang Fei was too cruel in killing the people of the Li and Mei Clans down to their roots.

Unlike them, Janette, as a demon, remains relatively unaffected by that. However, she also felt that Zhang Fei's changes after becoming an incubus were too drastic, especially since Zhang Yu repeatedly boasted that he was very gentle, but the current him was so vicious.
'Perhaps he can really help me fight them, so my mother and the members of my race can be free from their oppression, and they can live a peaceful life like in the past.'

"Fei'er, I still want to accompany you, but I have to go back now, or else I'll be late for my sect's internal competition, and Big Sis Yao will definitely nag me to no end." Zhang Lingxue then hugged and kissed Zhang Fei's lips for a moment before turning to Zhao Ziqin. "Are you sure about going with me to the central region?

You won't be able to meet him for some time, and I won't be able to bring you back here either, especially since I still have a lot of business to attend to in the sect after I was absent for some time."

"I'm sure, Big Sis." Zhao Ziqin then looked at Zhang Fei with a smile. "Moreover, he already promised to meet me as soon as possible, so I'll wait for him there. Besides, I'm thinking about joining your sect to increase my strength, so I won't continue to depend on you guys, and I can protect myself better."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei pulled Zhao Ziqin into his arms and gave her a deep kiss, which she shyly returned, especially since there were so many people around them. However, they kissed not for long, and he then said to her. "Don't worry; I will definitely keep my promise to you, and I will take you as my wife at that time."
Red hues instantly lit up Zhao Ziqin's cheeks, and he immediately hugged Zhang Fei while saying it softly. "I'll wait for you there, so don't let me wait too long, okay?"
After they said goodbye to the others, Zhang Lingxue immediately took Zhao Ziqin on her flying artifact, and the two of them left the Chu Clan at full speed.

Ye Lian suddenly grabbed Zhang Fei's hand. "Can we go see my mother now? She's been waiting for you for several days, but you were previously in seclusion with Aunt Lingxue, so I want to take you to see her now."

"Sure, we'll go see your mother now." Zhang Fei certainly didn't reject Ye Lian's wishes and immediately hugged her waist. "Grandma, you and the others can get ready to go home; I will bring you all back after I return from the Ye Clan."

"Fei'er, I think I'll stay here." Zhang Chen's answer surprised Zhang Fei. "Even though I've only lived in this realm for a few days, I already feel very comfortable living here. Moreover, I can only cultivate here, and I also need to take care of our restaurant, which is why I decided to move here."
"Well, if you really want that, then you can stay here with Ying'er and the others, Grandma." Zhang Fei then turned to the others. "What about you all?"

"Big brother, I will also stay here with our grandma and the others." Zhang Lin was the first to answer him. "As for my school, I no longer think about that, especially since school lessons on earth are useless for cultivators like us."

Qing Yi sighed heavily at her second daughter's answer, but they had already talked about that before. "Fei'er, I will come with you back to earth because I have to see your aunt first, or else she will worry about me, but I will move here when we come back here next time."
Zhong Yan, Zhang Yue, Ru Xue, and Xu Ling'er also decided to return to earth, especially since they still had their own affairs, so they couldn't move completely to the Sky Jade Realm yet.
As for Janette, Zhang Fei had asked her to take him to the Diyu Realm, so he also had to return to earth, especially since they could only go there via earth.

Before long, they had arrived at the Ye Clan, and the servants who saw their arrival kept glancing at Zhang Fei in confusion, especially since Ye Lian hugged his arm so intimately. After all, all they knew was that she was Gu Zhan's fiancé, and they would be getting married soon, so they were confused about the relationship between the two.
Regrettably, they remain unaware that their young miss's fiancé has passed away, thereby freeing her from ties to other men.
Yan Huan'er was already waiting for them when they arrived at the main hall, because Ye Lian had already informed her that they would meet her soon.

However, she was a little surprised when she felt Zhang Fei's cultivation had already reached 1-Star Core Realm, especially since her daughter once told her that he had only been cultivating for a little more than two weeks, and a few days ago his cultivation was still at 5-Star Foundation Realm. 'Sigh! This kid's progress is truly frightening and absurd!
I know he is a dual cultivator with several wives, but his cultivation speed is much faster than I imagined, and it far surpasses other dual cultivators.'
"Mother." Ye Lian called softly as she moved behind her mother, hugging her from behind. "What do you think about Fei?"

"He is terrifying, especially his cultivation speed, but I have to admit that he is better than Gu Zhan in some ways." Yan Huan'er replied while continuing to observe Zhang Fei. "Do you really love my daughter, Fei'er?"
"Aunt, I never joke about my feelings, and I approached Lian'er because I liked her." Zhang Fei then sat in front of them. "Moreover, she is a kind and gentle girl, so I want her to be my wife."
"What about your other wives?" Yan Huan'er asked him again with a worried look.

That made Zhang Fei smile. "Aunt, I can understand your worries, especially since I have several wives. However, Lian'er has a good relationship with Qing'er and Ying'er, and she has also known Hua'er for a long time."

Yan Huan'er naturally did not question Liu Hua and the Chu Sisters, especially since she herself had known them for so long, so she knew her daughter's good relationship with them. However, she was still worried about Zhang Fei's other wives because she had never met them and did not know their characters.

"As for my other wives, Lin'er and Lingxue, Lian'er has already spent some time with them, and they openly accepted her, so you don't need to worry about them." Zhang Fei then looked at Ye Lian for a moment before speaking to Yan Huan'er again. "As for our wedding, I've thought about this matter, and I want to quickly take her as my wife.
However, she wants to wait for Uncle Ye to return from the northern region, especially since she wants both of you to witness our wedding, so I decided to follow her wishes."

Yan Huan'er nodded in understanding. "Even though I don't know you very well, my daughter has chosen you to be her husband, and I trust her decision. That's why my husband and I decided to approve of your relationship, and we hope you will continue to love her and treat him fairly throughout his life."

"Lian'er will be my wife, and I will always love her. As for my treatment of them, I dare to guarantee that I will always treat her fairly and equally with my other wives." Zhang Fei then ordered Mei to buy three each of all kinds of pills, but she bought four Dantian Pills, especially since he had yet to swallow them after breaking through to the Core Realm.
{You got Essence Qi Pill x3}
{You got Bone Pill x3}
{You got Meridian Pill x3}
{You got Dantian Pill x4}
{You got Soul Pill x3}
{You got Yang Purifying Pill x2}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x1}
{4,750,000 Red Jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

After that, Zhang Fei gave those pills to Yan Huan'er and explained each effect to her, leaving her shocked and amazed at the same time. "You two are Lian'er's parents, and Ye Hang is her brother, so I want you guys to swallow them too, which will be good for your cultivation."

"Fei is right, Mother." Ye Lian also spoke to her mother. "I've swallowed them before, and the effects are truly amazing. You can swallow your share and give the rest to my father when he returns later. You don't need to give them to my brother now; you should wait for him to change his attitude towards him first."

Yan Huan'er smiled wryly as she listened to her daughter's words about her brother, but she nodded in agreement. "You're right, I will wait for your little brother to change his attitude before giving him these pills, or else he will become even more arrogant later."
"Anyway, what about Aunt Mei, Mother?"
"Sister Mei is still saddened by Zhan'er's death, and I'm thinking about going to the Gu Clan to accompany her again."
Recalling that, Ye Lian continued to feel sad, as it was her own fault. "Anyway, Fei, I have to go back to my sect tomorrow, so I won't be coming with you."

Zhang Fei left the Ye Clan after chatting with them for a while, and he brought Ru Xue and several other women back to earth. However, the Chu Sisters, particularly Chu Qing, chose not to join him due to the pressure from his current cultivation, so they chose to stay and focused on their cultivations.

"You might not know it yet because you just returned, but we are divorced now." Qing Tan suddenly turned to Qing Yi with a look of disbelief, especially since she had repeatedly persuaded her to divorce Zhang Hai, but she always insisted on maintaining their marriage. "Now, I live with my mother-in-law and my children; even Yue'er has returned from Singapore and lives with us."

After hearing that, Qing Tan nodded in understanding, and her expression brightened with joy upon learning that Qing Yi had reunited with her three children. Instead, Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh at his aunt's question. "Guo Lan did like me, but she hates me now, especially since I already have a girlfriend."

"Oh?" Qing Tan suspiciously and curiously looked at him, especially since Zhang Fei hadn't been close to any woman other than Guo Lan before, and she thought they were a good match. "Who is your girlfriend?"

Qing Yi just smiled when she heard that, and she immediately turned the conversation in another direction, including talking about her nephew.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Feng Yao
paragraphs: Given that time in the Sky Jade Realm was four times faster than on Earth, two days had passed when people finally learned about the destruction of the Li and Mei Clans. This news caused a stir throughout the western forest city, particularly since the Chu Clan had directly taken over their property.
Liu Qingyu immediately explained to those people the reasons for destroying the two clans, which made the situation in the city more panicked and a little chaotic.

She and Liu Hua deliberately did not conceal information about the relationship of the two clans with the Pang Clan, in the hope that they would be more prepared to deal with those heretics, and they also showed them one of Pang Hong's subordinates who was still in their custody.

Although the people from the Heavenly Sword Sect also heard the news, they did not directly interfere in the city's affairs, preferring to prepare their disciples to face the secret and unexpected attacks from the Pang Clan that could occur at any time.
Besides, they also sent some representatives to discuss the matter with Liu Qingyu and the Chu Clan, so they could devise a more suitable course of action.

Even so, people still didn't know about Gu Zhan's death or the disappearance of the people from the Zhao Clan, especially since Xing Mei was still covering up her son's death. People from the Chu Clan also covered up news about the clan, mainly because there were still two members left in the clan, as Zhao Feng and Zhao Liang were still alive.

Additionally, the remaining members of the Gu Assassin group had already arrived at the Zhao Clan. However, Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, and the Wen Twins immediately ambushed them. As per Zhang Fei's wishes, they killed those who tried to oppose them and absorbed those who were willing to submit to the Hua Assassin group, making the group even bigger.

Liu Hua made an astonishing decision for the old members of the group, but the Wen Twins were not surprised by it, so she changed the group's name to the Demon Fox Assassin group based on Zhang Fei's two identities. Even so, none of them objected, especially since she was the one who founded the group, recruited them, and helped them so much in their lives.
When Zhang Lingxue and Zhao Ziqin arrived at the Zhang Clan, three women—Zi'er, Zhang Xiaoling, and her mother—greeted them with suspicious looks.
"Hahaha." Zhang Lingxue laughed awkwardly at their gazes, but she spoke to them immediately. "Hey, stop it, guys! You're right, I'm no longer a virgin, and I've given it to my husband."

"Your husband?" The three women let out low cries, particularly because Zhang Lingxue had never been in a relationship with a man and had previously only traveled to the western region to accompany his two disciples to Blazing Volcano Mountain in search of the Fire Yang Flower.

However, Chang Wenjie had already returned two weeks ago, informing them that they had failed to obtain the flower and that Zhang Lingxue was taking care of something there, which was why she was late in returning. Yet she had now returned with such news for them, so they were completely shocked to hear their confession.
Zi'er suddenly asked him. "Since when have your old injuries been recovered, Lingxue? I can no longer feel them, and your body also seems to be stronger than before you went to the western region."

"Hahaha." Instead, Zhang Lingxue laughed at his question. "You're right, my old injuries have indeed recovered, and this happened because of my husband. Furthermore, he also gave me several things that ultimately helped me strengthen my body."
"Aunt Lingxue, who is your husband? Why didn't you bring him here? Who is that woman next to you?" Zhang Xiaoling immediately threw out several questions at once, giving her aunt a curious look.

Zhang Lingxue's mother, Yang Yudie, was also very curious about her husband's identity. "Hurry up! Tell us everything, or I'll spank your ass, especially since you dare to get married without asking for my blessing first!"

"Pft! Hahaha!" Zhao Ziqin laughed while listening to Yang Yudie's words, but she felt that the Zhang Clan was much more pleasant and harmonious than her clan, especially since her family only cared about their status and didn't care about her feelings.

"Mother, I'm already this old, so you'd better not do such a thing to me; otherwise, I'll die of shame." Zhang Lingxue complained with a pout. "His name is Zhang Fei, and the girl beside me is Zhao Ziqin, who is his future wife."
"Zhang Fei?" The three women instantly frowned, and they tried to search in their memories for that name, but they felt like they never knew his name.
Yang Yudie then asked him. "Who is Zhang Fei? Which branch of our clan is he from? Why did you choose to marry a member of our branch clan?"

"Mother, you are wrong about that; Zhang Fei is not a member of our clan." Zhang Lingxue then drew Zhao Ziqin to sit on an empty chair, where she revealed her husband's true identity, along with some details she made up herself. However, she refrained from revealing that he was a demon and a beast fox.

"At first, I was as shocked as the three of you, but he really came from another realm, and I had gone there together with the Liu Sisters before, which proved the truth of the information in the ancient records about the existence of other realms. However, there is no Qi in his realm, so his master brought him and his family to move here so they could cultivate.
For now, they live in the Chu Clan, especially Liu Hua, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing, who are also his wives."

They were even more confused and shocked after hearing about Zhang Fei's relationship with the three women, and Zhang Xiaoling asked her again. "Aunt Lingxue, why did you decide to accept him as your husband? After all, he already has three wives, and Ziqin is also his future wife, so I feel strange about your decision, especially since he is the first man in your life."

"En." Zhang Lingxue can naturally understand their thoughts. "Honestly, I never thought about being with Zhang Fei, especially since I just met him at Blazing Volcano Mountain. However, he knows that my condition is critical, and I may die at any time."

After Zhang Lingxue said the last thing, the three women released heavy sighs, as they themselves knew about her critical condition, which had frustrated them for the past few years, especially since they had never managed to cure her injuries.

"That's why he offered me to become his wife because he could only heal me if I became one, and I decided to accept his offer because I didn't want to be separated from all of you." However, Zhang Lingxue secretly laughed as she spoke, feeling embarrassed to reveal that she had become Zhang Fei's wife due to a bet with Liu Qingyu.
"Besides, he is an extraordinary man, and you guys would be amazed if you knew what happened at our first meeting."
"What happened there?"
"Haha." Zhang Lingxue laughed and put on a proud expression. "Have you ever heard that a cultivator with cultivation in the elementary realm could face a divine beast and subdue it?"
"What?" Yang Yudie then frowned as she asked in disbelief. "Are you kidding us? How could a cultivator with such low cultivation be able to face a divine beast, let alone subdue it?"

"I agree with my grandma, Aunt! There's no way a cultivator at that stage can fight against a divine beast, whose cultivation should already be in the earth or heaven realms." Zhang Xiaoling expressed her opinion by shaking her head.

Unlike them, Zi'er seemed to believe in Zhang Lingxue. "What kind of divine beast is that? Wenjie did tell us about your failure to get that flower, but she didn't tell us about the Divine Beast or Zhang Fei."
"Zi'er, that divine beast is a huge serpent." Zhang Lingxue then pointed at Zhao Ziqin. "If you don't believe me, then you can ask her, because she's already met Boitata."

"Big Sis Lingxue is right, seniors." Zhao Ziqin respectfully spoke to them. "Boitata is indeed a serpent divine beast, and her cultivation has already reached the 10-Star Heaven Realm. However, I don't know how Zhang Fei subdued her, especially since they were already together when I first knew them."

The three women immediately turned to Zhang Lingxue, but she shrugged her shoulders at them, not intending to explain too much about Zhang Fei. "All right, you don't need to be curious like that; you will understand what's special about him when he visits this clan in the future.
Anyway, I have to go now, and I will bring Ziqin with me, or else Big Sis Yao will scold me endlessly because I was absent for too long."
As soon as the two women disappeared, Zhang Xiaoling asked Yang Yudie. "Grandma, what do you think about Aunt Lingxue's husband?"

"Honestly, I'm still skeptical about Lingxue's stories about Zhang Fei, especially his actions in subduing those divine beasts in the 10-Star Heaven Realm." Yang Hudie then pondered for a while before speaking again.

"However, if he can really travel between two realms, that means he is indeed not just any cultivator, and his master should be a powerful cultivator who is stronger than your grandfather and Chang Wuhen. Perhaps his master helped him to subdue that beast, but she and the others were unaware of that person's presence due to their difference in strength."
Zhang Xiaoling nodded in agreement with her grandmother, and she also thought the same as her because it was impossible for Zhang Fei to subdue such a powerful beast by himself.
Zi'er shook her head slightly before speaking to them. "All right, we don't need to be too curious about Zhang Fei, and we will find out everything when he comes here."

Since the locations of the Zhang Clan and the Blazing Phoenix Sect were not too far away, both women had arrived at the sect quickly, and Zhang Lingxue immediately took Zhao Ziqin to meet Feng Yao, the sect master of the sect.

However, Zhang Lingxue shivered when they arrived at the room's door, confusing Zhao Ziqin, who was standing beside her. Suddenly, the door opened from the inside, and Feng Yao, who was sitting behind her desk, stared at her angrily, causing her to smile bitterly.

Feng Yao has butt-length black hair with two bangs hanging down to her chest, and the calmness on her pretty face makes people feel calm to be around her. Her red eyes look attractive and sharp, complemented by long and thin eyebrows, and her thin lips are quite tempting without lipstick. Her figure is tall and slim, and her long red dress perfectly hugs her body.
However, her figure is not as attractive as Zhang Lingxue or Zhao Ziqin, and her breasts are only around B-Cup, but a dignified and powerful aura radiates out from her.

Zhang Lingxue then brought Zhao Ziqin in and explained everything to Feng Yao, who immediately observed her body seriously, but she still kept several things secret from her, including the presence of Boitata beside Zhang Fei. "I see. I can see that your body has returned to normal, so I am really pleased with your recovery.

However, you have to contact your husband and take him to see me as soon as possible because I have a lot of questions for him, and I want to test him myself to see whether he is worthy to be my brother-in-law or not."
"Hehe." Zhang Lingxue chuckled and warned her. "Big Sis, Fei'er's cultivation is indeed far below yours, but you shouldn't underestimate him, lest you yourself regret underestimating him."

"I believe in you." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "Moreover, you know yourself that I never underestimate others, so I will test him to the best of my abilities. Since you are back now, I will catch up with Old Long and the others in the demon cave, and I will hand over the matters of our sect's internal competition to you.
As for Ziqin, you can take care of everything yourself, and it would be better if she became your direct disciple."
Zhang Lingxue immediately agreed with that. "All right, leave everything to me, and you can focus on helping them strengthen the seal on the demon portal."

paragraphs: Before long, they had arrived at the village, but Zhang Fei [1] felt that there was something unusual in the village, and his eyes turned blood red as he inspected the villagers. Nevertheless, he didn't find anything unusual about them, and Mei didn't either. 'This is weird; maybe it's just me being too sensitive?'

"Hey, Fei! Look at that girl." Following Luo Yu's direction, Zhang Fei [1] noticed a group of five people in the distance, but his attention was solely on one of them. "She is Xia Qianqian, and the man next to her is her brother, Xia Leng. I didn't expect that they would also embark on a mission in this area, and this village was the only place for them to rest."

Zhang Fei [1] naturally did not care about Xia Leng and the others, only paying attention to Xia Qianqian. As his two partners stated a few days ago, her face is unappealing and a little below average, but she does have a seductive body. Her breasts are large in an E-Cup; her buttocks look plump and stick out backwards; and her lips are sensually thick.

Gu Yan whispered to Zhang Fei [1] when she saw his expression. "Are you interested in having her as your partner, Fei? However, you have to be careful because many people say that Xia Leng has a sister complex, and he wants Xia Qianqian for himself, so he is very protective of her.
Many rumors suggest that Xia Leng and Xia Qianqian are indeed in a relationship, with some even claiming to have spotted them bathing together and sharing passionate kisses.

"Xia Leng's overprotectiveness towards Xia Qianqian is undeniable, but the veracity of the rumors about their relationship remains unproven, and I believe those who propagate these rumors harbor animosity towards both of them." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with Luo Yu, especially since he did not detect their Yang and Yi Qi in each other's bodies, so it was certain that they did not have such a relationship.

"Even so, you still have to approach her carefully if you want to take her as your partner, especially since her brother is quite popular even among seniors, and most of them are quite strong, even though they are not in the top ten."

However, Zhang Fei [1] only smiled while listening to Luo Yu, and he did not feel too worried about Xia Leng. "Let's go; we'll rest for a bit, and we'll start looking for information about the quest afterward."
Xia Qianqian seemed fascinated by Zhang Fei's handsome face, and she asked her big brother directly. "Big brother, do you recognize that man?"

Xia Leng raised his eyebrows and looked at them, but then he shook his head at his sister. "I've never seen that man before, and he's probably a new disciple from our sect. However, I don't understand how Gu Yan and Luo Yu could be with him, especially since everyone in the sect knows that the two of them are lesbians, and their relationship seems so intimate."

"That man is probably a member of a big clan, so he can join our sect, even though the registration of new disciples hasn't started yet." Xia Leng nodded to the man next to him, who was none other than Gong Zhi, one of the Yin-Yang Pavilion's top ten disciples. "Look at him; he's handsome, and his body looks strong.
His cultivation has reached the 1-Star Core Realm, which may have led the lily couple to succumb to his seduction."
"Haha." The other man suddenly laughed and patted Gong Zhi's shoulder. "Do you feel insecure about competing with him?"

With a shake of his head, Gong Zhi turned to him. "Why should I feel insecure about competing with him, Shan Yun? Moreover, that guy will soon become an inner disciple, and he won't care about outer female disciples, so I don't need to feel that way."

"Well, that's true." Shan Yun nodded in agreement with him. "Gu Yan and Luo Yu also seem to be breaking through to the core realm soon, so our competition for the top spot will be two less if they break through, and we can get better rewards."
Suddenly, the young woman sitting beside Shan Yun asked Xia Qianqian. "Hey, are you interested in that male disciple?"

"No! Qianqian wouldn't be interested in a man like him." Instead, it was Xia Leng who answered her quest in an angry tone. "Hey, Ning Qingxue, you better not give my sister any strange ideas, or else I won't help you on your mission, and the elder will punish you for failing your mission."

After hearing that, Ning Qingxue immediately covered her mouth, grumbling in her heart in annoyance. 'Tch! This bastard! If he really loved Qianqian, he should just eat her up! Humph! I don't care about you guys!
I will try to get close to that guy, especially since he is stronger than all of you, so he will be more useful to me than you.'
"Qianqian, you better not approach that man; do you understand?"

"Yes, Big Brother." Even though she said that, Xia Qianqian had other thoughts in her heart, and she thought of a way to avoid Xia Leng meeting Zhang Fei [1]. 'Sigh, I'll think of another way to meet him after we return to the sect later, or else my big brother will punish me if he finds out I tried to meet him.'

Xia Leng then pulled his little sister up, as he had told the others. "Let's go; we have to look for that beast again, especially since the time limit is almost up, and we only have two days left to find it and bring it back to the sect."

"Hehe." Zhong Yan and Yang Lu'er giggled when they saw Guo Lan holding hands with Zhang Fei down from above, especially since her face was still incredibly red after their first kiss, and she kept smiling to herself.
"Are you feeling relieved now, Lan?" Zhong Yan asked with a smile.
Guo Lan bashfully nodded to Zhong Yan. "Thank you, Big Sis Yan."

Yang Lu'er then teased her. "Little girl, you were peeking at us, right? You should already know how enjoyable it is to have sex with my master, so you should do it with him soon, and you will definitely enjoy it very much."

Immediately, a cloud of smoke billowed from Guo Yan's head, as she hadn't anticipated their discovery of his peeking activity. She looked up at Zhang Fei, who was smiling at her, and finally realized that he had purposely allowed her to watch them. However, she then asked Yang Lu'er a question. "Why do you refer to him as your master?
After all, you are a famous woman, and people will think you are strange if they hear you call him that."

"Why should I care about their opinions? My life is my business, and I will enjoy my life to the fullest." Yang Lu'er replied with a shrug. "Additionally, he is an incubus, and I have no problem recognizing him as my master. Aside from me, my mother, Qiu Mei, Zou Ling, Fang Chen, Ren Xia, and Tang Ziyu also acknowledge him as their master."

After hearing those names, Guo Lan's jaw dropped, as she recognized three of the five because Zou Ling was a famous clothing designer, Fang Chen was a famous news anchor, and Tang Ziyu was a famous actress.

"Have you really slept with Tang Ziyu, Fei?" Guo Lan asked with a look of shock, especially since she was one of her millions of fans and knew quite a bit about her. She was a married woman, but she unexpectedly had an affair with Zhang Fei.

"Yes, I have indeed slept with Tang Ziyu before." Zhang Fei nodded to Guo Lan, then spoke to Yang Lu'er. "Unfortunately, you are wrong about her. She is not my servant; she is my future woman. Unlike you and the others who often do that kind of event, she is doing it for the first time, which is because she is disappointed in her husband, who continues to cheat on her."

'Tch!' Yang Lu'er gritted her teeth in annoyance after hearing that, but she herself was aware that Tang Ziyu was indeed different from them, and she had never slept with another man before she slept with Zhang Fei.
Zhong Yan inwardly laughed at Yang Lu'er's expression before asking Zhang Fei. "Does this mean you will bring Lan'er with us, Fei'er?"
"Do you want to go there, Lan?"

"Yes." Guo Lan agreed without hesitation, especially since she didn't want to lose Zhang Fei, and she had already decided to learn to accept his polyamorous relationship, so it was the best way for her to be with him.

Yang Lu'er was actually curious about their secret activities and the origin of their shop's products. Even so, she was fully aware that Zhang Fei wouldn't tell her anything, so she didn't ask him either.
"That's good." Zhang Fei then said to Zhong Yan. "Anyway, I probably won't be going there tonight, so you and the others can teach Guo Lan about it."
"Are you going with Janette today?"

"Yes, I will indeed go there, and Janette is the only person who can take me there." Zhang Fei then turned to Guo Lan, who looked at him curiously. He gently pinched her nose before telling her about Janette, but her eyes widened in shock after hearing that she was a dryad. "That's why I can't bring anyone there, and you can train under their guidance somewhere else later.
Otherwise, you guys will turn into demons, and I don't want that."
Even though she still felt strange about all of Zhang Fei's stories, Guo Lan could more or less understand everything, and she nodded in understanding at him.

Since their office was in the same city, Zhang Fei was able to get there quickly by using his Nine Cloud Steps, and the two women were already waiting for him there.

"You haven't returned to your realm for two years, but you should still know it by heart, so you should immediately take him to a safe place if you encounter any imminent danger."

"Hey, Fei!
Look at that girl." Following Luo Yu's direction, Zhang Fei [1] noticed a group of five people in the distance, but his attention was solely on one of them.
"She is Xia Qianqian, and the man next to her is her brother, Xia Leng.
I didn't expect that they would also embark on a mission in this area, and this village was the only place for them to rest."
Zhang Fei [1] naturally did not care about Xia Leng and the others, only paying attention to Xia Qianqian.
As his two partners stated a few days ago, her face is unappealing and a little below average, but she does have a seductive body.
Her breasts are large in an E-Cup; her buttocks look plump and stick out backwards; and her lips are sensually thick.
Gu Yan whispered to Zhang Fei [1] when she saw his expression.
"Are you interested in having her as your partner, Fei?

"Xia Leng's overprotectiveness towards Xia Qianqian is undeniable, but the veracity of the rumors about their relationship remains unproven, and I believe those who propagate these rumors harbor animosity towards both of them." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with Luo Yu, especially since he did not detect their Yang and Yi Qi in each other's bodies, so it was certain that they did not have such a relationship.

"Even so, you still have to approach her carefully if you want to take her as your partner, especially since her brother is quite popular even among seniors, and most of them are quite strong, even though they are not in the top ten."
However, Zhang Fei [1] only smiled while listening to Luo Yu, and he did not feel too worried about Xia Leng.
"Let's go; we'll rest for a bit, and we'll start looking for information about the quest afterward."
Xia Qianqian seemed fascinated by Zhang Fei's handsome face, and she asked her big brother directly.
"Big brother, do you recognize that man?"
Xia Leng raised his eyebrows and looked at them, but then he shook his head at his sister.
"I've never seen that man before, and he's probably a new disciple from our sect.

"That man is probably a member of a big clan, so he can join our sect, even though the registration of new disciples hasn't started yet." Xia Leng nodded to the man next to him, who was none other than Gong Zhi, one of the Yin-Yang Pavilion's top ten disciples.
"Look at him; he's handsome, and his body looks strong.
His cultivation has reached the 1-Star Core Realm, which may have led the lily couple to succumb to his seduction."
"Haha." The other man suddenly laughed and patted Gong Zhi's shoulder.
"Do you feel insecure about competing with him?"
With a shake of his head, Gong Zhi turned to him.
"Why should I feel insecure about competing with him, Shan Yun?
Moreover, that guy will soon become an inner disciple, and he won't care about outer female disciples, so I don't need to feel that way."
"Well, that's true." Shan Yun nodded in agreement with him.
"Gu Yan and Luo Yu also seem to be breaking through to the core realm soon, so our competition for the top spot will be two less if they break through, and we can get better rewards."
Suddenly, the young woman sitting beside Shan Yun asked Xia Qianqian.
"Hey, are you interested in that male disciple?"
"No!
Qianqian wouldn't be interested in a man like him." Instead, it was Xia Leng who answered her quest in an angry tone.
"Hey, Ning Qingxue, you better not give my sister any strange ideas, or else I won't help you on your mission, and the elder will punish you for failing your mission."
After hearing that, Ning Qingxue immediately covered her mouth, grumbling in her heart in annoyance. 'Tch!
This bastard!
If he really loved Qianqian, he should just eat her up!
Humph!
I don't care about you guys!
I will try to get close to that guy, especially since he is stronger than all of you, so he will be more useful to me than you.'
"Qianqian, you better not approach that man; do you understand?"

Xia Leng then pulled his little sister up, as he had told the others.
"Let's go; we have to look for that beast again, especially since the time limit is almost up, and we only have two days left to find it and bring it back to the sect."

Yang Lu'er then teased her.
"Little girl, you were peeking at us, right?
You should already know how enjoyable it is to have sex with my master, so you should do it with him soon, and you will definitely enjoy it very much."

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Diyu Realm Rulers
paragraphs: [Master, I started scanning this realm as soon as we arrived here, and the scanning will end in two hours.] Zhang Fei was glad to hear that, especially since Mei always acted quickly, and he didn't need to order her around. [However, I didn't expect that you would get other quests besides the daily quest, and the system also automatically started upgrading.
However, I don't know anything about the upgrade, especially since I only have the authority to supervise it, so it's out of my control.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'I didn't expect to get other quests in this realm either, and I started to doubt my savior's identity, especially since she seemed to want me to prefer my demon side, so I thought that she might also be a demon.'

[Well, that possibility is open, but we don't have a definite answer to her identity, as we don't have any information about her. However, you might be able to meet her again in the future, so you can ask her directly if that happens.]

Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh after he remembered the young girl who killed him, brought him back to life, and changed his life. 'Sigh, I really want to know her identity and her reason for turning me into this, so I hope we will meet again one day in the future.'

"Why do you keep sighing to yourself? Don't you like coming to this realm? After all, you're a demon yourself, so I thought you wouldn't have any trouble adapting to this realm." Janette suddenly asked him.

"Nothing; I was just thinking about something." Zhang Fei then looked at the surrounding area, but the Diyu Realm was far beyond his expectations. "Even though I've never been to the Netherworld Realm directly, I can see from the gate that it's too dark, and this realm is completely the opposite from there, especially since this place is almost no different from Earth.
However, I didn't get the feeling I had in that realm, so I didn't feel anything special in this realm."

Janette didn't comment, especially since she didn't know about the Netherworld Realm. She then turned her head away, raised both hands, and shouted as loudly as she could. "Diyu Realm! I'm back! I hope the rest of you are doing well."

Zhang Fei smiled when he saw her act like that, but he used his divine senses to check that realm, especially since he couldn't access his map because the system was still in the process of upgrading, so he had to check it manually. After examining various directions, he was surprised to discover that the realm resembled an island state, with a single, vast island stretching out in all directions.
Despite this, an endless ocean surrounded the island's outskirts. "So where do we go first, Janette?"

"Can we go to the Dryad Forest first?" Zhang Fei agreed directly with Janette, especially since that was his main reason for coming here. "Our forest is in that direction, and it will take us about five hours to get there."

"I don't think it will take us that long to get there." Zhang Fei surprised Janette by pulling out the Pandora Odyssey. He immediately escorted her aboard and activated its stealth mode, ensuring the other demons wouldn't notice their presence. "Can you explain to me about this realm?"

"This place is similar to Earth, but there is only one large island here, as you can see. However, there are no humans here, and you are the first human to set foot here." Janette then pointed to the sky, and Zhang Fei immediately followed the direction she pointed, but he was surprised to see a huge floating ancient black castle. "Did you see that?

That was the castle of the supreme ruler of the Diyu Realm, but currently it has no owner because the old demon lord disappeared without a trace. Due to his wisdom and fair treatment of all demon races, this realm was once safe and peaceful, but his disappearance plunged it into great chaos.

Since then, twelve of his subordinates have scrambled to replace him as supreme ruler of this realm, causing it to endure perpetual warfare. We demons who didn't want to side with anyone became victims of their greed and ambition."
"So there are now twelve rulers trying to fight for the position of supreme ruler?"
"Yes." Janette nodded to Zhang Fei. "They are the twelve zodiacs."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei turned to her, surprised. "Do you mean they are like the twelve zodiac knights in the comics?"

"I don't know what you mean by those zodiac knights." When he heard that, Zhang Fei laughed wryly, and Janette then pointed at the twelve floating stone platforms. "There is a portal above those stone platforms that connects to their sub-realms. Each ruler has their own city, which is huge and majestic, and they live in their palace, located right in the middle of their cities.

However, not all demons, especially those of us who are not willing to support them, can live in their realms, and only the demons who pledge their loyalty can. Moreover, this realm divides the demons into five classes: lower, intermediate, advanced, elite, and ruler.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after hearing that, because he originally thought their classes would be divided according to their demon ranks.

"Haha." Janette laughed before looking down, then pointed at the crowd of demon beasts below them. "Those demon beasts belong to the lower class, and those who can transform into their semi-humanoid form belong to the intermediate class.

However, we dryads belong to the advanced class even though we were born in our semi-humanoid form, especially since we have unique abilities that common demons don't have. Apart from us, there are still several other demons that belong to the advanced class, such as druids and many more."
"What about the elite demons?"

"Elite demons are those who have a form similar to humans, but they still have special characteristics as demon races, and you humans call them demi-humans. They are powerful, even though they are not as powerful as the rulers, and most of them chose to side with the rulers."
"Demi-humans, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself with a faint smile on his face. "Who are the identities of the twelve rulers?"

"Aries represents Aries; he has the power to control flames. Taurus, represented by Tauri, can control the earth and possesses the highest endurance and absolute strength. Twin girls, one white and the other black, like the Yin-Yang symbol, represent Gemini, possessing the ability to manipulate air and illusions."
"Illusion, huh?" Zhang Fei wasn't curious about the two women, but he was more curious about their abilities. "What about the others?"

"Kinos represents Cancer, and his ability to manipulate water makes him one of the best fighters in the water. Leon represents Leo; he is a true predator who can fully adapt to his environment. Besides, he has amazing instincts, senses, reflexes, and speed."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "A lion stands at the top of the food chain, and a crab is an aquatic animal, so it's not surprising that they can be like that."

"Hey, Fei, I thought you might be interested in Virgil's representation of Virgo." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Janette. "There are only four women among the rulers, and she is the most beautiful. Furthermore, she has the most unique abilities among them, particularly since she has the power of light, even though she is a demon."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was really surprised by that. "How can she have the power of light?"

"I don't know for sure about that." Janette responded by shaking her head. "Virgil really has the power of light, and she is even able to purify other demons, so the other rulers hardly dare to offend her. Zygoz, the oldest of the rulers, represents Libra, demonstrating his wisdom.

His ambition to become the supreme ruler was the smallest compared to the others, and it was his subordinates who stopped the troops of other rulers who attacked my race at that time, so I could escape to Earth."
"Not bad; there is still a demon ruler who has feelings in this realm."

"Haha." Janette laughed softly before continuing. "Scorpius represents the scorpion, and his poison is too lethal, causing our bodies to dissolve in a matter of seconds, so you have to be careful when you meet him. Avros, the ultimate hunter, represents Sagittarius, and his ability to hunt his enemies is beyond question.
Lycus represents Capricorn, but his abilities remain uncertain, particularly given his laziness and lack of ambition."
Zhang Fei massaged his forehead, especially since the number of rulers in the Diyu Realm was simply too many, and there were still two more left. "What about Aquarius and Pisces?"

"Aqua is Aquarius, and his water manipulation abilities are top-notch; even Kinos can't match him, so you have to be careful if you fight him in the water area." Zhang Fei nodded understandingly at Janette. "Pisces also has excellent water control, and she can also manipulate all aquatic demons to attack her enemies.

Angela is the second-most beautiful woman, but her beauty is not inferior to that of Virgil. Besides, she is the kindest among the rulers, and she never bullied other demons from the classes below her."
"Angela, huh? Have you met her before?"

"No." Janette shook her head before pointing north toward the sea. "If you are curious about Angela, you can go there, and you might be able to meet her there, especially since she often goes there to enjoy her own time. However, you have to be careful with her telekinesis ability, and she might be able to catch you because she can also use teleportation like you.

Besides, not many demons know that she can use electricity too, and I heard about it from my mother who has met her several times, so her attacks are really deadly if she combines electricity and water together."

Unlike Virgil and Virgo, Janette's explanation about Angela completely piqued Zhang Fei's interest, making him eager to meet her, especially since she was the only demon ruler with teleportation abilities like him.

After that, Janette explained to Zhang Fei about each area in the realm, and she also told him the identity of the demon races living in each area, which made him impatient to explore the areas in the realm.

After they flew for two hours, they finally arrived above a very dense forest area. There was a large city in the heart of the forest, but half of it looked destroyed, and some black smoke was also rising from inside the city.
"This place is where I was born and raised, Fei, the Dryad Forest." Janette expressed her longing gaze upon the Dryad Forest, particularly considering her absence from home for the past two years.

Seeing Janette clench her fists tightly and her expression in pain, Zhang Fei took her hand directly. "I understand how you're feeling, but it's crucial to manage your emotions and prevent vengeance from blinding your eyes and heart, as it could lead to irrational actions."
"En." Janette just nodded at Zhang Fei. "Let's go down."

Zhang Fei nodded and hugged Janette's waist. He carried her down from his flying artifact before storing it in his inventory. They then walked into the forest, but most of the area they passed looked charred, and there were a lot of fallen trees around.

Janette looked very sad to see the forest where she was born and raised badly destroyed. She, as a Dryad, is a tree humanoid, so she can hear and feel the sadness of the trees. "It's been two years, but they're still hunting my kin."

After they had walked for quite a while, the city was right in their eyes. However, just as they were about to go further, many tree roots suddenly attacked them. Janette quickly stood in front of Zhang Fei and used her Tree Control to restrain them, then returned to her Dryad form while shouting. "Stop it, guys! It's me! I'm home!"
