They are powerful, even though they are not as powerful as the rulers, and most of them chose to side with the rulers."
"Demi-humans, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself with a faint smile on his face.
"Who are the identities of the twelve rulers?"
"Aries represents Aries; he has the power to control flames.
Taurus, represented by Tauri, can control the earth and possesses the highest endurance and absolute strength.
Twin girls, one white and the other black, like the Yin-Yang symbol, represent Gemini, possessing the ability to manipulate air and illusions."
"Illusion, huh?" Zhang Fei wasn't curious about the two women, but he was more curious about their abilities.
"What about the others?"
"Kinos represents Cancer, and his ability to manipulate water makes him one of the best fighters in the water.
Leon represents Leo; he is a true predator who can fully adapt to his environment.
Besides, he has amazing instincts, senses, reflexes, and speed."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"A lion stands at the top of the food chain, and a crab is an aquatic animal, so it's not surprising that they can be like that."
"Hey, Fei, I thought you might be interested in Virgil's representation of Virgo." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Janette.
"There are only four women among the rulers, and she is the most beautiful.
Furthermore, she has the most unique abilities among them, particularly since she has the power of light, even though she is a demon."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was really surprised by that.
"How can she have the power of light?"
"I don't know for sure about that." Janette responded by shaking her head.
"Virgil really has the power of light, and she is even able to purify other demons, so the other rulers hardly dare to offend her.
Zygoz, the oldest of the rulers, represents Libra, demonstrating his wisdom.

His ambition to become the supreme ruler was the smallest compared to the others, and it was his subordinates who stopped the troops of other rulers who attacked my race at that time, so I could escape to Earth."
"Not bad; there is still a demon ruler who has feelings in this realm."
"Haha." Janette laughed softly before continuing.
"Scorpius represents the scorpion, and his poison is too lethal, causing our bodies to dissolve in a matter of seconds, so you have to be careful when you meet him.
Avros, the ultimate hunter, represents Sagittarius, and his ability to hunt his enemies is beyond question.
Lycus represents Capricorn, but his abilities remain uncertain, particularly given his laziness and lack of ambition."
Zhang Fei massaged his forehead, especially since the number of rulers in the Diyu Realm was simply too many, and there were still two more left.
"What about Aquarius and Pisces?"

"Aqua is Aquarius, and his water manipulation abilities are top-notch; even Kinos can't match him, so you have to be careful if you fight him in the water area." Zhang Fei nodded understandingly at Janette.
"Pisces also has excellent water control, and she can also manipulate all aquatic demons to attack her enemies.
Angela is the second-most beautiful woman, but her beauty is not inferior to that of Virgil.
Besides, she is the kindest among the rulers, and she never bullied other demons from the classes below her."
"Angela, huh?
Have you met her before?"
"No." Janette shook her head before pointing north toward the sea.
"If you are curious about Angela, you can go there, and you might be able to meet her there, especially since she often goes there to enjoy her own time.
However, you have to be careful with her telekinesis ability, and she might be able to catch you because she can also use teleportation like you.

Besides, not many demons know that she can use electricity too, and I heard about it from my mother who has met her several times, so her attacks are really deadly if she combines electricity and water together."

Unlike Virgil and Virgo, Janette's explanation about Angela completely piqued Zhang Fei's interest, making him eager to meet her, especially since she was the only demon ruler with teleportation abilities like him.

After that, Janette explained to Zhang Fei about each area in the realm, and she also told him the identity of the demon races living in each area, which made him impatient to explore the areas in the realm.
After they flew for two hours, they finally arrived above a very dense forest area.
There was a large city in the heart of the forest, but half of it looked destroyed, and some black smoke was also rising from inside the city.
"This place is where I was born and raised, Fei, the Dryad Forest." Janette expressed her longing gaze upon the Dryad Forest, particularly considering her absence from home for the past two years.
Seeing Janette clench her fists tightly and her expression in pain, Zhang Fei took her hand directly.
"I understand how you're feeling, but it's crucial to manage your emotions and prevent vengeance from blinding your eyes and heart, as it could lead to irrational actions."
"En." Janette just nodded at Zhang Fei.
"Let's go down."
Zhang Fei nodded and hugged Janette's waist.
He carried her down from his flying artifact before storing it in his inventory.
They then walked into the forest, but most of the area they passed looked charred, and there were a lot of fallen trees around.
Janette looked very sad to see the forest where she was born and raised badly destroyed.
She, as a Dryad, is a tree humanoid, so she can hear and feel the sadness of the trees.
"It's been two years, but they're still hunting my kin."
After they had walked for quite a while, the city was right in their eyes.
However, just as they were about to go further, many tree roots suddenly attacked them.
Janette quickly stood in front of Zhang Fei and used her Tree Control to restrain them, then returned to her Dryad form while shouting.
"Stop it, guys!
It's me!
I'm home!"

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Dryad Forest
paragraphs: After Janette returned to her dryad form, the tree roots stopped attacking them and disappeared into the ground again. Soon, three young female dryads appeared from behind the trees, and their eyes lit up after seeing her.
All three of them are in their dryad form, so their bodies are no different from the plants around them, and their bodies come from different types of plants; only they can move and talk like humans.

One of them had waist-length blonde hair with amber eyes, but her body was too petite, like a teenage girl around fifteen years old, and she was also flat-chested. Even so, she had an attractive face, and her body gave off a calming aura.

The second dryad had as short red hair as a rose, and her appearance was that of a girl in her early twenties, but her expression was sadistic, with many spikes circling her body. Her eyes were red, and her fingers were more like claws. Her face is not very attractive, but her body is quite attractive, with medium breasts around the C-Cup, and her buttocks are quite large and stand out.

Zhang Fei was deemed the third dryad woman to be the most attractive, with her long white hair resembling a tulip, bangs adorning her forehead, and tulip branches and flowers covering her entire body. Her expression seemed calm but shy, but her eyes were a little unusual because they were red in contrast to her hair.
She was also no different from a girl in her early twenties, but her breasts were a little disappointing as they were quite small at A-Cup.

"Princess!" The three of them exclaimed with joy as they ran over to Janette before hugging her with feelings of longing, especially since they hadn't seen each other for quite a while. "Princess! You're finally back! We missed you so much!"
'Princess? She's a princess of the dryads, huh?' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered in surprise; he really didn't expect that Janette's status among the dryads was so high.

Janette herself looked so happy after seeing them, so she immediately hugged them tightly to vent the longing that had been buried deep in her heart for the past two years. "I'm glad the three of you are still alive! I also miss the three of you, Milia, Cassia, and Viola."
"Whoa! I'm glad you're safe, Princess." As she sobbed, Viola spoke.
Milia added. "I thought I would never see you again, Princess."
"We missed you and always worried about you, Princess." Cassia said it quietly and hugged Janette tighter.
Janette let out a soft sigh before releasing them from her embrace, looking at the three with a smile. "I'm sorry, I'm only back now, but I'll be staying here for quite a while."
"That's good! You have to tell us about your life in the human world, Princess." However, they were shocked as soon as they looked at Zhang Fei, especially since he was still in his human form.
Viola then inquired. "Who is he, Princess? Why did you bring a human into our forest?"
"If the Queen knew of the human presence in our forest, she would be very angry, Princess." Millia added.
Unlike them, Cassia continued to observe Zhang Fei with a curious gaze before speaking. "It's my first time seeing a human, but he doesn't look bad, unlike in the stories of the ancestors, Princess."

"Zhang Fei is the little brother of my human friend, and it was his big sister who helped me when I was seriously injured two years ago." Janette smiled as she explained, then introduced them to Zhang Fei, pointing at each one individually. "The blonde one is Viola, the white-haired one is Cassia, and the last one is Milia."
Zhang Fei nodded to them while saying this to Janette. "It seems there are a lot of things that you're still hiding from us, and I really didn't expect you to be a Princess of the Dryads."
Janette smiled bitterly at that, as she was indeed still hiding many things from them. "I'm sorry, Fei. I-"
"Sigh, you don't need to explain anything; I myself still keep many secrets from them." Zhang Fei said it with a shake of his head.

Cassia, Viola, and Milia looked at Zhang Fei curiously but also suspiciously. According to their ancestors' stories, humans were always rude and arrogant, and they often killed their kin. However, in their eyes, Zhang Fei appeared kind and friendly.
"Thank you." Janette was grateful for his understanding, and she told the three dryads about Zhang Fei's other identity. "Anyway, he isn't just a human; he's also a demon like us."

"Huh!?" Viola, Cassia, and Milia were shocked to hear that, especially since he was clearly a human, and they also didn't smell the demon scent from his body. "Are you kidding us, Princess? How can he be a demon?"
After hearing them, Zhang Fei smiled at them, and he immediately transformed himself into an Incubus, which made the three dryads even more shocked.
"Incubus!" The three of them shouted loudly, and many tree roots shot towards Zhang Fei from the ground, but Janette stopped them once again.

"All right, you guys can stop attacking Zhang Fei because he is not part of them, and he is really a human that I brought from the outside world, but he is also an incubus, as you guys have seen for yourself."
"Is that true, Princess?"
"Hey! I'm really a human, but I'm also an Incubus." Zhang Fei then turned himself into a white fox. "See? I'm a fox-beast, too."
"Eh!?" The three Dryads were stunned to see Zhang Fei's fox form, and they could feel that his aura was completely different from his incubus form, which actually made them feel relaxed.

Subconsciously, Cassia walked up to Zhang Fei, picked him up into her arms, and caressed his white fur. "Wow! Your fur is really smooth, much different from the fur of the demon beasts in this realm. Moreover, your fur is also much whiter than my hair, and I like it so much!"

Viola and Milia then approached them and stroked Zhang Fei's fur as they giggled happily like ordinary girls, causing him to sigh helplessly, especially since they were no different from Chu Qing and the others.
"This is my first time seeing a human who is also a demon and a beast." Viola said this as she continued to caress Zhang Fei's fur.
"True." Milia nodded in agreement, and she also continued to caress his fur. "His fur is really smooth, and I can't stop myself from stroking him."
Even though Dryad was a demon, the three of them looked so happy caring for Zhang Fei's fur, demonstrating that they had a good side and were friends with nature.
Janette was amused to see the three female dryads acting like that, but Zhang Fei himself seemed to really enjoy their actions. However, someone suddenly shouted at them. "What are you guys doing?"

Soon, a mature female Dryad appeared in front of them. Unlike Janette, she has long green hair, and her face is quite pretty and mature. She had green eyes, and her nose looked sharp, but her wide lips looked pale. However, her body looks completely tree-like, including her hair, which looks like small tree branches.
Even her fingers were sharp, and her entire body was like a large tree trunk, but her breasts were no less large than hers.
"Queen Lillea!" Cassia, Milia, and Viola immediately kneeled before her.

"En." Lillea nodded at them, but she was stunned for a moment after she saw Janette, so she immediately went over to her and hugged her tightly. "You are finally back here, my daughter. I'm glad that you're safe, and you also look so healthy now."
"Ugh! Let me go, mother! You're hugging me too tight!" Janette said it irritably, pushing her mother away. "Sooner or later, I will die from your embrace, Mother!"
Lillea giggled at Janette's words. "You three get up."
"Yes, my Queen." They answered in unison and immediately stood up.
"Oh? Where did this white fox come from?" Lillea inquired as she observed Zhang Fei, who was in Cassia's arms.

When she heard her question, Janette immediately explained it to Lillea. "Mother, Zhang Fei is my savior's little brother, and it was Zhang Yue who helped me when I arrived on earth two years ago; otherwise, I would have died if she hadn't taken care of my injuries at that time. Besides, he is very strong, so I brought her here to help us."

"Hmm?" Lillea took Zhang Fei seriously, particularly since she was unable to feel his power due to their differences, so she was skeptical if he could help them. Furthermore, their enemies were more than just random demons; they were three of the twelve rulers.
"Are you going to keep letting Cassia hug you, Fei?"
"Ha ha!" Zhang Fei laughed as he jumped down from Cassia's arms and returned to his human form, especially considering the negative reactions they had previously shown when they saw his incubus form.
"A human?" Lillea was shocked to see Zhang Fei, as she could sense that he was now a pure human. "How could he change from a beast to a human?"
"Mother, Zhang Fei's true identity is human, but he is also a beast, as you saw just now.
Lillea still couldn't digest her daughter's answer, especially since it was impossible for someone to be a beast and a human at the same time.

"Princess is telling the truth, My Queen." Cassia joined in, and the other two female dryads also nodded to her. "Apart from his human and fox forms, he also has a demon form, which is truly authentic because he has a demon scent on his body."

Lillea didn't say anything; she walked over to Zhang Fei and groped his body while muttering. "How unbelievable! I've lived for over a thousand years, but I've never heard of or seen a human, demon, or beast in one body."
"Hey, that's because I'm unique." Zhang Fei grabbed Lillea's hands and pushed them away, noting that her hands were too rough, akin to tree bark.

Lillea was stunned for a moment by Zhang Fei's action, especially since no human had ever touched her before, let alone a male human. Cassia, Viola, and Milia were surprised to see that. They knew that she didn't like being touched by anyone, including the rulers who coveted her, and she always got angry if that happened.

'Damn it! It seems that my mother has also fallen under Zhang Fei's deadly charm!' Janette inwardly cursed angrily before grabbing her mother's hand. "Anyway, let's get into the city first; I missed the others too."

Lillea nodded in agreement and led them into the half-destroyed city, but the three female dryads immediately returned to their respective positions, especially since their job was to monitor the situation around the city.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Dryad's Problem
paragraphs: As he followed behind Janette and Lillea, Zhang Fei continued to sigh as he watched the surrounding area of the city. From the remaining buildings that were still standing, he could see that the forest city was actually beautiful, but half of it had been destroyed, and there were so many Dryads who had been injured and died by enemy attacks.

Even so, none of them had the desire to leave the forest city, mainly because they had lived in that place since long ago, from the time of their ancestors, and the forests spread across the Diyu Realm were not suitable for them as Dryads.

"When was the last time they attacked this town, Mother?" "When was the last time they attacked this town, Mother?" Janette sadly asked, and her eyes filled with sorrow as she watched her hometown crumble.
Lillea sighed heavily at her daughter's question. "Three days ago, and they might attack us again in the next few days, so we have to start preparing now to face their wave of attacks."

Janette turned back and looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately nodded at her, so she stopped walking and grabbed Lillea's shoulders. "Mother, I have repeatedly asked you about the root of our problems, but you were never willing to tell me the truth. However, I am much more mature now, so I hope you can tell me the truth."

"She's right." Zhang Fei joined the conversation. "You may think that I'm still weak, but I can assure you that I have the ability to help you. However, I can't do anything until I know the real problem, which makes some rulers target you, so I hope you can tell us about it, and I will think of a solution to stop them."

Even though she didn't know for sure about Zhang Fei's strength and abilities, Lillea could see his confidence, so she immediately nodded and led them away to her private quarters. When they arrived there, he immediately told them the truth. "They want you, my daughter."
Janette and Zhang Fei looked at Lillea with raised eyebrows. "What really happened? Why do they want to get me?"

"You are no ordinary Dryad, and you are more special than me." Lillea then took a deep breath before revealing it. "Back then, I accidentally found one of the ten demon lord seeds, and I used it to give birth to you. That's why some of them want to capture you, and some of them want to kill you, especially since your existence threatens their ambition to become the supreme ruler of this realm."

After she heard that, Janette looked at Lillea in a daze. As a native of the Diyu Realm, she naturally knew about the ten demon lord seeds, but she never expected that her mother would find one of them, and she was even born because of both. "Is that true, Mother?"

[The Demon Extermination Sword has been fused with you, but you have to be careful when using it. A soul weapon is not a random weapon; many greedy people will try to snatch it from you if they find out about it.]
"I know." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Anyway, what kind of new feature do I get after the system upgrade?"

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Training Space
paragraphs: [Hmm, the new feature is a training space, but I'm having a hard time explaining it to you, so it would be better if you checked it out yourself.]
"All right, open the portal to enter that place, Mei."
[Alrighty!]

When he arrived inside, Zhang Fei gawked because the training space looked so modern and advanced, and there was an advanced piece of equipment right in the middle of it. "Hmm? Could it be that my savior came from an advanced place? Otherwise, she couldn't possibly have created Mei and the overpowered system, and this place is also far more advanced than all the facilities available in my country."
Zhang Fei then approached and checked the equipment in the middle of the training space. "How do I use this, Mei?"

Mei suddenly materialized in front of Zhang Fei, resembling a woman in her twenties with long white hair braided in some places. She has a tall and slim figure, clad in a modern suit that resembles a robot suit. However, he can see through her body, especially since she is just a hologram.
"How can you manifest yourself? Does this imply that you can also do it in the outside world?"

Mei shook her head at Zhang Fei. [I can manifest myself inside this training space due to its direct connection to the system, but I am unable to do so outside. As for my form, the creator created me like this, and I don't see any other option to change my appearance.]

However, Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after he noticed Mei's face, which was similar to the girl who changed her life. "Apparently, she created you using her own image, especially since your face is similar to hers. Anyway, show me the function of this equipment; I can't wait to try it."
[All right.]

As soon as Mei activated it, a transparent screen immediately appeared on the equipment, and it was like a game menu. The screen displayed several options, with some still locked and only three active at the moment.
[Menu]
1. Comprehension.
2. Gravity.
3. Battle simulation.
4. Locked.
5. Locked.
[Master, I don't know why the bottom two options are locked, and I think you have to wait for the next system upgrade for them to open.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "What is the function of the three options?"

[If I activate the gravity feature, the gravity here will be heavier than in the outside world, Master. Moreover, this feature has ten levels, and each level will increase the gravity by two times the previous level.]

"Oh?" After hearing that, Zhang Fei's eyes lit up, and he was sure that it would be of great benefit to him, especially to his speed. "So if I train at level one, then gravity becomes two times heavier than the outside world, right? If I train at level two, the gravity here will become four times heavier, right?"
[Yes.] Mei then explained the other feature. [Battle Simulation: You can spar with virtual opponents, but their strength will depend on your current cultivation.]

"I see." Zhang Fei felt that that feature was also very good, especially since his enemies were virtual, so he didn't need to hold back himself and fight them with full strength. "Then what about the third one?"
[Comprehension: It can help you to understand your techniques five times faster than normal, so you will be able to understand them faster, Master.]

"Hey, this training space is really awesome!" Zhang Fei exclaimed joyfully, but he suddenly remembered that he didn't have any other cultivation techniques, especially fighting techniques, and he had always relied on his demon and beast abilities before.

He immediately opened the system shop and looked for sword techniques, especially since he had the Demon Extermination Sword now, so he needed sword techniques to be able to use it properly. As his eyes read the dozens of sword techniques on the shop's list, he asked her for consideration. "Which sword techniques do you think are suitable for me?"

[Since you haven't mastered swordsmanship, I think the basic sword manual really suits you, Master. Furthermore, the sword control method, the sword element method, and the sword energy method will also prove beneficial to you, particularly as these are fundamental techniques. Once you become more skilled in swordsmanship, you can purchase some higher-level techniques.]

Zhang Fei agreed with Mei's opinion, especially since he wouldn't be able to practice high-level sword techniques if he hadn't mastered the basics of swordsmanship. "All right, you can buy them, and I will learn about them directly."
{You got the basic sword manual x1}
{You got the sword control method x1}
{You got the sword element method x1}
{You got the sword energy method x1}
{20,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei took a deep breath as soon as he saw the prices of the four techniques, especially since they were so expensive, even though they were only basic techniques, and he thought that high-level techniques would definitely be even more expensive. Luckily, he got a lot of jewels from the Li and Mei Clans, and the income from his shop was also quite large.
Even though his restaurant generates a substantial income, it still falls short of his shop's earnings. Following that, he promptly reviewed the four techniques.
[Basic Sword Manual: This is simply a manual for properly wielding a sword, swinging, slashing, thrusting, etc.]
[Sword Control Method: The first method is controlling the sword with Qi. The second method is controlling the sword with the heart.]
[Sword Element Method: The user can channel all kinds of elements into the sword, thereby increasing the power of the user's sword technique by several times.]

[Sword Energy Method: Sword energy can amplify sword intent to attack, suppress, and restrain people. This method has ten levels, and each level will increase the user's sword energy twofold. However, the user must have a good understanding of swordsmanship to be able to maximize its effects, especially the sword intent, which is the signature of a sword cultivator.]

"Sword intent, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he nodded in understanding. "Sigh, I don't have any understanding of swordsmanship, so I'll ask Lingxue and Qingyu later, especially since they are sword cultivators."
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 1,900 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 1,900 red jewels sent to inventory]

Zhang Fei immediately ignored the notification, especially since it was not that important to him, and sat cross-legged on the floor. "Mei, activate the comprehension, and I will learn those four techniques first."
[Alrighty!]
While the real him was training in the training space, Zhang Fei [1] had just opened his eyes after completing the daily quest, and the two women were already waiting for him with smiles.
"What are we going to do now, Fei?" Luo Yu was the first to ask him.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately got out of bed and answered her. "What else? We have to start looking for information about the mission so that we can quickly leave this village to complete the other four missions."

Gu Yan hurriedly informed him. "Anyway, I heard that Xia Leng and the others haven't returned to this village since yesterday, and the villagers said that they might have difficulty dealing with the beast that was the target of their mission."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] turned to Gu Yan with a raised eyebrow, but he didn't care much about Xia Leng and the other three, especially since he didn't know them. However, Xia Qianqian caught his interest, and he wanted her to be his dual cultivation partner, so he didn't want anything to happen to her. "What kind of beast are they looking for? Is it strong?"

"I don't know for sure, especially since the villagers don't have much information about that beast either." Gu Yan responded by shaking her head. "However, they said that the beast was an aquatic beast that lived in the southern ocean, but they never saw its true form, and they only saw many tentacles coming out of the sea, which they thought were part of it.
The presence of the beast makes the villagers always anxious, especially since their livelihood is selling aquatic beasts, and it repeatedly attacks them, so they have difficulty doing their work."

Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened the map and checked towards the southern ocean, and they found the names of the two female disciples on the edge of that place, but he could not find the three male disciples. 'Mei, why can't this map detect the depths of the ocean?'

[Master, it seems like something is preventing the map from detecting that deep, so you should probably go there and check it yourself. However, if Gu Yan's words just now are true, the beast is probably some kind of octopus or giant squid.]

Zhang Fei [1] agreed with her and spoke to the two women. "I think I know what kind of beast they are looking for, but it's none of our business, so it would be better if we asked the villagers about our mission."
"Aren't you interested in Qianqian? Aren't you afraid of her being eaten by that beast?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and pinched Gu Yan's nose instead. "Ning Qingxue and Xia Qianqian are fine; they are waiting at the edge of the ocean, so you don't need to worry about them. But I couldn't find Xia Leng and the others, and I think they are diving into the ocean to look for the beast. Even so, I don't know its exact strength, so I don't know whether they can deal with it or not.

Since they dared to embark on the mission, they should have understood the risks, and we don't need to interfere in their affairs. Moreover, they are cultivators, so they must be responsible for their own lives."

Gu Yan and Luo Yu released heavy sighs while shaking their heads, especially since Zhang Fei [1] was so apathetic towards others and more egocentric. sentences.text: [Hmm, the new feature is a training space, but I'm having a hard time explaining it to you, so it would be better if you checked it out yourself.]
"All right, open the portal to enter that place, Mei."
[Alrighty!]
When he arrived inside, Zhang Fei gawked because the training space looked so modern and advanced, and there was an advanced piece of equipment right in the middle of it.
"Hmm?
Could it be that my savior came from an advanced place?
Otherwise, she couldn't possibly have created Mei and the overpowered system, and this place is also far more advanced than all the facilities available in my country."
Zhang Fei then approached and checked the equipment in the middle of the training space.
"How do I use this, Mei?"
Mei suddenly materialized in front of Zhang Fei, resembling a woman in her twenties with long white hair braided in some places.
She has a tall and slim figure, clad in a modern suit that resembles a robot suit.
However, he can see through her body, especially since she is just a hologram.
"How can you manifest yourself?
Does this imply that you can also do it in the outside world?"
Mei shook her head at Zhang Fei.
[I can manifest myself inside this training space due to its direct connection to the system, but I am unable to do so outside.
As for my form, the creator created me like this, and I don't see any other option to change my appearance.]
However, Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after he noticed Mei's face, which was similar to the girl who changed her life.
"Apparently, she created you using her own image, especially since your face is similar to hers.
Anyway, show me the function of this equipment; I can't wait to try it."
[All right.]
As soon as Mei activated it, a transparent screen immediately appeared on the equipment, and it was like a game menu.
The screen displayed several options, with some still locked and only three active at the moment.
[Menu]
Comprehension.
Gravity.
Battle simulation.
Locked.
Locked.
[Master, I don't know why the bottom two options are locked, and I think you have to wait for the next system upgrade for them to open.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"What is the function of the three options?"
[If I activate the gravity feature, the gravity here will be heavier than in the outside world, Master.
Moreover, this feature has ten levels, and each level will increase the gravity by two times the previous level.]
"Oh?" After hearing that, Zhang Fei's eyes lit up, and he was sure that it would be of great benefit to him, especially to his speed.
"So if I train at level one, then gravity becomes two times heavier than the outside world, right?
If I train at level two, the gravity here will become four times heavier, right?"
[Yes.] Mei then explained the other feature.
[Battle Simulation: You can spar with virtual opponents, but their strength will depend on your current cultivation.]
"I see." Zhang Fei felt that that feature was also very good, especially since his enemies were virtual, so he didn't need to hold back himself and fight them with full strength.
"Then what about the third one?"
[Comprehension: It can help you to understand your techniques five times faster than normal, so you will be able to understand them faster, Master.]

"Hey, this training space is really awesome!" Zhang Fei exclaimed joyfully, but he suddenly remembered that he didn't have any other cultivation techniques, especially fighting techniques, and he had always relied on his demon and beast abilities before.
He immediately opened the system shop and looked for sword techniques, especially since he had the Demon Extermination Sword now, so he needed sword techniques to be able to use it properly.
As his eyes read the dozens of sword techniques on the shop's list, he asked her for consideration.
"Which sword techniques do you think are suitable for me?"
[Since you haven't mastered swordsmanship, I think the basic sword manual really suits you, Master.
Furthermore, the sword control method, the sword element method, and the sword energy method will also prove beneficial to you, particularly as these are fundamental techniques.
Once you become more skilled in swordsmanship, you can purchase some higher-level techniques.]
Zhang Fei agreed with Mei's opinion, especially since he wouldn't be able to practice high-level sword techniques if he hadn't mastered the basics of swordsmanship.

{You got the basic sword manual x1}
{You got the sword control method x1}
{You got the sword element method x1}
{You got the sword energy method x1}
{20,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei took a deep breath as soon as he saw the prices of the four techniques, especially since they were so expensive, even though they were only basic techniques, and he thought that high-level techniques would definitely be even more expensive.
Luckily, he got a lot of jewels from the Li and Mei Clans, and the income from his shop was also quite large.
Even though his restaurant generates a substantial income, it still falls short of his shop's earnings.

[Sword Control Method: The first method is controlling the sword with Qi.

[Sword Element Method: The user can channel all kinds of elements into the sword, thereby increasing the power of the user's sword technique by several times.]
[Sword Energy Method: Sword energy can amplify sword intent to attack, suppress, and restrain people.
This method has ten levels, and each level will increase the user's sword energy twofold.

[Ding]

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Demon Remnant I
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei [1] used the Nine Cloud Steps several times, the three of them finally arrived at the mountain the village chief was referring to, but two middle-aged men immediately stopped them. "Halt!

Matriarch Liu forbids anyone from approaching this place, and the cultivation of the three of you is still too low, so you guys have to go back, or you guys will die from the demon miasma that still remains in this place."
"Hmm? Do you two come from the Liu Clan, seniors?"

"Yes." One of them then introduced themselves. "My name is Liu Bai, and my brother's name is Liu Kang. Our matriarch ordered us to guard this place, especially since there were too many victims who died there in the past, and the demon miasma was too strong for humans like us."

"Hasn't the demon invasion passed for so long, seniors? How can their miasma remain in this place?" Gu Yan asked as she looked at the cave entrance, which was quite far in front of them, but they could see a strange black aura from the cave.

Liu Kang sighed softly before telling them. "You don't know the horror of those demons; they are much stronger than our ancestors. Many of our ancestors had to die in order to seal the portal in the Demon Cave, so you don't need to be surprised if their miasma still lingers in this place today.
Otherwise, this realm would have fallen into their hands, and we wouldn't be able to live as peacefully as we do now."

"My brother is right." Liu Bai also spoke to them. In the past, those demons controlled almost our entire realm, massacred countless people in various corners, and even destroyed many clans. Fortunately, our ancestors were willing to unite to repel the demon invaders, and they finally succeeded in doing so with fierce resistance, including sacrificing themselves.

Unfortunately, one of the clans from our realm actually forgot the hard work of our ancestors by choosing the heretic path in order to become strong, and they tried to destroy the seal on the demon portal."

"The Pang Clan, right?" They nodded to Zhang Fei [1], but he then took out a token and showed it to them, making them look at him with frowns. "Seniors, you don't need to look at me that way, and I dare to guarantee that this token is genuine, especially since your second young miss gave it to me.
If you don't believe me, then you can contact her now and tell her that I, Zhang Fei, showed it to you guys."

Liu Kang immediately took the token from Zhang Fei [1]'s hand, and they observed it seriously before becoming convinced that it was genuine. "What is your relationship with our second young miss? We have heard that Pang Hong no longer controls her, and she is now active again in the western region."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed while rubbing the back of his head. "Seniors, you two probably won't believe me if I say I'm her husband, so it would be better if you contact Hua'er now, and she will confirm my identity."

The two middle-aged men were shocked by his confession, and they exchanged looks of disbelief, but Liu Bai immediately nodded to his brother, so Liu Kang contacted Liu Hua directly to confirm Zhang Fei [1]'s identity.

They didn't have to wait long because Liu Hua gave them an immediate answer, and she also asked them to allow Zhang Fei [1] to enter the cave. After all, he was a demon, so she was sure he would be fine if he went there.

'What should we do now?' Liu Kang asked his brother via voice transmission. 'This young man is really the husband of our second young miss, and she asked us to let him go to that cave. However, his cultivation is still too weak, and our matriarch will definitely blame us if he dies inside.'

Liu Bai frowned and asked him back. 'Is our second young miss crazy now? How could she allow her husband to enter such a dangerous place? Even our matriarch doesn't dare venture too deep with her cultivation already at 1-Star Heaven Realm, and this young man will definitely die in there.'

"Seniors, I appreciate the worry of the two of you, but I will definitely be fine, so let me enter the cave, and I will complete our mission." The two men wanted to interrupt him, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately summoned Boitata out of his beast space, making them instinctively take a step back. "She is my protector, so I will be completely safe with her by my side."
'Unbelievable! This woman is much stronger than our matriarch; that means she is the strongest in all regions!' As they gazed at Boitata, Liu Kang and Liu Bai silently muttered.

Boitata couldn't care less about their stares; instead, she complained to Zhang Fei [1]. "Master! You previously summoned me to that disgusting place, and now you summon me to one that is no less disgusting than that!"
'Master? How could a woman as strong as herself be willing to acknowledge this young man as her master?' The two middle-aged men screamed in their hearts.
*Slap*
"Ahh!" Boitata let out a high-pitched cry before rubbing her buttocks. "Why did you slap my butt so hard, Master?"

"If you continue to complain, I will punish you severely later." Boitata immediately covered her mouth with her hands as soon as Zhang Fei [1] threatened her like that. "I won't summon you there, and I just need your help to convince these two seniors, so you can stop complaining."

Boitata immediately turned to the two middle-aged men, unleashing her aura to intimidate them. She then placed her left hand on her waist, and her right hand pointed at them. "He is my master, so you two must let him in there, or I will swallow you both alive. Do you two understand?"
The two men gulped hard because Boitata could literally kill them without even blinking, and they nodded repeatedly without saying a word, but their expressions were filled with fear towards her.
"Good!" Boitata then, with a proud smile, turned to Zhang Fei [1], who shook his head at her. "Master, you can enter the cave now, and I'll return to your beast space."
Boitata instantly disappeared from before them, and Zhang Fei [1] spoke to the two women. "You guys wait here, and I will enter the cave alone."
"But, Fei-"

"Stop it, Yan." Luo Yu immediately stopped Gu Yan. "Have you forgotten his other identity? We will only be a burden to him if we go with him into that cave, so we should just wait here, and he will definitely be fine."
Gu Yan nodded in understanding. "All right, you can go in there, and the two of us will wait for you here, Fei."

Zhang Fei [1] nodded and teleported in front of the cave door, making the two middle-aged men turn toward his direction in shock, especially since they couldn't see his movements. However, he immediately rushed into the cave before transforming into his incubus form, especially since the demon miasma inside was too strong.
"What is the relationship between you two and our young master?" After Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from their sight, Liu Bai asked the two women.
"Haha." Gu Yan giggled before telling them. "Seniors, the three of us are disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and we are his dual cultivation partners."
"Eh?" They looked at the two women in surprise, and they never thought that their second young miss would marry a dual cultivator.

Luo Yu then explained it to them. "Honestly, I was shocked to learn that he had such a relationship with your clan, seniors. However, he told us that he had several wives, and they lived together in the western region, but we have never met them."

After that, the two men didn't ask anything else and watched the cave entrance with worried expressions, but they also continued to wonder about Zhang Fei's identity, including about his relationship with Liu Hua.

Zhang Fei [1] walked through the dark cave while looking at the map, but he didn't find anyone or anything on it, so he was relieved by that. "Hey, Mei! What do you think is the reason the demon miasma in this place still hasn't disappeared, even though a long time has passed? Even now, the demon miasma in this place is thick.
[I can't say for sure about that, Master. Anyway, you should be able to absorb this demon miasma into your body, and it might be useful for you, especially since you are a pure demon.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] momentarily raised his eyebrows before trying to do so, but he couldn't feel anything, even though his body had started to absorb the demon miasma. "Are you sure this will be useful for me? Why don't I feel anything?"
[Hmm? Perhaps my guess was wrong, Master. Even so, I think you can absorb it all, so this cave will return to normal, and the people in this region won't have to worry about this place anymore.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement, and he continued to absorb the demon miasma as he ventured deeper into the cave. He felt that it became thicker and thicker the deeper he went.

After he walked for a long time, Zhang Fei [1] finally arrived at the deepest part of the cave. However, he immediately frowned because he felt such a strong aura from within, so he summoned the Demon Extermination Sword directly. "Fortunately, my real body and clone are always connected to each other, and we also share everything, so I can use this sword."

[Hehe, that's the grandness of your demon body clone, Master. Most likely, only you have this special clone ability in this universe, especially since it was a gift from the system's creator, so other humans or demons will not have it.]

Zhang Fei [1] then used the sword element method to channel his light qi into his sword, making it glow white. "Hahaha! The other demons will definitely be jealous if they see me using the light element, particularly since the light element is their nemesis."

[That's for sure, Master! If other demons come into contact with light elements, they will undoubtedly suffer serious injuries and, in the worst-case scenario, die. Fortunately, you are not only a demon, but you are also a heavenly fox, so you are immune to the light element. However, Angela could potentially pose a threat to you, given that she possesses the light element despite being a demon.]

Zhang Fei [1] wanted to reply to Mei, but his focus was suddenly diverted by a black tree at the end of the cave. However, he also smelled the strong smell of blood from the black tree, making him a little nauseous. "Could it be that that person wanted this black tree? How did that person know that it was here?
[Perhaps the person who submitted the mission is related to the demons who invaded this realm in the past, Master. Could that person be related to the Pang Clan?]

"I think that possibility does exist, especially since the Pang Clan is so eager to break the seal on the demon cave, which means they want those demons to return to this realm, so maybe there is someone from that clan who has ties to them." Zhang Fei [1] then squatted in front of the black tree and tried to touch it. "Can you scan this tree, Mei?"
[I will try it!]
Name: Blood Tree Demon
Attributes: blood and darkness.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

Zhang Fei [1] sighed in disappointment because the system could only scan it to that extend, so he didn't know the use of the black tree. "What do you think if I uproot this tree and keep it in my portable mansion?"

What do you think is the reason the demon miasma in this place still hasn't disappeared, even though a long time has passed?
Even now, the demon miasma in this place is thick.
[I can't say for sure about that, Master.
Anyway, you should be able to absorb this demon miasma into your body, and it might be useful for you, especially since you are a pure demon.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] momentarily raised his eyebrows before trying to do so, but he couldn't feel anything, even though his body had started to absorb the demon miasma.
"Are you sure this will be useful for me?
Why don't I feel anything?"
[Hmm?
Perhaps my guess was wrong, Master.
Even so, I think you can absorb it all, so this cave will return to normal, and the people in this region won't have to worry about this place anymore.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement, and he continued to absorb the demon miasma as he ventured deeper into the cave.
He felt that it became thicker and thicker the deeper he went.
After he walked for a long time, Zhang Fei [1] finally arrived at the deepest part of the cave.
However, he immediately frowned because he felt such a strong aura from within, so he summoned the Demon Extermination Sword directly.
"Fortunately, my real body and clone are always connected to each other, and we also share everything, so I can use this sword."
[Hehe, that's the grandness of your demon body clone, Master.
Most likely, only you have this special clone ability in this universe, especially since it was a gift from the system's creator, so other humans or demons will not have it.]
Zhang Fei [1] then used the sword element method to channel his light qi into his sword, making it glow white.
"Hahaha!
The other demons will definitely be jealous if they see me using the light element, particularly since the light element is their nemesis."
[That's for sure, Master!
If other demons come into contact with light elements, they will undoubtedly suffer serious injuries and, in the worst-case scenario, die.
Fortunately, you are not only a demon, but you are also a heavenly fox, so you are immune to the light element.
However, Angela could potentially pose a threat to you, given that she possesses the light element despite being a demon.]
Zhang Fei [1] wanted to reply to Mei, but his focus was suddenly diverted by a black tree at the end of the cave.
However, he also smelled the strong smell of blood from the black tree, making him a little nauseous.
"Could it be that that person wanted this black tree?
How did that person know that it was here?
[Perhaps the person who submitted the mission is related to the demons who invaded this realm in the past, Master.
Could that person be related to the Pang Clan?]

"I think that possibility does exist, especially since the Pang Clan is so eager to break the seal on the demon cave, which means they want those demons to return to this realm, so maybe there is someone from that clan who has ties to them." Zhang Fei [1] then squatted in front of the black tree and tried to touch it.
"Can you scan this tree, Mei?"
[I will try it!]
Name: Blood Tree Demon
Attributes: blood and darkness.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
Zhang Fei [1] sighed in disappointment because the system could only scan it to that extend, so he didn't know the use of the black tree.
"What do you think if I uproot this tree and keep it in my portable mansion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Demon Remnant II
paragraphs: [I don't recommend it, Master. Shi Wu and Shi Xi are ordinary humans, and exposure to this demon miasma will undoubtedly result in their deaths. Actually, it would be better for you to leave them in the Chu Clan and teach them cultivation, so they will be more useful to you.
In this manner, you can relocate the blood tree demon to your portable mansion, but it will prevent all of them from entering again due to the demon's miasma spreading and filling it.]

Zhang Fei [1] actually did not want to teach the Shi Sisters about cultivation, as he thought that they might betray him in the future. After all, they didn't have a good relationship, and he captured them after Guo Lan's kidnapping. However, he also took Mei's words seriously, especially since they would indeed be more useful to him if they were cultivators. "Anyway, is Mei Xiang awake now?"
[Not yet. Mei Xiang suffered a heavy blow to her mental and soul, especially after she saw her eldest son's head, so she is still unconscious now.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding before deciding to take Qiao Ran out of his portable mansion, especially since he wanted to see the effect of the demon miasma on her.

"Argh!" Qiao Ran instantly groaned in pain and fell to the ground as soon as she appeared in the cave. Her expression was filled with pain from the demon miasma that entered her body through her pores. However, as soon as she saw Zhang Fei [1] in incubus form, her expression looked shocked, and she also realized their location. "Argh! Why did you bring me to this place?
I will die if this demon miasma continues to enter my body."

"What else?" Zhang Fei [1] then squatted down beside Qiao Ran and opened her top, noticing that her white skin was starting to turn black due to the demon miasma. "I want to know how this demon miasma affects humans, so I will use you as a guinea pig to find out the results. However, you don't need to worry; I won't let you die, especially since you are still useful to me."

'Argh! This bastard is truly evil! I had no idea he was a demon masquerading as a human!' But alas, Qiao Ran had misjudged Zhang Fei [1], especially since she didn't know that he had three forms, all three of which were real. "Argh! Please send me back in there; this demon miasma is eating away at my body from within."
[Master, you better absorb the demon miasma that entered Qiao Ran's body and send her back to the portable mansion, or she will really die if you keep her here.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded and touched Qiao Ran's chest. He then absorbed all of the demon miasma that was already inside her body, causing it to recover quickly. Once her body was free of the demon miasma, he sent her back into the portable mansion. "Sigh. I want to have this blood tree demon, but it would be troublesome if I moved it there."
[Master, I think you can use another method to obtain this blood tree demon.]
"What do you mean, Mei?"
[Hehe, you have the training space, and I think you can move this blood tree demon in there first, so the four women inside the portable mansion won't be affected by the demon miasma.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows after hearing that. "Shouldn't they be able to train in my training space? I thought about letting them train in there later, but they won't be able to do that if I keep this blood tree demon in there."

[You're right; they can indeed train there, but I'm not asking you to keep this blood tree demon in there, Master. You can move it there first, and your real body can move it to the Diyu Realm. After all, that realm is also the realm of demons, and this demon miasma won't affect them, so I think it's the best solution for that.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and tried to dig up the blood demon tree, but a black smoke suddenly emerged from the tree, which immediately turned into a huge demon figure like an oni. It had two large horns on its head, as well as two large fangs protruding from its mouth. "Hmm? An incubus? How did you get here? Did Azarel send you here?
Why do you want to dig up this tree?"
[Master, this demon is just a remnant of his soul; he no longer has his prime strength, so you don't need to be afraid of him.]
Hearing that, Zhang Fe [1] stood up, smirked faintly, and immediately pressed the Demon Extermination Sword, coated in his light qi, towards the demon's neck.

The demon instantly released a groan filled with pain from the effects of his light element. "Argh! Stop it! How... how can a lust demon like you use the light element? I'll disappear if you do this to me!"
"How can I use the light element? Obviously, this is because I'm not an ordinary demon, but I won't tell you anything." Zhang Fei [1] then pressed his sword even more against the demon's neck.

"Anyway, I know that this is just your soul remnant, so you won't be able to do anything to me, and I will give you an easy death if you answer all my questions; otherwise, I will torture you first before I eliminate you."
'This bastard! How is this possible? Even the demon lord couldn't do such a thing!' The demon grumbled to himself, especially since he indeed couldn't do anything against Zhang Fei [1].

"Which realm do you come from? Who is Azarel? What is your purpose in planting this demon blood tree in this place? Are there other trees elsewhere?" Zhang Fei [1] asked him a few questions, but the demon didn't seem to want to answer them, so he immediately swung his sword and slashed his right arm clean, causing him to let out a painful roar that sounded out of the cave.
"You better not test my patience and answer my questions now, or else I will make you suffer more than this."

'Damn it! How is this possible? How could his sword cut through my soul remnant?' The demon muttered as he shivered, looking at the Demon Extermination Swrod in Zhang Fei [1]'s hand. "I am a demon from the Netherworld Realm, and my lord deliberately left the remains of my soul in this blood demon tree to scare away humans who try to approach it."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows after hearing that. "No wonder I felt the same urge when Mei opened the gate to that realm from this cave; it turns out you came from that realm. Answer my other questions."
"Azarel is the Incubus Lord, and I originally thought that you were his subordinate, but that's impossible because you can use the light element."
"That's right." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to him. "I am indeed an incubus, but I am not a demon from the Netherworld Realm."

"As for your question about this blood tree demon, there are still four other trees in this realm, and each is located in four different regions." Zhang Fei [1] looked at the demon with narrowed eyes after hearing that. "You don't need to ask me for their location because I don't know where they put the other four, and each demon blood tree is guarded by other remnant souls from other demons.

This tree is used for long-term plans because it takes a very long time to mature, and it will release a more potent demon miasma upon reaching maturity, which will kill all humans in this realm before turning them into mindless demons."

Zhang Fei's face darkened upon hearing that, and without thinking twice, he increased his light element before slashing his sword several times, killing the demon directly. After that, he opened his map to search for the whereabouts of the other blood demon trees, but it and Mei couldn't detect their presence. "Tch! This matter is truly troublesome!

I have to inform Hua'er and Lingxue about this so they can move to find their whereabouts. Otherwise, everything will be too late if the four trees are allowed to reach their maturity, and the people in this realm will suffer."
[Master, you must warn them not to approach the four trees' location if they find them, or else they will suffer the same torment that Qiao Ran endured earlier.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement when he informed his two wives about the blood demon tree in the other four regions, and he also asked them to inform the people in the northern and eastern regions, especially since he didn't know the people from both regions.

After he did that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately dug up the blood demon tree before sending it into his training space, and he then walked out leisurely while absorbing the remaining demon miasma left in the cave.
Meanwhile, Liu Bai and Liu Kang exchanged looks of shock when they saw the demon miasma in the cave dissipating quickly. "Do you think our young master managed to clear it?"

Liu Kang nodded to his brother. "I don't know the source of the demon miasma myself, but there might be something in that cave that caused it, and our young master has probably gotten rid of it by now."

"In that case, we should report this matter to our matriarch, so we can immediately check inside once the demon miasma completely disappears." Liu Bai took out his communication device and contacted Liu Rong directly, but it was useless because Liu Hua had immediately informed her mother as soon as she received information about it from Zhang Fei [1].
"The second young miss has already informed her about this matter, and she asked us to coordinate with our young master."
"Did our matriarch tell you something else?"

"Yes." Liu Bai then told his brother about the existence of the other four blood demon trees, shocking Liu Kang. "I don't know how our young master did it, but this is really good for our region's people, and we no longer need to guard this place."
Liu Kang agreed with him. "We've guarded this place for so long, and we can finally return to our clan to be with our families."

After that, they ran towards the entrance of the cave, especially since the demon miasma was no longer visible from the outside, so they felt that it was safe for them to go there. Gu Yan and Luo Yu followed them immediately, and they waited together for Zhang Fei [1] to come out from inside.

After they waited for some time, Zhang Fei [1], who had already returned to his human form, casually walked out, and the two women immediately jumped up to hug him before examining his body from top to bottom. "Hahaha! You guys don't need to act like this, you know? Nothing happened to me, and I already got rid of something inside there, so the demon miasma won't appear here again."
"That's good." Both women said this while releasing sighs of relief.
"Young master, have you eliminated the blood demon tree?" Liu Kang asked him.

"Yes, I destroyed the tree." Both men nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "However, there are still four more trees in other regions, and they should have moved to find their location by now. Even so, they won't be able to get close to those trees, so I'll wait for news from Hua'er before going to eliminate them, and our realm will be safe from them."
"Our matriarch had already told us earlier, and she asked us to follow your instructions regarding this cave."
However, Zhang Fei shook his head at them. "Seniors, you don't need to check this cave anymore because there is only that tree inside, so you two can return to the Liu Clan now."
The two middle-aged men exchanged glances for a moment before saying goodbye to Zhang Fei [1] and the others, and they immediately left the place.

Zhang Fei [1] then hugged the two women's waists as he said. "Let's go back to the village, and we'll leave tomorrow. As for the mission, we won't get any points, especially since I already destroyed the item."

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Senior Cultivators
paragraphs: Many mingzhu crystals illuminated the walls of a cave, where several men and women sat around a fairly large, transparent red pyramid. In the center, there was a constantly glowing black hole; this was the portal that connected the Sky Jade Realm to the Netherworld Realm.

These people were none other than the ancestors and leaders of clans and sects in the Sky Jade Realm, who were attempting to protect the transparent red pyramid from destruction. This was particularly important because their ancestors had created the seal by sacrificing their lives to stop the demon that had previously invaded their realm.

The ancestors and patriarchs of the Chang, Zhang, Lan, and Di clans represented the Central Region. Besides them, there was also the tribe leader of the Moon Fox Race, Hu Gao. Even the Blazing Phoenix Sect sect master, Feng Yao, had arrived at that location, and she represented her Feng Clan.
The patriarchs of the Chu, Ye, Gu, and Zhao Clans, representing the Western Region, were present. In addition, the Sect Master of Heavenly Sword Sect was also present among them.
The Eastern Region was represented by the Guo and Huan Clans' ancestor and patriarch, as well as the Luo, Qiao, and Dong Clans' matriarchs. There was also the Desolate Sect's sect master.

The others were the representatives of the Southern Region: the ancestor and patriarch of the Liu Clan, the patriarch of the Shen Clan, and the matriarch of the Meng Clan. Beside them, there was also a woman who was the sect master of the Hidden Sea Palace, and another woman was the sect master of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Yan Zixiu.

As for the northern region, naturally there are no representatives from them, especially since there are only the Pang Clan and the Demon Sect in that region, and they actually want to destroy the seal.

A woman with flowing reddish-black hair suddenly spoke to them. "I just received information from two members of my clan about the demon cave in my area, and the source is the blood demon tree inside. However, the tree has been destroyed now, and the cave has returned to normal again."

The woman still looks charming despite her old age, and the red tattoo on her forehead makes her look unique. Her blue and gold dress accentuates her buxom figure, and her E-cup breasts remain full and do not sag.
Her words shocked everyone present, and the matriarch of the Meng Clan questioned her. "Is that true, Liu Rong? Who was the person who managed to get rid of the demon miasma?"
"Why would I lie to you, Meng Qi?" Liu Rong responded with a shake of her head. "Actually, I haven't met that person myself, but he is Hua'er's husband."

"Seriously?" Not only Meng Qi was surprised to hear the latter name, especially since they remembered for sure that Liu Hua had fallen under Pang Hong's control several years ago and that no one had ever managed to escape from his control before. "Is that true? How could your second daughter be free from Pang Hong's control? Was her husband the one who saved her from him?"

"Gezz! You guys! I couldn't possibly lie to all of you, right?" Liu Rong responded with a soft sigh as she saw their expressions. "Hua'er has truly been freed from Pang Hong's control, and you guys are right that it was her husband who freed her.
If you are curious about his identity, you can ask my son-in-law, especially since I myself haven't met him, and my two granddaughters have also become his wives now."

Hearing that, all of them immediately turned to Chu Hong, who had come alone to represent the Chu Clan, causing him to laugh wryly due to his discomfort at their gazes. "My sister-in-law has indeed returned to normal now, and her husband's name is Zhang Fei. Just like my mother-in-law said, Ying'er and Qing'er have also married him, so he is now part of the Chu and Liu clans. He-"
Just as Chu Hong was about to continue his words, Zhang Long, the Zhang Clan ancestor, interrupted him. "Zhang Fei? I never knew there was a man named Zhang Fei in my clan before."
"Yes, Father, there is no such name in our main clan or branch clan." Zhang Wuji, patriarch of the Zhang Clan, then asked Chu Hong. "Are you sure that his name is really Zhang Fei?"

"His name is indeed Zhang Fei, but he is not a member of your Zhang Clan, Brother Wuji." Chu Hong replied with a nod. "However, I still don't know about his origins or how he released Hua'er from under Pang Hong's control, especially since I hurriedly came here, so I haven't talked to him too much."

"Wuji! Old Long! Zhang Fei is now a member of your clan." The two men from the Zhang Clan immediately turned to Feng Yao with raised eyebrows. "Before I came here, I had already met and talked with Lingxue, and she had already given her virginity to him, so I wouldn't be wrong if I said that he was a member of your clan, right?"
"What?" Both of them screamed in shock after hearing that.

Feng Yao then told them about their meeting based on Zhang Lingxue's story, including the reason she decided to choose Zhang Fei as her husband. Afterwards, both men contacted their families to confirm their relationship, which was confirmed by Zi'er and Yang Yudie's explanations.

"Your daughter also decided to become his wife." Feng Yao said this as she turned to Ye Yuan, the patriarch of the Ye Clan. However, she didn't say anything about Zhang Fei's relationship with Zhao Ziqin, especially since Zhang Lingxue had already told her about his problems with the Zhao, Huan, and Qiao Clans, whose representatives were also present.

"I know." Ye Yuan replied with a nod. "When I was on my way here, my wife had already told me about their relationship, and she had also met Zhang Fei a few days ago. Honestly, I still regret the failure of the marriage plans between Lian'er and Zhan'er, but my daughter has already made up her mind, so we decided to approve their relationship."

"Haha." Gu Tong, the patriarch of the Gu Clan, laughed when he heard that. "Brother Ye, you don't need to regret it, especially since it was my son's fault, and they wouldn't have failed to get married if he hadn't had an affair with the female disciples of their sect."

Suddenly, the Heavenly Sword Sect's sect master joined their conversation. "Back then, I thought that Zhan'er and Lian'er were a perfect couple, but unfortunately, he was playing with several other female disciples behind her back. I even tried to advise him repeatedly, but he never listened to my advice."

"Yeah, you're right; I hope the same as you." Ba Jiawen said this as he nodded.

"The demon soul remnant, intentionally implanted into the blood tree demon, informed him about it, confirming its truth. "Unfortunately, we still haven't been able to find their whereabouts, Senior Guo. The members of the Pang Clan hide really neatly like rats, and they always move secretly; even some of our clansmen fall under their control."

However, they didn't realize that some of them were grinning faintly and secretly sending information about their conversation to outsiders.

sentences.text: Many mingzhu crystals illuminated the walls of a cave, where several men and women sat around a fairly large, transparent red pyramid.
In the center, there was a constantly glowing black hole; this was the portal that connected the Sky Jade Realm to the Netherworld Realm.
These people were none other than the ancestors and leaders of clans and sects in the Sky Jade Realm, who were attempting to protect the transparent red pyramid from destruction.
This was particularly important because their ancestors had created the seal by sacrificing their lives to stop the demon that had previously invaded their realm.
The ancestors and patriarchs of the Chang, Zhang, Lan, and Di clans represented the Central Region.
Besides them, there was also the tribe leader of the Moon Fox Race, Hu Gao.
Even the Blazing Phoenix Sect sect master, Feng Yao, had arrived at that location, and she represented her Feng Clan.
The patriarchs of the Chu, Ye, Gu, and Zhao Clans, representing the Western Region, were present.
In addition, the Sect Master of Heavenly Sword Sect was also present among them.
The Eastern Region was represented by the Guo and Huan Clans' ancestor and patriarch, as well as the Luo, Qiao, and Dong Clans' matriarchs.
There was also the Desolate Sect's sect master.
The others were the representatives of the Southern Region: the ancestor and patriarch of the Liu Clan, the patriarch of the Shen Clan, and the matriarch of the Meng Clan.
Beside them, there was also a woman who was the sect master of the Hidden Sea Palace, and another woman was the sect master of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Yan Zixiu.

As for the northern region, naturally there are no representatives from them, especially since there are only the Pang Clan and the Demon Sect in that region, and they actually want to destroy the seal.
A woman with flowing reddish-black hair suddenly spoke to them.
"I just received information from two members of my clan about the demon cave in my area, and the source is the blood demon tree inside.
However, the tree has been destroyed now, and the cave has returned to normal again."
The woman still looks charming despite her old age, and the red tattoo on her forehead makes her look unique.
Her blue and gold dress accentuates her buxom figure, and her E-cup breasts remain full and do not sag.
Her words shocked everyone present, and the matriarch of the Meng Clan questioned her.
"Is that true, Liu Rong?
Who was the person who managed to get rid of the demon miasma?"
"Why would I lie to you, Meng Qi?" Liu Rong responded with a shake of her head.
"Actually, I haven't met that person myself, but he is Hua'er's husband."

"Seriously?" Not only Meng Qi was surprised to hear the latter name, especially since they remembered for sure that Liu Hua had fallen under Pang Hong's control several years ago and that no one had ever managed to escape from his control before.
"Is that true?
How could your second daughter be free from Pang Hong's control?
Was her husband the one who saved her from him?"
"Gezz!
You guys!
I couldn't possibly lie to all of you, right?" Liu Rong responded with a soft sigh as she saw their expressions.
"Hua'er has truly been freed from Pang Hong's control, and you guys are right that it was her husband who freed her.
If you are curious about his identity, you can ask my son-in-law, especially since I myself haven't met him, and my two granddaughters have also become his wives now."
Hearing that, all of them immediately turned to Chu Hong, who had come alone to represent the Chu Clan, causing him to laugh wryly due to his discomfort at their gazes.
"My sister-in-law has indeed returned to normal now, and her husband's name is Zhang Fei.
Just like my mother-in-law said, Ying'er and Qing'er have also married him, so he is now part of the Chu and Liu clans.
He-"
Just as Chu Hong was about to continue his words, Zhang Long, the Zhang Clan ancestor, interrupted him.

"Yes, Father, there is no such name in our main clan or branch clan." Zhang Wuji, patriarch of the Zhang Clan, then asked Chu Hong.
"Are you sure that his name is really Zhang Fei?"
"His name is indeed Zhang Fei, but he is not a member of your Zhang Clan, Brother Wuji." Chu Hong replied with a nod.
