chapters.title: Chapter 193: Pang Clan
paragraphs: In a dark room, a man kept walking back and forth while cursing repeatedly. "That bastard, Guan Yu! It's been a few days since he last informed me that he had started the plan, but he still hasn't told me the results! Could it be that he failed to do so? That shouldn't be possible; his cultivation is above that of Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu, so he should be able to capture them."
"Why do you keep getting angry like this, Pang Hong?" A man dressed all in black asked as he walked into the room, and two other men followed behind him.

"Tch! "I sent my subordinate to do something about the Liu Sisters, but he seems to have disappeared now, and he hasn't even given me any news for days." Pang Hong replied irritably before asking them. "Why did you three suddenly come back here, Pang De?"

"Haha." Pang De laughed and sat down on an empty chair. "Somehow, I feel that you are too stupid, especially since Liu Hua was in your hands for several years and you never did anything to her. Even a novice cultivator was able to free her from you, and you also had to suffer serious injuries because of him."
"Hey, are you impotent, Pang Hong?" The second man asked as he put on a mocking look.

The third man also said this to Pang Hong mockingly. "If Liu Hua were under my control, I would have enjoyed her sexy body long ago, and she wouldn't be able to return to her senses anymore, let alone escape from me."
"Bastard! How dare you two mock me, Pang Zhen and Pang Gui?" Pang Hong shouted angrily as he released his aura.
"Enough!" Pang De immediately stopped Pang Hong and restrained him with his aura. "We came here to discuss something, so you better hold back your anger."
"What do you want to discuss with me?" Pang Hong inquired as he retracted his aura, but he continued to glare fiercely at Pang Zhen and Pang Gui.

Pang De immediately released Pang Hong before providing an explanation. "Our spies in the demon cave informed me that Zhang Fei, who freed Liu Hua from your control, has ties to the Chu, Ye, and Zhang Clans, particularly since their four young misses are now his wives. Therefore, you should exercise caution when acting against them to avoid suffering yourself if you act rashly."

"Hmm?" Pang Hong's expression turned ugly after hearing the last clan name. "Could that guy have caught Guan Yu? How could that be possible? When we last met, his cultivation was still in the elementary realm, so he couldn't possibly defeat him, even if the Liu Sisters helped him."

"Unfortunately, you're wrong about that." Pang Zhen said while shaking his head. "Some time ago, Zhang Lingxue wandered around the western and southern regions, and she was one of Zhang Fei's wives now, so she must have helped them capture that idiot."
"How did you know about that?" Pang Hong inquired as he turned to face him.

"What a fool!" Pang Zhen countered with a sneer. "Unlike you, who only focuses on the Liu Sisters, I have recruited two clans from the southern region to be our vassals, and Zhang Lingxue previously went to one of those clans, so they immediately informed me about her arrival."

"While you were busy recovering from your injuries caused by Zhang Fei, I've also managed to recruit two clans from the eastern region outside the Guan Clan, and their strength is comparable to the Guo, Luo, and Dong Clans." Pang Gui joined in showing off his success, making Pang Hong's expression even uglier.

"We know that you wanted to recruit the Li and Mei Clans from the western region, but your efforts were in vain because the people from both clans have disappeared, and their clans have been taken over by the Chu Clan."
"What?" Pang Hong exclaimed in shock after hearing that.
"All right, let's stop this trivial conversation, especially since we are facing a serious problem now." Pang De immediately made a serious expression.

"Our spies told me that Zhang Fei managed to find and get rid of the blood demon tree in the southern region, so Chang Wuhen and the others already know about the existence of the other four trees, and they have also ordered their clan members to look for the other three.

That's why I have ordered our vassals in the eastern and central regions to protect the blood demon trees in their region, or they will find both of them and destroy them. However, we don't have any vassals in the western region, so I can't send people to protect the blood demon tree there.
That's why I want you to go there now and recruit one or two clans from that region as soon as possible, especially since that region is your responsibility, or those people will find it first."
Pang Hong nodded in understanding before posing a question. "Then what about our plan regarding the seal on the demon portal? When will we move to destroy it?"

"Regarding the demon seal, I am still waiting for orders from our ancestors, and we will immediately move once they give them. That way, those demons can return to this realm, and we will rule it with them." Then Pang De stood up. "All right, you should go to the western region now, and you better be careful, lest you be captured by them too."

After the three of them disappeared, Pang Hong also left the room before flying away, but his mind was filled with many questions about Zhang Fei, especially about his relationship with those powerful clans. "Tch! That little bastard! Back then, he was able to defeat me thanks to the help of those powerful beasts, but he won't be able to escape from me again this time, and I will skin him alive!"

After they arrived at the inn, Zhang Fei [1] brought the two women to see the village chief and informed him about the situation in the cave under the mountain, much to his surprise, especially since the demon miasma had filled the place for so long, but it's gone now.

"Village chief, the Liu Clan will definitely make an announcement regarding this matter soon, so you guys no longer need to be afraid of it. However, I hope you don't tell anyone that I did it, and you can tell them that they were the ones who got rid of it."

"How can you do that, young man?" Zhang Fei [1] smiled and opened his palms, and after seeing his light element, the village chief nodded in understanding. "No wonder you were so confident to go to that place before; I didn't expect that you had such a strong light element.

I'm truly grateful that you were able to remove the demon miasma from that place, especially since that area is quite fertile and there are many good resources that are useful for us there. After all, the situation in the southern ocean is uncertain with the presence of that beast, so we have to think of other ways to improve our situation."
"Village chief, you don't need to thank me; I did that because of the mission we took. In that case, we will return to our lodgings now and leave this village tomorrow."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] led the two women back to their lodgings, but two young women were already waiting for them there, none other than Ning Qingxue and Xia Qianqian, and their expressions were full of panic.

Ning Qingxue went straight to them and grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s hand. "Brother! Please, you have to help us! Xia Leng and the others disappeared into the sea, and we couldn't contact them, so we came back here to ask for help. However, none of the villagers dared to approach the sea because they were afraid of beasts, so we deliberately waited for you to come back."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows momentarily as he looked at Xia Qianqian. "What actually happened? How did they disappear?"

Hearing that, Ning Qingxue immediately explained the exact situation, and she also told them about the beast, surprising Zhang Fei [1] and the two women, especially since the beast was a giant octopus whose size was truly huge.
"Brother, please save my brother and the others." Xia Qianqian finally spoke with a pleading look.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately shook his head at Xia Qianqian. "I'm sorry. I want to save them because we come from the same sect, but we don't want to throw our lives away in vain, especially since the beast is much stronger than us and we can't possibly defeat it.
That's why it would be better if you contacted the elders of our sect, and they will definitely be willing to come to this area to save them."

"Brother, we've contacted them, but they won't be arriving here any time soon, especially since this village is too far from our sect, and they might already be dead by the time the elders arrive here." Seeing Zhang Fei [1] continue to hesitate, Ning Qingxue placed her hand on her chest. "Please save them. If you can save them, I am willing to do anything for you."
'Shameless!' Gu Yan and Luo Yu exclaimed in their hearts as they looked at Ning Qingxue with a glare.

"Sorry, I have to decline your offer, especially since my life is much more important than your body, and I already have two amazing partners by my side." Zhang Fei [1] immediately pulled his hand back from Ning Qingxue's grasp, making her frown, and he immediately brought the two women to enter the inn.

However, Xia Qianqian immediately blocked their way while stretching her arms to the side and speaking to Zhang Fei [1]. "What about me, brother? My brother is the only person who always cares and loves me, so I don't want him to die at the hands of that beast. Like Ningxue, I am willing to do anything for you, including being your servant, but you have to save him first."

Gu Yan and Luo Yu laughed in their hearts after they listened to Xia Qianqian's words, especially since they knew for sure that Zhang Fei [1] had an interest in her, but they also knew that he didn't really care about the fate of others, and he deliberately rejected Ning Qingxue to bait her.

They also knew about his strength as a fox beast, and they believed that it would be too easy for him to defeat the giant octopus beast. 'If Xia Leng discovers that his sister has fallen for Fei's bait, he will undoubtedly vomit blood, and it will be impossible for him to take her away if she has already become entangled in the pleasure of dual-cultivating with him.'

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] thought while rubbing his chin; his eyes moved up and down as he observed Xia Qianqian's body, making her blush. However, she didn't stop him, and instead puffed out her chest, making her massive breasts stand out even more.

"Your offer does interest me, but I don't want to take the risk, especially since your brother is overprotective about you, and he will definitely prevent you from fulfilling your words, so I won't accept your offer."

Ning Qingxue's expression turned angry after she heard Zhang Fei [1]'s answer, especially since she had offered her body to him in order to save the three men. However, he did not hesitate to reject her; instead, he thought about accepting Xia Qianqian's offer. 'Damn it! My face is prettier than hers, but he rejects me!'

Xia Qianqian herself realized the truth of Zhang Fei [1]'s words, especially since her brother had forbidden her to get close to him, but she really didn't want the three men to die at the hands of the beast. She then took a deep breath, grasped his hand, and gazed at him with a serious expression. "What if I give my body to you first?
That way, my brother won't be able to stop me, but you have to save them."

After they arrived at the inn, Zhang Fei [1] brought the two women to see the village chief and informed him about the situation in the cave under the mountain, much to his surprise, especially since the demon miasma had filled the place for so long, but it's gone now.
"Village chief, the Liu Clan will definitely make an announcement regarding this matter soon, so you guys no longer need to be afraid of it.
However, I hope you don't tell anyone that I did it, and you can tell them that they were the ones who got rid of it."
"How can you do that, young man?" Zhang Fei [1] smiled and opened his palms, and after seeing his light element, the village chief nodded in understanding.
"No wonder you were so confident to go to that place before; I didn't expect that you had such a strong light element.
I'm truly grateful that you were able to remove the demon miasma from that place, especially since that area is quite fertile and there are many good resources that are useful for us there.
After all, the situation in the southern ocean is uncertain with the presence of that beast, so we have to think of other ways to improve our situation."
"Village chief, you don't need to thank me; I did that because of the mission we took.
In that case, we will return to our lodgings now and leave this village tomorrow."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] led the two women back to their lodgings, but two young women were already waiting for them there, none other than Ning Qingxue and Xia Qianqian, and their expressions were full of panic.
Ning Qingxue went straight to them and grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s hand.
"Brother!
Please, you have to help us!
Xia Leng and the others disappeared into the sea, and we couldn't contact them, so we came back here to ask for help.
However, none of the villagers dared to approach the sea because they were afraid of beasts, so we deliberately waited for you to come back."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows momentarily as he looked at Xia Qianqian.
"What actually happened?
How did they disappear?"

Hearing that, Ning Qingxue immediately explained the exact situation, and she also told them about the beast, surprising Zhang Fei [1] and the two women, especially since the beast was a giant octopus whose size was truly huge.
"Brother, please save my brother and the others." Xia Qianqian finally spoke with a pleading look.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately shook his head at Xia Qianqian.
"I'm sorry.
I want to save them because we come from the same sect, but we don't want to throw our lives away in vain, especially since the beast is much stronger than us and we can't possibly defeat it.
That's why it would be better if you contacted the elders of our sect, and they will definitely be willing to come to this area to save them."

"Brother, we've contacted them, but they won't be arriving here any time soon, especially since this village is too far from our sect, and they might already be dead by the time the elders arrive here." Seeing Zhang Fei [1] continue to hesitate, Ning Qingxue placed her hand on her chest.
"Please save them.
If you can save them, I am willing to do anything for you."
'Shameless!' Gu Yan and Luo Yu exclaimed in their hearts as they looked at Ning Qingxue with a glare.

"Sorry, I have to decline your offer, especially since my life is much more important than your body, and I already have two amazing partners by my side." Zhang Fei [1] immediately pulled his hand back from Ning Qingxue's grasp, making her frown, and he immediately brought the two women to enter the inn.
However, Xia Qianqian immediately blocked their way while stretching her arms to the side and speaking to Zhang Fei [1].
"What about me, brother?
My brother is the only person who always cares and loves me, so I don't want him to die at the hands of that beast.
Like Ningxue, I am willing to do anything for you, including being your servant, but you have to save him first."

Gu Yan and Luo Yu laughed in their hearts after they listened to Xia Qianqian's words, especially since they knew for sure that Zhang Fei [1] had an interest in her, but they also knew that he didn't really care about the fate of others, and he deliberately rejected Ning Qingxue to bait her.

They also knew about his strength as a fox beast, and they believed that it would be too easy for him to defeat the giant octopus beast. 'If Xia Leng discovers that his sister has fallen for Fei's bait, he will undoubtedly vomit blood, and it will be impossible for him to take her away if she has already become entangled in the pleasure of dual-cultivating with him.'
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] thought while rubbing his chin; his eyes moved up and down as he observed Xia Qianqian's body, making her blush.
However, she didn't stop him, and instead puffed out her chest, making her massive breasts stand out even more.

"Your offer does interest me, but I don't want to take the risk, especially since your brother is overprotective about you, and he will definitely prevent you from fulfilling your words, so I won't accept your offer."
Ning Qingxue's expression turned angry after she heard Zhang Fei [1]'s answer, especially since she had offered her body to him in order to save the three men.
However, he did not hesitate to reject her; instead, he thought about accepting Xia Qianqian's offer. 'Damn it!
My face is prettier than hers, but he rejects me!'

Xia Qianqian herself realized the truth of Zhang Fei [1]'s words, especially since her brother had forbidden her to get close to him, but she really didn't want the three men to die at the hands of the beast.
She then took a deep breath, grasped his hand, and gazed at him with a serious expression.
"What if I give my body to you first?
That way, my brother won't be able to stop me, but you have to save them."

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Fighting Demon Beast
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] startled Xia Qianqian with his hug and kiss, and his tongue immediately invaded her mouth, a sensation she had never experienced before. Even so, she immediately closed her eyes, wrapped her hands around his neck, and followed his guidance to perform a French kiss. "Mhn~" 'Where did he learn this kind of kissing technique?
I often kissed my ex-partner in the past, but we only kissed lightly, and his kiss was more intense than our kiss back then.'

Ning Qingxue's expression grew uglier watching them kiss so hotly, and the jealousy that filled her heart made her anger boil. 'This bitch! I targeted this guy first, but instead she went ahead of me to get him, and he ignored me for her! Tch! I can't care about Xia Leng, and I will teach her a lesson after this!'

Noticing Ning Qingxue's expression, Gu Yan and Luo Yu smiled strangely while laughing in their hearts, especially since they were sure that Zhang Fei [1] would not be interested in her, or else he would not treat her like that.

Suddenly, Zhang Fei [1] and Xia Qianqian disappeared from their sight, and Ning Qingxue stomped her feet on the ground in anger before flying quickly away from the village, following them into the southern ocean.
"Hey, Yu, how long do you think Fei will keep us by his side?" Gu Yan suddenly asked as she tilted her face to the side.

"I don't know." Luo Yu answered her question with a shake of her head. "We are not his official wives, and we decided to be his dual cultivation partners because he can satisfy us and help us become stronger, so I didn't think much about it. For now, we just need to enjoy our time with him, and we will return to our previous lives if he gets bored with us."

Gu Yan nodded in understanding and pulled Luo Yu into the inn. "Let's cultivate while we wait for them to return, especially since I can already feel the barrier leading to the core realm, so I want to break through as quickly as possible to become an inner disciple."
"Yeah, I've felt it too, and I hope I can break through before we return to the sect, so we can become inner disciples together with Fei."

Meanwhile, they had arrived at the edge of the southern ocean, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately released Xia Qianxian from his embrace before rubbing her cheek. "You must remember your previous words, and you will be mine after I save your brother."
"I know." Xia Qianqian replied as she rubbed her own lips, and she still wanted to continue kissing Zhang Fei [1], but they had to save her brother and the two men first. "What will we do now?"

"You wait here, and I will dive into the ocean to look for them." After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately jumped into the ocean and swam quickly into the depths. He also transformed into his half-fox form while releasing his heavenly fox aura, especially since there were so many aquatic beasts stronger than him inside.
"Brother, he will save you soon, so you and the others should hold on for a little longer." Xia Qianqian said this as she cupped her hands in front of her chest.
*Tap... Tap...*
Hearing that, Xia Qianqian immediately turned back, but two hard slaps from Ning Qingxue landed on her cheeks, causing them to become very red.
*Slap... Slap...*
Xia Qianqian did not ignore her actions just like that, and she slapped Ning Qingxue's cheeks back as she glared angrily at her.
*Slap... Slap...*
"You-"

"You what?" Xia Qianqian furiously interrupted Ning Qingxue. "You should stop fantasizing about getting closer to him, because he obviously doesn't even give you a glance due to the fact that you're a slut."

"How dare you call me like that?" Ning Qingxue cursed angrily while releasing her aura, making Xia Qianqian reflexively jump away from her, especially since she cultivated several minor levels above her. "I'll beat you, little bitch!"

"Humph!" Xia Qianqian snorted and took out an artifact from her storage ring before activating it, and several yellow bolts of lightning directly shot out from it before striking Ning Qingxue. "Feel that!"

"Argh!" Ning Qingxue instantly collapsed to the ground, groaning in agony. The lightning bolts had scorched her body, tearing even her sect uniform to shreds, ultimately causing her to become unconscious.

"Phew." After witnessing Ning Qingxue go unconscious, Xia Qianqian sighed in relief and patted her chest several times, yet she was equally shocked by the artifact's power. "Back then, my brother gave this artifact to me so that I could protect myself, but I never thought I would use it on this slut. Moreover, this artifact is only spirit-grade, but its effect is so strong."

Although she didn't like Ning Qingxue's actions just now, Xia Qianqian also didn't want to see her in pain, so she squatted beside her and put a healing pill into her mouth. After that, she sat on the edge of the ocean and continued to stare ahead, waiting for Zhang Fei [1] to save his brother.

While his clone was busy searching for the whereabouts of the three male disciples in the ocean, Zhang Fei was struggling hard to get up from the floor, especially since the weight of gravity in the training space became two times heavier after he asked Mei to activate the gravity feature. "Crap! The pressure from this gravity is too strong!
I don't dare imagine if I train to level two, which would make it four times heavier."'
[Do you want me to turn it off first, Master?]

"No need!" Zhang Fei immediately rejected Mei. "This gravity is indeed troublesome, but I have to make it through it. That way, I can be better than the other cultivators out there, and I can protect them all from the enemies who are targeting us."
Mei could only shake her head after hearing that, and she followed Zhang Fei's wishes, especially since she knew exactly what was on his mind.

"Damn it! I can't lose to this gravitational weight!" Zhang Fei immediately pressed both palms on the floor and tried to push his body up, making his muscles bulge out all over his body. "Get up! I have to make it up!"
*Bam*

Instead, Zhang Fei once again fell to the floor, but he didn't want to stop and continued to struggle to stand up. Unfortunately, because he didn't use his cultivation, the weight of gravity was still too much for him, and he kept falling again and again.
After quite a long time, Zhang Fei decided to rest first, and he thought about continuing afterward. "Anyway, what time on earth is it now, Mei?"

[Almost 6 p.m., master. Do you want to return to earth and send them to the Sky Jade Realm first? Moreover, you haven't finished your daily quest, especially since you were previously busy understanding those sword techniques. That's why it would be better if you went out to finish it first, and you could continue your training in this space after sending them there.]

"All right, you can turn off this gravity now." Zhang Fei immediately stood up as soon as Mei carried out his order, but he felt that his body was lighter than before he trained at two times gravity. "Not bad! Although I haven't been able to adapt to that gravity, my previous training has made my body a little better, and it will definitely get better once I manage to adapt perfectly."

[That's for sure, Master. There is no such device in the Sky Jade Realm, and I am sure that your speed will surpass the cultivators, whose levels are above you if you have perfectly adapted to two times gravity.]

Zhang Fei nodded and left the training space, arriving at the previous forest immediately. Wasting no time, he summoned the demon extermination sword before jumping down from the tree, and he immediately enveloped it in his light element before dashing towards a low-level demon beast not far from him.
*Slash*
*Splurt*
[You have killed 1 demon, with 19 remaining.]

"Huh?" Zhang Fei was completely shocked after seeing the demon beast split in half, even though he only slashed his sword lightly. "Damn it! This sword is really sharp! This beast is no different from silky tofu before this sword!"

[Haha.] After hearing that, Mei suddenly laughed. [Master, the sharpness of the demon extermination sword is indeed extraordinary, especially since the grade seems to be very high. Moreover, that demon beast is only low-level, and you also imbue it with your light element, so it's natural that you can kill it easily.
However, high-level demons have much stronger physiques, and many of them have thick skin, so you won't be able to kill them this easily.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement and opened his map to search for stronger demon beasts. Once he found their location, he immediately teleported away. Quickly, he arrived on top of a herd of bull demon beasts, and their bodies looked huge and covered in thick black fur. "Hmm? What do you think about them, Mei?"

[These bull demon beasts possess robust bodies and skin, and their razor-sharp horns would inflict severe pain if they were to pierce you. Moreover, they are different from ordinary bulls on Earth, and they can also channel their power to their leaders, so it would be better if you attacked the strongest among them first.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and checked their status one by one, but he immediately raised his eyebrows as soon as a bull demon beast walked out of the bushes, and it had already changed into its semi-humanoid form while shouldering a large axe. "Hey! That beast should be their leader, so I'll fight him first.
If I'm having trouble fighting him, then I'll use my heavenly fox bloodline to suppress him."

[Yes, you can do that, Master. Demon beasts are no different from beasts in the cultivator realm, but these demon beasts do not have cultivation like them, and they only rely on their physical strength, so you can suppress them with your aura and absorb their beast essences.]

Zhang Fei immediately transformed into his incubus form and landed in front of the bull demon beasts, but his arrival made their leader's expression turn furious, and he gripped his axe tightly before charging at him.

"Dang! His body is so big, but his speed is quite fast!" Even so, Zhang Fei had no intention of dodging the attack from the bull demon beast leader, and instead he swung his sword from the bottom up to block his axe, causing their weapons to clash with each other.
*Swoosh*

The bull demon beast leader's axe instantly snapped in half, sending the axe head flying far back, leaving him momentarily stunned. However, Zhang Fei immediately slashed his sword towards his chest, which hit him directly and left a fairly deep slash wound, making him stumble several steps back. Black blood flowed out of his chest.
*Grunts*

The bull demon beast leader let out a loud grunt while stomping his feet on the ground before his body was enveloped in a black and red aura, and Zhang Fei could feel the flow of power from the horde of bull demon beasts behind him.
Zhang Fei immediately flew into the air as soon as the bull demon beast leader charged towards him, causing his head to hit the big tree behind him, and the tree instantly exploded because of it.

Seeing that, Zhang Fei dove down while preparing to slash his sword, and he immediately did so as soon as they were close enough. However, the bull demon beast leader immediately crossed his arms above his head, but he was overconfident in his body strength, and the demon exterminating sword directly cut both of them, causing him to snort in pain.
*Grunts*
Zhang Fei continued his attack and slashed his sword at the bull demon beast leader's neck, immediately separating his head from his body and causing black blood to spurt out of it.
[You have killed 2 demons, with 18 remaining.]

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Deserted Valley
paragraphs: After he killed the bull demon beast leader, Zhang Fei only noticed that something unusual happened to the demon extermination sword, which absorbed a part of his demon soul, but he immediately ignored it and focused on his quest first.

As soon as their leader died, the herd of bull demon beasts fled the place in a hurry, but Zhang Fei certainly didn't let them go. As he used the clone illusion steps, he moved towards the herd and killed them one by one, while his sword continued to absorb some of their demon souls.
[You have killed 3 demons, with 17 remaining.]
[You have killed 4 demons, with 16 remaining.]
[You have killed 5 demons, with 15 remaining.]
[You have killed 20 demons, with 0 remaining.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 20 Demons.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 2,000 female essences are added to the balance.]

"Phew." With a breath of relief, Zhang Fei examined the demon extermination sword. "Did you notice it, Mei? This sword absorbs their souls, but I don't feel any changes in this sword, and their souls also don't provide any benefits to me."

[Yes, master, I also noticed that, but I don't understand the benefits of their demon souls for the demon extermination sword. Perhaps you should use it to kill more demons or demon beasts, and we might find out the true effect of their demon souls on it. After all, the sword is still incomplete, and its grade is still unclear.]

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei grinned slightly and ran straight to another area. "In that case, let's test it by killing other demon beasts; after that, I will return to earth to send them off to the Sky Jade Realm."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] had already swam quite deep in the ocean, but he still hadn't managed to find the beast, especially since it didn't appear on his map. However, he found an underwater cave not far from his location, so he rushed there and swam along it carefully.

A while later, Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at the end of the cave, but he strangely saw a light from above and swam straight towards the surface. However, to his surprise, he arrived at a valley far from the ocean, and it was filled with various kinds of herbs. The names of the three people immediately appeared on his map.
Not only that, he could also see the names Xia Qianqian and Ning Qingxue at a considerable distance from his current location.
[Master, it seems that people in this realm don't know about the existence of this place, especially since it is still very natural, so humans have never come here before.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with that, but he was still curious about the beast's whereabouts, especially since its name still hadn't appeared on his map, so he decided to summon Boitata out of his beast space.

"Eh? Where is this place, Master? Why did I never know there was a place in this realm before?" With gleaming eyes, Boitata watched those herbs, her saliva seeming to drip from the corner of her mouth. "Ouch!" Why did you slap my butt again? Are you looking forward to eating me?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded as he squeezed Boitata's buttocks. "However, I won't eat you using this clone of mine, so I will summon you in the Diyu Realm before eating you later with my real body, and I will make a mischievous snake like you submit to me."

"Ha ha." Upon hearing that, Boitata laughed awkwardly, still feeling scared due to the size of his dick. However, she then spoiledly hugged Zhang Fei [1], teasing him in the process. "Master, I'm your contract beast, remember? Since I've already submitted to you, I can't possibly be more submissive than now, right?"

"You are still not completely submissive to me, so I have to train you to become more submissive to me." Boitata sulked in response, and Zhang Fei [1] surveyed the surroundings as he questioned her. "Can you feel the presence of another beast in this place?

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Bring His Aunt-Cousin
paragraphs: In a cave, a young woman with long pink hair who was meditating naked slowly opened her eyes after she felt someone's presence. "Since when did you come back, Mother?"

"A week ago, Yue'er." Hu Lili answered as she sat beside her daughter and embraced her shoulders. "However, I saw you were engrossed in your cultivation, so I didn't disturb you and waited for you to finish first, but you seemed to have failed to break through again."

Hu Yue released a heavy sigh and nodded to her. "I've touched the final barrier to breaking through to the sovereign realm many times, but I've repeatedly failed to do so. Anyway, what about Zhang Fei? Have you met him?"
"Yes, I've met him before, but our meeting wasn't very long." Hu Lili answered with a nod. "As I thought before, Zhang Fei is indeed a heavenly fox, but he is also a demon."
"A demon?" Hu Yue frowned immediately after hearing that, especially since she couldn't sense any demon aura from Zhang Fei's body when they met and were intimate back then.

"Zhang Fei already showed me his demon form, which is a lust demon, and the pink symbol under your navel is his demon partner mark." Hu Yue was truly shocked after learning the identities of the three Zhang Feis, and Hu Lili immediately continued.
"Honestly, I still feel strange about him because he has three real forms, and I've never encountered anything as absurd as that before, so I can't be sure of his future.

Even so, I am confident that he can take you away from this place, especially since I myself have felt the pressure from his bloodline, so I am sure that Hu Gao and Hu Dong will be helpless before him, and I have given him the key to this sub-space.
However, he is still too weak, so you will have to wait quite a long time for him to arrive, but he has promised to increase his strength as quickly as possible."

"Mother, I want to meet Zhang Fei again and stay by his side, but I don't want him to be too hasty and force himself to improve his cultivation. Otherwise, it will backfire on him if he is too hasty, which will be detrimental to the future." Hu Yue suddenly realized something, looked at her mother suspiciously, and finally asked, "Did he do something to you when you two met?
I've felt the effects of his heavenly fox aura before, so I'm very clear about it. Moreover, he's also a lust demon, so I'm sure that he's done something to you."

Hu Lili felt lost after hearing her daughter's question, but she sighed softly and nodded to her. "Zhang Fei's bloodline did influence me, and he also used his demon abilities on me, so we already kissed before. Besides, he confessed to me that he wanted to get me as his wife too, but I rejected him and asked him to focus on his goal to fulfill his promise to you."

"I see." Hu Yue nodded in understanding before lying her head on Hu Lili's shoulder and taking her hand. "Mother, my father died so long ago, and you have always been alone since then. Hu Gao has always coveted you, and he will run out of patience with you sooner or later, so he might force you to be his wife."
Hu Lili raised an eyebrow and asked a question. "Are you thinking of asking me to give myself to Zhang Fei?"

"Yes." Hu Yue answered without hesitation. "As you said before, Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, and a heavenly fox is a supreme fox race, so he is much superior compared to Hu Gao, who is of the same race as us.

Although I feel strange about such a relationship, I am more willing to share a husband with you than if I had to watch you become that old bastard's wife, especially since you will never be happy for the rest of your life if that happens, and we will leave this place together in the future."

Hu Lili inwardly sighed heavily, as she certainly didn't want to be Hu Gao's wife, but she also didn't want to hurt her daughter's feelings by becoming Zhang Fei's wife. "All right, we don't need to discuss this matter now, especially since he doesn't have the ability to come here yet. For now, I will assist and guide you in your cultivation, so you can break through to the sovereign realm faster."

After she said that, Hu Lili immediately took off her dress and moved to sit in front of her daughter. They then pressed their palms against each other while closing their eyes. They quickly immersed themselves in their cultivation, with her channeling her qi into Hu Yue's body.
*Bam*

The body of a giant black ape without a head slammed to the ground, and Zhang Fei immediately landed beside it while observing the demon extermination sword. "Mei, what exactly is going on with this sword? I've killed quite a lot of demon beasts, and it has absorbed a lot of demon beast souls, but I still don't see any changes to it."

[Unfortunately, I still don't have an answer for you, Master. I've been observing that sword since you fought with those empn beasts, but I also didn't find any changes in it, so we can only wait for it to show a reaction on its own; only then can we find the answer.]
Zhang Fei couldn't help but sigh after hearing that, and he wiped off the blood on his sword before it entered his forehead and turned into a sword tattoo again. "Open the gate to Earth, Mei."
[Yes, Master.]

As soon as Mei opened the gate, Zhang Fei immediately jumped in, arriving at Zhang Chen's house in an instant. The moment he came out of his room, Xu Ling'er immediately jumped up to hug him like a spoiled girl. "Hehe! How was your adventure in the Diyu Realm, Big Brother? Is that place nice?"

"That place is actually quite nice, but power struggles continue to occur there, so the situation is really chaotic now." Zhang Fei then turned to the other woman, and he smiled at Guo Lan, who was sitting beside Zhong Yan, but her expression was nervous because she would be joining them in going to the Sky Jade Realm for the first time.

"Lan, you don't need to be this nervous, and you will like the situation in the Chu Clan. Moreover, Hua'er and the others are also kind, so you will feel safe and calm there. However, I won't stay there for too long this time, especially since I have to return to the Diyu Realm, so they will be the ones to teach you cultivation."
"I know, Fei." Guo Lan replied with a nod. "However, this is my first experience going to a foreign place, let alone the place being another world, so I feel really nervous."

"Don't worry; you will be fine, and you will definitely be eager to go there again after you spend a few days there." Zhang Fei suddenly heard the sound of a car stopping in front of the house, and he raised his eyebrows immediately, especially since his mother came back with his maternal aunt and cousin. 'Why did she bring them here? Was she telling them the truth?'

"Fei'er." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Zhang Yue. "What if we teach them to cultivate like us? After all, Aunt Tan and Cousin Xun have no family besides us, and they've always been very nice to us, so I think it would be better if they became one of us."

Zhang Fei himself was actually happy and grateful to Qing Tan, but he felt that their lives were already excellent, even though her husband was no longer around. That's why he felt it was hard to bring them into such a cruel world, which might put them in endless danger.

Zhong Yan also spoke to Zhang Fei, noticing his expression. "Fei'er, I can understand your thoughts, but I agree with Yue, and it would be better if they became cultivators like us. Furthermore, they don't need to stay in the Sky Jade Realm permanently; they can come back here again.
That way, they will be stronger than ordinary humans here, and they can protect themselves if there are people who have evil intentions towards them."

"Fei'er, you don't need to hesitate anymore." Ru Xue joined in persuading him. "Back then, when you were first kicked out of your house, Sister Tan always visited you to give her support, and she always believed that you didn't do that, so I thought this was a good opportunity to repay her."

Zhang Fei did not immediately give them an answer, especially since his circumstances were completely different from those in the past, and he now had such a relationship with his mother, big sister, and little sister. He was afraid that Qing Tan would be disappointed in them if she found out their true relationship, and she might hate them for the rest of her life. "Sigh!
If Aunt Tan hates us, I will feel terrible for her."

Not long after, Qing Yi led the two guests into the house, and she immediately ran to her son's side while whispering to him. 'Fei'er, your aunt insisted on coming here because she wanted Xun'er to train with you to reduce his weight, and I was at a loss on how to explain to them, so I brought them here.'

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after he heard his mother's explanation, and he immediately spoke to Qing Tan. "Aunt Tan, I understand your wishes regarding Xun'er, but my training is completely different from what you imagine, and it's hard for me to explain it to the two of you, so I'll show it to you right away.
However, I hope you two are not too shocked by the truth, and I ask you two not to tell this to anyone else, especially since no one will believe you."
"What do you mean by that, Fei'er? Why can't you explain it to me?" Qing Tan inquired with a raised eyebrow, and Quan Xun also looked suspiciously at him.

Zhang Fei didn't answer his maternal aunt's question and asked Mei to open the gate directly to the Sky Jade Realm, causing Qing Tan and Quan Xun's eyes to widen in shock. "All right, you guys can come in now."
"Yay! I can't wait to cultivate again, Big Brother!" Xu Ling'er exclaimed as she jumped down from Zhang Fei's arms before entering the gate.
Qing Tan and Quan Xun's expressions became even more shocked once Zhang Yue, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, and Guo Lan also disappeared through that gate.
"Fei'er! Where... did that strange gate come from? "Where... did they all disappear?" Qing Tan asked her nephew stutteringly.

"You two don't need to be afraid. Go through that gate now, and you guys will understand why I find it difficult to explain everything." Seeing them so hesitant and afraid, Qing Yi took their hands and pulled them into the gate, and Zhang Fei immediately followed behind them.

Qing Tan and Quan Xun instantly froze in place as soon as they arrived at the Chu Clan's back garden, but they were also amazed by the scenery around them, making them feel like they had moved to a kingdom era.
*Roar... Roar...*

The roar of the two tigresses woke them from their daze, but they immediately hid behind Qing Yi as soon as they jumped at Zhang Fei, and their expressions were filled with horror because of their sizes.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei instantly fell to the ground, and the two tigresses licked her face in excitement, making her maternal aunt and cousin, who were previously frightened, become dumbfounded.

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei laughed loudly as he hugged the two tigresses who were lying on either side of him. "Hey, the growth of you two is amazing! I haven't seen the two of you for four days, but you guys are getting bigger now, and I might be able to ride on your backs soon."
*Tap... Tap..."
Zhang Fei turned to Liu Hua, who had gracefully landed in front of them, and she spoke to him. "I thought you wouldn't come here this time, Fei'er."

"As I thought before, Zhang Fei is indeed a heavenly fox, but he is also a demon."
"A demon?" Hu Yue frowned immediately after hearing that, especially since she couldn't sense any demon aura from Zhang Fei's body when they met and were intimate back then.

"Zhang Fei already showed me his demon form, which is a lust demon, and the pink symbol under your navel is his demon partner mark." Hu Yue was truly shocked after learning the identities of the three Zhang Feis, and Hu Lili immediately continued.
"Honestly, I still feel strange about him because he has three real forms, and I've never encountered anything as absurd as that before, so I can't be sure of his future.

Even so, I am confident that he can take you away from this place, especially since I myself have felt the pressure from his bloodline, so I am sure that Hu Gao and Hu Dong will be helpless before him, and I have given him the key to this sub-space.
However, he is still too weak, so you will have to wait quite a long time for him to arrive, but he has promised to increase his strength as quickly as possible."
"Mother, I want to meet Zhang Fei again and stay by his side, but I don't want him to be too hasty and force himself to improve his cultivation.

Otherwise, it will backfire on him if he is too hasty, which will be detrimental to the future." Hu Yue suddenly realized something, looked at her mother suspiciously, and finally asked, "Did he do something to you when you two met?
I've felt the effects of his heavenly fox aura before, so I'm very clear about it.
Moreover, he's also a lust demon, so I'm sure that he's done something to you."
Hu Lili felt lost after hearing her daughter's question, but she sighed softly and nodded to her.
"Zhang Fei's bloodline did influence me, and he also used his demon abilities on me, so we already kissed before.
Besides, he confessed to me that he wanted to get me as his wife too, but I rejected him and asked him to focus on his goal to fulfill his promise to you."
"I see." Hu Yue nodded in understanding before lying her head on Hu Lili's shoulder and taking her hand.
"Mother, my father died so long ago, and you have always been alone since then.
Hu Gao has always coveted you, and he will run out of patience with you sooner or later, so he might force you to be his wife."
Hu Lili raised an eyebrow and asked a question.
"Are you thinking of asking me to give myself to Zhang Fei?"
"Yes." Hu Yue answered without hesitation.
"As you said before, Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, and a heavenly fox is a supreme fox race, so he is much superior compared to Hu Gao, who is of the same race as us.

Although I feel strange about such a relationship, I am more willing to share a husband with you than if I had to watch you become that old bastard's wife, especially since you will never be happy for the rest of your life if that happens, and we will leave this place together in the future."
Hu Lili inwardly sighed heavily, as she certainly didn't want to be Hu Gao's wife, but she also didn't want to hurt her daughter's feelings by becoming Zhang Fei's wife.
"All right, we don't need to discuss this matter now, especially since he doesn't have the ability to come here yet.
For now, I will assist and guide you in your cultivation, so you can break through to the sovereign realm faster."
After she said that, Hu Lili immediately took off her dress and moved to sit in front of her daughter.
They then pressed their palms against each other while closing their eyes.
They quickly immersed themselves in their cultivation, with her channeling her qi into Hu Yue's body.
*Bam*
The body of a giant black ape without a head slammed to the ground, and Zhang Fei immediately landed beside it while observing the demon extermination sword.
"Mei, what exactly is going on with this sword?
I've killed quite a lot of demon beasts, and it has absorbed a lot of demon beast souls, but I still don't see any changes to it."
[Unfortunately, I still don't have an answer for you, Master.

I've been observing that sword since you fought with those empn beasts, but I also didn't find any changes in it, so we can only wait for it to show a reaction on its own; only then can we find the answer.]
Zhang Fei couldn't help but sigh after hearing that, and he wiped off the blood on his sword before it entered his forehead and turned into a sword tattoo again.
"Open the gate to Earth, Mei."
[Yes, Master.]
As soon as Mei opened the gate, Zhang Fei immediately jumped in, arriving at Zhang Chen's house in an instant.
The moment he came out of his room, Xu Ling'er immediately jumped up to hug him like a spoiled girl.
"Hehe!
How was your adventure in the Diyu Realm, Big Brother?
Is that place nice?"

"That place is actually quite nice, but power struggles continue to occur there, so the situation is really chaotic now." Zhang Fei then turned to the other woman, and he smiled at Guo Lan, who was sitting beside Zhong Yan, but her expression was nervous because she would be joining them in going to the Sky Jade Realm for the first time.
"Lan, you don't need to be this nervous, and you will like the situation in the Chu Clan.
Moreover, Hua'er and the others are also kind, so you will feel safe and calm there.
However, I won't stay there for too long this time, especially since I have to return to the Diyu Realm, so they will be the ones to teach you cultivation."
"I know, Fei." Guo Lan replied with a nod.
"However, this is my first experience going to a foreign place, let alone the place being another world, so I feel really nervous."

"Don't worry; you will be fine, and you will definitely be eager to go there again after you spend a few days there." Zhang Fei suddenly heard the sound of a car stopping in front of the house, and he raised his eyebrows immediately, especially since his mother came back with his maternal aunt and cousin. 'Why did she bring them here?
Was she telling them the truth?'
"Fei'er." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Zhang Yue.
"What if we teach them to cultivate like us?
After all, Aunt Tan and Cousin Xun have no family besides us, and they've always been very nice to us, so I think it would be better if they became one of us."
Zhang Fei himself was actually happy and grateful to Qing Tan, but he felt that their lives were already excellent, even though her husband was no longer around.
That's why he felt it was hard to bring them into such a cruel world, which might put them in endless danger.
Zhong Yan also spoke to Zhang Fei, noticing his expression.
"Fei'er, I can understand your thoughts, but I agree with Yue, and it would be better if they became cultivators like us.
Furthermore, they don't need to stay in the Sky Jade Realm permanently; they can come back here again.
That way, they will be stronger than ordinary humans here, and they can protect themselves if there are people who have evil intentions towards them."
"Fei'er, you don't need to hesitate anymore." Ru Xue joined in persuading him.

"Back then, when you were first kicked out of your house, Sister Tan always visited you to give her support, and she always believed that you didn't do that, so I thought this was a good opportunity to repay her."

Zhang Fei did not immediately give them an answer, especially since his circumstances were completely different from those in the past, and he now had such a relationship with his mother, big sister, and little sister.
He was afraid that Qing Tan would be disappointed in them if she found out their true relationship, and she might hate them for the rest of her life.
"Sigh!
If Aunt Tan hates us, I will feel terrible for her."

Not long after, Qing Yi led the two guests into the house, and she immediately ran to her son's side while whispering to him. 'Fei'er, your aunt insisted on coming here because she wanted Xun'er to train with you to reduce his weight, and I was at a loss on how to explain to them, so I brought them here.'
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after he heard his mother's explanation, and he immediately spoke to Qing Tan.

"Aunt Tan, I understand your wishes regarding Xun'er, but my training is completely different from what you imagine, and it's hard for me to explain it to the two of you, so I'll show it to you right away.
However, I hope you two are not too shocked by the truth, and I ask you two not to tell this to anyone else, especially since no one will believe you."
"What do you mean by that, Fei'er?
Why can't you explain it to me?" Qing Tan inquired with a raised eyebrow, and Quan Xun also looked suspiciously at him.
Zhang Fei didn't answer his maternal aunt's question and asked Mei to open the gate directly to the Sky Jade Realm, causing Qing Tan and Quan Xun's eyes to widen in shock.
"All right, you guys can come in now."
"Yay!
I can't wait to cultivate again, Big Brother!" Xu Ling'er exclaimed as she jumped down from Zhang Fei's arms before entering the gate.
Qing Tan and Quan Xun's expressions became even more shocked once Zhang Yue, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, and Guo Lan also disappeared through that gate.
"Fei'er!
Where... did that strange gate come from?
"Where... did they all disappear?" Qing Tan asked her nephew stutteringly.
"You two don't need to be afraid.

Go through that gate now, and you guys will understand why I find it difficult to explain everything." Seeing them so hesitant and afraid, Qing Yi took their hands and pulled them into the gate, and Zhang Fei immediately followed behind them.

Qing Tan and Quan Xun instantly froze in place as soon as they arrived at the Chu Clan's back garden, but they were also amazed by the scenery around them, making them feel like they had moved to a kingdom era.
*Roar...
Roar...*

The roar of the two tigresses woke them from their daze, but they immediately hid behind Qing Yi as soon as they jumped at Zhang Fei, and their expressions were filled with horror because of their sizes.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei instantly fell to the ground, and the two tigresses licked her face in excitement, making her maternal aunt and cousin, who were previously frightened, become dumbfounded.
"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei laughed loudly as he hugged the two tigresses who were lying on either side of him.
"Hey, the growth of you two is amazing!
I haven't seen the two of you for four days, but you guys are getting bigger now, and I might be able to ride on your backs soon."
*Tap...
Tap..."
Zhang Fei turned to Liu Hua, who had gracefully landed in front of them, and she spoke to him.
"I thought you wouldn't come here this time, Fei'er."

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Plant Manipulation
paragraphs: Zhang Fei had already brought his mother, aunt, and cousin to the Chu Clan's main hall, but Qing Tan and Quan Xun kept staring at the four women in shock, especially since three of them addressed him as their husband, which means they share a husband with each other.

Not far from them, Zhang Yue and the women from earth were sitting side by side, except for Xu Ling'er, who chose to cultivate inside the qi gathering formation in the back garden, along with the two tigresses.

Qing Tan and Quan Xun became even more shocked once Zhang Fei explained to them about the Sky Jade Realm, cultivators, and its relationship with people from the Chu Clan. He also told them about his relationship with Zhong Yan, but he hasn't told them about his relationship with his family, especially since such a relationship is taboo for ordinary humans like the two of them.
"Anyway, I don't have much free time right now because I've made a promise to someone and want to fulfill it as quickly as possible, so I have to focus on my own practice.

That's why my mother and grandmother will explain to you two about how to cultivate, and you guys will understand the truth of my words after you become cultivators like us." Zhang Fei then asked Liu Hua to summon the Wen Twins, who soon appeared in front of them, and he later asked Mei to open a portal to the training space before bringing them all in.

After they left, Qing Yi and Zhang Chen led the two people back to the back garden, especially since that place was the best place to start their journey of becoming cultivators, and they also explained to the two about the basics of cultivation.
"Big Sis, where's He'er? All of you are here, but I haven't seen him since earlier."
Qing Yi immediately stopped walking before turning to Qing Tan with a sad expression. "He'er is dead, so he's not with us now."
"Huh?" Qing Tan and Quan Xun were completely shocked after hearing the news. "Who killed him? Why didn't you tell us before?"

"He'er's death hit both of us hard, so you don't have to blame Yi'er for not telling you guys." They immediately turned to Zhang Chen. "Moreover, Fei'er is his murderer, so we don't want to talk about this matter anymore."
Both of them stiffened after hearing Zhang Chen's answer, but Qing Tan then, with a trembling voice, asked her. "Are... you serious, Aunt Chen? Why... did Fei'er kill his big brother?"
"Let's go; I'll explain everything to you two." As they continued their journey to the back garden, Zhang Chen told them about the matter between Zhang Fei and Zhang He.
Qing Tan was truly sad after she heard that Zhang He intended to kill his little brother, but she knew that he had always been jealous of Zhang Fei, and he even snatched Chen Xin from him.

"That's good because he's dead now." Qing Tan turned to her son with a sharp glare, but Quan Xun ignored his mother and continued. "Since a long time ago, I have never liked Zhang He, especially since he was always arrogant and bullied Cousin Fei. Besides, Cousin Yue was always good to him, but he and that bitch, Chen Xin, actually framed them, which made them separated for quite a long time."
"You-"

Qing Yi promptly stopped her little sister. "Tan'er, you don't need to scold Xun'er because his words are true, and this matter happened because of He'er's arrogance and greed. Honestly, I'm sad about his death, but I've started to accept it.
Moreover, our lives are different now, and there are so many new things waiting for us in the future, so I don't want to keep looking back at the past and focus on our future instead."

Before long, they had arrived at the back garden, so Zhang Chen and Qing Yi took them into the formation before explaining how to absorb Qi from the air, and they asked the two to try it after they more or less understood it.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was explaining the function of the device in the center of the room to Liu Qingyu and the others, which amazed them, especially the gravity feature. Despite this, they still harbored many questions about Zhang Fei, particularly because all the things he had ever given and shown them were too mysterious for anyone else to possess.

Zhang Lin then hugged his arm as she asked. "Big brother! What if you activate it now? That way, we can experience the effects for ourselves, and our movements can be faster than those of other cultivators."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at his little sister's impatience and then pinched her nose. "Lin'er, two times gravity is really tough, and I've tried it myself before. Regrettably, I'm still struggling to adapt completely, and I'm sure that the pressure will overwhelm you, Big Sis, Qing'er, and Ying'er.
However, Qingyu, Hua'er, and the Wen Twins are stronger than us, so they might be able to adapt to the gravity pressure faster."
"I know that, but I still want to try it." Zhang Lin said it while pouting her lips.

Chu Ying then spoke to him as well. "I myself am aware of my limits, but I agree with Lin'er. I want to train using the gravity feature so I can be stronger and faster, and I don't have to depend on you or the others."
"Me too!" As she raised her hand, Chu Qing said this.
"What do you two think?" Zhang Fei questioned the Liu Sisters.

"I don't think it's a big deal, Fei'er." Liu Hua agreed with her big sister, as she herself was actually not that confident to overcome the pressure of two times gravity, and Liu Qingyu then continued. "At first, everyone will find it difficult to experience new things, but our bodies will always adapt to them.

We may struggle for now, but we can only improve if we successfully overcome the obstacles in front of us, so you can activate it. Even so, I won't train here for now because I have to look after our clan, and I also have to protect Aunt Chen and the others, so you can send me out now."

"You guys, get ready because I will turn on the gravity feature now, and I'll take Qingyu out of this place after that." Liu Hua and the others looked at Zhang Fei questioningly, thinking that he would train with them, so he directly explained it to them.
"I plan to go to the Central Region to do something, but I won't stay there and go straight back to the Diyu Realm afterward, so I'll join you guys after I get there."

After they agreed, Zhang Fei took Liu Qingyu out of that place, but he didn't go straight to the central region, and he dual-cultivated with her first because they both missed each other. Even so, they didn't do it for too long, especially since she was overwhelmed by his wildness and quickly became exhausted.

After that, Zhang Fei first traveled to the Heavenly Sword Sect, recording its location in his warp portal before proceeding to the Central Region. Since the region was too far away, he was forced to use the Nine Cloud Steps again and again, and he also swallowed several high-grade qi recovery pills to overcome his qi deficiency.

After he arrived in the Central Region, Zhang Fei went straight to the Blazing Phoenix Sect and saved the sect's location. However, he did not meet Zhang Lingxue, as she was busy preparing for her sect's internal competition, and Zhao Ziqin was also diligently cultivating in her room. Therefore, he decided to return to the Diyu Realm and headed directly towards the Dryad Forest.
"Where have you been, Fei? Did you take them away to the Sky Jade Realm?" Janette, who was talking to her mother, immediately asked when Zhang Fei appeared in front of them.
"Yes, I just came back from the Sky Jade Realm." Zhang Fei then turned to Lillia. "Can I ask you for one thing?"
Lillea nodded at Zhang Fei. "My daughter has told me about her relationship with you; you are now part of our race, and I will definitely help you if I can."

"I want to kiss you now." Janette and Lillea frowned after hearing that, but Zhang Fei quickly explained his purpose to them. "That's why I want to mimic your plant manipulation because it will be very useful for me, but I can only do it if I kiss you, so I hope you can fulfill my request."

Lillea did not immediately give her consent, and she suspiciously asked Zhang Fei. "How could you know that I have that kind of ability? Moreover, a lust demon shouldn't have the ability to mimic another demon's ability, so I'm really curious about that."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that. "Have you ever met anyone like me before? I am a human, a fox, and a lust demon, remember? Other lust demons may not be able to do it, but I am different from them, and I have mimicked Janette's tree control before."
Lillea released a soft sigh before agreeing to Zhang Fei's request. "All right, you can kiss me to mimic my plant manipulation."
After obtaining her consent, Zhang Fei stood in front of Lillea and cupped her cheeks before kissing her, but he only gave her a light kiss while mimicking her plant manipulation.
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the plant manipulation of a Dryad named Lillea.]

Upon receiving the notification, Zhang Fei immediately parted their lips and expressed gratitude. "Thank you, Lillea. This way, I can do something about the herbs in that deserted valley, which will be very useful for me and my family."
"It's okay; it's just a kiss, so you don't need to thank me."

Janette suddenly asked him. "Fei, could you teach my mother to become a cultivator? If she becomes a demon cultivator like me, then her strength will increase even more, and we can protect our kin from attacks by the armies of those rulers."

"Sure." After all, Zhang Fei himself was interested in getting Lillea, so he immediately agreed to Janette's request, and he took out the portable mansion. "You can take your mother inside and teach her cultivation, and I will practice together with the others for now."

Janette excitedly pulled her mother into the portable mansion, and Zhang Fei himself immediately returned to the training space to train with his other wives, particularly since he wanted to adapt to the two-time gravity sooner.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,000 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 2,000 red jewels sent to inventory]

Zhang Fei [1], who had just finished the daily quest, immediately opened his eyes. However, he felt someone's presence in front of his bedroom door, so he opened it and pulled Xia Qianqian, who was standing there inside. "Have you finished taking care of them?"

"Yes, I just finished taking care of them, so I came to you to fulfill my promise." Xia Qianqian answered with a red face and a pounding heart, but she then glanced at Luo Yu and Gu Yan, who were still in deep cultivation. "Are we going to do it here?"

"Are you ashamed of them?" Xia Qianqian nodded at Zhang Fei [1]. "They are my partners, and you will also be my partners after this, so you don't need to feel embarrassed towards them. Instead, I will teach you some interesting things that you never knew before, and I dare to guarantee that you will like them. Anyway, why did you decide to become a dual cultivator?
Was Xia Leng the one who took your virginity? I heard that he was overprotective of you, and there were a lot of rumors circulating about the relationship between the two of you."

Xia Qianqian smiled bitterly upon hearing that, as she herself had heard about them too many times. "Brother, the rumors about our relationship are false, so don't believe them. Big Brother is indeed overprotective of me, but we don't have that kind of relationship. In fact, the person who took my virginity was my childhood friend, and he had previously been a disciple of our sect.
However, the sect expelled him, and he moved to the eastern region, leaving me with no further news about him.
Zhang Fei [1] just nodded and ignored it outright, as he didn't think much about it. "Shall we start now?"
